advancements.theoreticalsciences.transfi: Climb into the Infinite, the Realm's top layer
block.theoreticalsciences.abiogenesis_cr: A crucible of primordial soup under lightning and ultraviolet light, held where chemistry tips over into life. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.absolute_frame: A frame that keeps its shape whatever the laws around it do: the one fixed reference in a place where every other measure has come loose.
block.theoreticalsciences.absolute_pedes: A pedestal of the highest grade, made to hold an offering at the very centre of a ritual. Nothing set on it is ever quite where it was before.
block.theoreticalsciences.absorption_col: Trays of water down which the nitrous gases bubble, turning to nitric acid as they go.
block.theoreticalsciences.abyssal_silica: Titan's rocky core, under its hidden ocean: hydrated silicate, soaked through for four billion years. Found on the floor of Titan's hidden ocean. Hot water through it gives hydrogen (serpentinisation); eight cobblestone and a Vent Biofilm make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.acceleration_c: A copper RF cavity ringing at its resonant frequency. Its field points forward each time a bunch arrives, so particles gain energy on every pass.
block.theoreticalsciences.accretion_casi: Casing built to sit beside an accretion disk, where infalling gas heats to millions of degrees and shines in X-rays before it crosses the horizon.
block.theoreticalsciences.accretion_disk: Found: in the Accretion Frontier (Accretion Rim).

Gas spiralling into a black hole, heated by friction to millions of kelvin. On the way down it can turn tens of percent of its rest mass into light. Found in lakes in the Accretion Frontier's Accretion Rim. Made in the Accretion Disk Reactor.
Feeds matter onto a captive black hole: falling in, it gives up to a third of its rest energy as light. Too much at once, and its own light blows the disk away. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.accretion_frag: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Accretion Disk Fragment when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.aerosol_spraye: Breaks liquid into droplets fine enough to hang in the air for days. The same kind of haze turns Titan orange and hides its surface from view.
block.theoreticalsciences.air_separation: Air compressed, cooled until it liquefies, and boiled apart: nitrogen off the top, oxygen from the bottom.
block.theoreticalsciences.aleph_glass.lo: Glass whose clarity has a cardinality. It holds countably many points of light in a perfectly ordered grid, yet every sliver of it still contains as many points as the whole.
block.theoreticalsciences.alkahest.lore: The universal solvent the alchemists searched for, at last: it dissolves anything, and holds the whole of Chemistry in one fluid. Made in the Alkahest Still. One of the five fluids of Pleroma.
block.theoreticalsciences.alkahest_still: A tall glass still with a reflux column, for the one distillation the alchemists never finished. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.alt_az_mount.l: A mount that turns a dish on two simple axes, altitude and azimuth, while a computer works out how to follow the sky. Nearly every large modern telescope sits on one.
block.theoreticalsciences.amber_ore.lore: Found in the Overworld, between Y 24 and 96. Gives Raw Amber when mined with stone pickaxe or better. A coal-dark shale shot with drops of fossil resin that still catch the light.
block.theoreticalsciences.ammonia.lore: NH₃: nitrogen made useful. Fertiliser for half the world's food, and the start of nitric acid.
block.theoreticalsciences.ammonia_buffer: Ammonia and ammonium sulfate, holding steady at pH 9: alkaline, and stubborn about it.
block.theoreticalsciences.ammonia_conver: A bed of iron catalyst through which the synthesis gas passes, a little more of it ammonia each time.
A glass cell of warm, oxygenated fluid, a scaffold of plant fibre floating in it for the tissue to grow on. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.analog_black_h: A condensate flowing faster than its own speed of sound: a horizon that sound cannot cross back over, and, at it, Hawking radiation of phonons. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.analytic_conti: Calculus in a box: limits, derivatives, integrals, series and the analytic continuation of functions into the complex plane. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.ancient_dna_la: A clean room behind leaded glass, under positive pressure: bleach, drill, extract, amplify, read. Anything modern that gets in is read too. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.anima_mundi.lo: The soul of the world: water, lava, the Overworld's deep brine and magma, and the Essence of every other mod installed, distilled into one fluid. Made in the Essence Distillery. One of the five fluids of Pleroma.
block.theoreticalsciences.annihilation_r: Converts mass entirely into energy, E = mc^2, regulated by dilithium crystals. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_contai: A quarantine cell of chronoplastic walls, causal shielding and windows of containment glass, with dimensional stabilisers at every corner. It lets what it holds grow, just slower than its field can clear it. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_resolu: A tower of reality-lattice casing around a column of lensed, error-corrected fields. It doses an anomaly fraction by fraction until not one of its cells is left, and writes what it learned back into the laws. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.answer_pedesta: A plinth that waits for a conclusion. When the right answer is placed on it, the surrounding proof settles into consistency and the room grows quiet. A wrong answer sits there and does nothing at all.
block.theoreticalsciences.antibody_bench: A sterile hood over a rack of vials and a cold store: a trace of an invader is grown, made harmless and measured into doses.
block.theoreticalsciences.anticarbon_ore: Found in the Antiverse, between Y -60 and 20. Gives Anticarbon Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antigold_ore.l: Found in the Antiverse, between Y -48 and 60. Gives Raw Anti-Gold when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen.l: A positron bound to an antiproton. CERN first made a few atoms of it in 1995; it can only be held in magnetic traps, since touching any wall annihilates it. Made in the Antiproton Decelerator and the Electrolytic Cell.
block.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen_i: Found in the Antiverse, between Y 20 and 160. Gives Antihydrogen Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiiron_ore.l: Found in the Antiverse, between Y -48 and 120. Gives Raw Anti-Iron when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antimatter_pen: Pair-produces antimatter from gamma photons and holds it in a magnetic bottle. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiproton_dec: A ring that catches antiprotons from collisions at nearly light speed and brakes them, lap after lap, until they can be trapped. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.antisilicon_or: Found in the Antiverse, between Y -20 and 100. Gives Antisilicon Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antisoil.lore: Soil of the Antiverse, made of antiprotons, antineutrons and positrons.
block.theoreticalsciences.antistone.lore: Stone made of antimatter, the mirror image of ordinary rock. It looks exactly the same; only meeting matter would tell the difference, and then not for long.
block.theoreticalsciences.antistone_bric: Antistone dressed into bricks. Among antimatter it is as sound as any masonry; a single ordinary atom touching it would annihilate with it.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiverse_cach: A locker for matter of the wrong sign. It holds its contents by fields alone, since a single touch of the walls would annihilate both.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiwater.lore: Water with every proton, neutron and electron swapped for its antiparticle. It would boil, freeze and flow just like water, as long as nothing ordinary touched it. Found in the Antiverse's seas. Made in the Mirror Matter Foundry.
block.theoreticalsciences.aquifer_pump.l: Draws water from the rock it stands on, and, in the Planetary Interior, brine and hotter things.
block.theoreticalsciences.arbor_heartwoo: The innermost wood of the Arbor, dense and pale, with rings that record not years but the branching of possibilities. Run a finger along the grain and it follows a different branch each time.
block.theoreticalsciences.arbor_planks.l: Planks cut from the Arbor, pale and fine-grained, with faint branching lines running along their length. The wood smells of rain and seems to grow warmer when people walk across it.
block.theoreticalsciences.arbor_planks_s: A slab of Arbor Planks, for building with.
Stairs of Arbor Planks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.armature_breec: The loading end of a railgun, where the conducting armature sits across the rails. A megaamp pulse closes the circuit and the Lorentz force flings it down the bore.
Found: in the Accretion Frontier (Asteroid Belt).
The rubble of planetesimals that never became planets. Its chondrules are frozen droplets from the Solar System's first few million years.
block.theoreticalsciences.asymmetric_rea: A cold, stirred vessel where a handed catalyst makes one mirror image of a molecule and not the other. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.atomic_clock.l: Counts the oscillations of a caesium atom. The deeper it stands in a gravity well, the slower it ticks. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.autocatalytic_: A soup of molecules that catalyse their own making: each copy speeds the making of the next, so the broth grows faster the more of it there is. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
block.theoreticalsciences.autoclave.lore: A thick steel drum that fills with steam under pressure, hotter than boiling, until nothing alive is left inside. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.autonomous_ext: An Extreme Assembly Table that crafts on its own: give it a pattern, feed it, power it.
block.theoreticalsciences.auxin.lore: Indole-3-acetic acid in solution: the hormone that tells a shoot which way the light is and a root which way is down. Made in the Phytotron.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_distille: Boils reality down past its source code to the axioms underneath, and condenses them into fragments. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_lamp.lor: A lamp that shines when its axiom is in force. Its light is steady and colourless, and when the axiom is withdrawn it simply goes dark. Rows of them read like a truth table drawn in light.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_stone.lo: Pale, smooth stone that seems to be made of definitions. Each block holds its shape because it has been told to. It is cool and faintly humming, like a theorem being proved.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_toggle.l: A switch that adopts or rejects an axiom. Flip it and the local truths rearrange; some things become provable, others not.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiomatic_brea: Breaks every law of physics and mathematics at once. While it runs, step into its heart to fall out of reality. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiomatic_fiel: A field emitter that projects not forces but rules; a small region where a chosen axiom holds or does not.
block.theoreticalsciences.balance_tinctu: The first stage of Alkahest: everything Chemistry knows about how fast and how far a reaction goes, in one solution. Made in the Alkahest Still.
Found: in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns, Magma Chambers); dropped by the Magma Crawler (the Planetary Interior (Magma Chambers)).
Lava that cooled slowly and shrank as it set, cracking into columns, most often six-sided, as at the Giant's Causeway.
block.theoreticalsciences.basaltic_magma: Molten rock low in silica, at around 1,200 °C. Runny for a magma, it pours out in fast rivers of lava rather than exploding, as on Hawaii. Found in the magma seas of the Planetary Interior. Made in the Deep Drilling Rig.
block.theoreticalsciences.bayesian_analy: Weighs a prior against a piece of evidence and writes down the updated belief. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.bec_trap.lore: A magnetic bottle for atoms cooled to billionths of a degree, where thousands of them fall into one quantum state and move as a single wave.
block.theoreticalsciences.bending_magnet: A dipole magnet that curves a beam of charged particles along an arc. The faster the beam or the tighter the turn, the stronger the field it needs.
block.theoreticalsciences.bioluminescent: A membrane full of luciferase, glowing as a firefly does: light made by a living thing. Found in the landmarks of Inner Space. In the Photobioreactor its light grows algae; four Cell Membranes and glowstone dust (or an Eel Photophore) make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.bioreactor.lor: A sterile, stirred, temperature-held vat where cells grow and do the chemistry for you. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.biosafety_pane: A sealed wall panel for a high-containment lab, easy to scrub and with nothing for a microbe to hide in. Found in the BSL-4 Field Stations of the Overworld. The Autoclave makes Sterile Packs with it; iron and quartz make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.bitter_plate_s: Perforated copper discs stacked in a helix, as Francis Bitter designed in the 1930s. Water rushes through the holes to carry off the heat of tens of kiloamps.
block.theoreticalsciences.black_smoker.l: The mouth of a hydrothermal vent: water at 400 C pours out of it, black with metal sulfides that crystallise the moment it meets the cold sea. Its plume lifts and scalds whoever swims into it, and the grazers and crabs gather round. Found on the chimneys of the vent fields in Titan's hidden ocean and the Hadal Trench. The Chemical Reactor draws acid from it; four chimney blocks and a magma block make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.blood_plasma.l: Blood with the cells taken out: water, salts, sugar and a host of proteins, the antibodies among them. It carries everything a body sends anywhere. Found in the seas and channels of Inner Space's Bloodstream; the Lake Pump draws it, without end.
block.theoreticalsciences.bomb_calorimet: A sample burnt in pure oxygen inside a steel bomb, under a bucket of water: how far the water warms is how much heat it gave. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.bone_matrix.lo: Calcium phosphate laid down on collagen: a body's stone. Found at the bottom of Inner Space. The Chemical Reactor grinds it into bone meal; matrix and bone meal make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.bose_einstein_: Thousands of atoms behaving as one. Chilled to within a whisper of absolute zero, they share a single wavefunction and slide as a single wave, rippling with interference fringes. It looks like a faint mist that refuses to scatter. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
Cools atoms to nanokelvin until they share a single quantum state. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.breached_anoma: Ruins of a machine that pulled creatures out of nothing. Built anew at the Convergence Altar, it grows any creature whose genome it is shown.
block.theoreticalsciences.breeding_bench: Rows of trial plots and a ledger: grow a population, keep the best, sow their seed. Each run is a generation of selection. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.bridgmanite_or: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 4 and 70. Gives Bridgmanite when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.brine_evaporat: Shallow pans of brine, warmed until the water goes and the salts come out, one after another. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.brinicle.lore: A tube of ice growing down from the sea ice: brine squeezed out of freezing water is colder and saltier than the sea, sinks, and freezes the water round it as it goes. Found hanging from the ice of Titan's hidden ocean, and growing longer by itself. The Chemical Reactor melts it to concentrated brine.
block.theoreticalsciences.brown_dwarf_or: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Brown Dwarf Core when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.brownian_micro: A microscope over a drop of water with clay in it. The grains never stop jittering, molecules strike them from every side, and how far they wander weighs the molecules. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.brownian_suspe: Fine clay held in water and never at rest: each grain is kicked about by molecules too small to see, and wanders without ever settling on a path. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
block.theoreticalsciences.bubble_pedesta: The cradle on which a warp bubble is shaped. In Alcubierre's metric space contracts ahead and expands behind, while the bubble's own interior stays flat and calm.
block.theoreticalsciences.bubble_univers: A sphere of an entirely separate universe, nucleated out of the inflating vacuum and sealed off from ours. Inside it, the constants are slightly different.
block.theoreticalsciences.buffer_tank.lo: A weak acid and its salt, mixed to a ratio: the pH it holds is set by that ratio, and it will not budge. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_cache.lor: Bigger on the inside: it borrows a little room from a fifth dimension. In brane cosmology our whole universe floats in such a bulk.
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_crystal.l: A translucent crystal from the Bulk whose facets seem to point in directions I cannot quite name.
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_stone.fou: Found: in the Bulk (Moduli Wastes, Graviton Reef).
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_stone.lor: The bedrock of the higher-dimensional Bulk: a grey stone that seems to have more surfaces than it shows. Edges blur where the extra dimensions curl back in.
block.theoreticalsciences.burst_casing.l: The shell of an observatory that waits for bursts lasting milliseconds that never repeat. It is built to sit very still for a very long time.
block.theoreticalsciences.burst_observat: Twelve scintillators facing every way at once, waiting for the brightest explosions in the Universe.
block.theoreticalsciences.bussard_ramsco: A magnetic funnel that sweeps ionised gas out of the nebula streaming past. Only works high in the Accretion Frontier, in the Jet Stream (Y 200 or more). Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.calorimeter_de: An array of scintillator crystals and pixel trackers that records where a particle went and how much energy it carried. A quantum processor reads the flashes. The crystals glow faintly when hit.
block.theoreticalsciences.cantor_diagona: Lists every number, then builds one that is on no list. Manufactures infinities, and then bigger ones. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.capacitor_bank: Rows of capacitors charged slowly and emptied all at once: energy gathered over seconds, released in microseconds as a single heavy pulse.
block.theoreticalsciences.carbon_monoxid: Colourless, odourless and deadly; with hydrogen, the start of every synthetic fuel.
block.theoreticalsciences.carborane_supe: The strongest acid that can be bottled. It protonates almost anything yet is gentle on glass, because its conjugate base is so stable it does not attack. It is clear and calm in the flask. It is one of the few acids that is strong and polite at the same time. Made in the Electrolytic Cell.
block.theoreticalsciences.cardinal_ore.l: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 1280 and 1536. Gives Cardinal Shard when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.cascade_casing: Shielded housing for a centrifuge cascade. Each stage enriches uranium only slightly, so stages are piped in series by the dozen and machines run by the thousand.
block.theoreticalsciences.casimir_energy: An energy store built around the force between two plates in a vacuum.
Presses matter between plates so close the vacuum itself pushes back. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.catalyst_formu: Metal salt soaked into a porous support, dried, and calcined in a furnace: a catalyst made to a recipe, at the top of its volcano.
block.theoreticalsciences.causal_shieldi: A plate of chronosteel and causal shield lattice that keeps cause and effect in the right order on either side. It feels slightly ahead of the moment, as though it knew I was going to touch it.
Solder that joins things across time. Tachyon crystal lets it flow backwards, chronon capacitors keep the loop stable, and components soldered with it are connected before they are made. It feels slightly older than it is. Made in the Chronon Field Inverter.
block.theoreticalsciences.causality_loop: Sends objects back along a closed timelike curve so they exist twice. The universe is not amused. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
A wall two molecules thick, oily inside and wet outside, that keeps a cell itself. Found on the surface of Inner Space's Tissue and the beds of its Bloodstream. The Patch-Clamp Rig peels Lipid Bilayers from it; matrix and a bilayer make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.central_soleno: The tall coil at a tokamak's core. Ramping its current induces the plasma current, so the plasma itself is the secondary winding of a giant transformer.
block.theoreticalsciences.centrifuge_rot: A thin-walled cylinder spun so fast its rim outruns sound. Heavier molecules crowd towards the wall and lighter ones drift to the axis.
block.theoreticalsciences.chamber_casing: The shell of a chamber where time runs at another rate. Even on Earth, a clock a kilometre higher gains about one part in 10¹³.
block.theoreticalsciences.chance_tiles.l: Tiles laid in no repeating order, each pattern drawn at random. Any stretch that looks designed is a coincidence the dice were always going to throw.
block.theoreticalsciences.chelation_colu: A column of grabbing molecules: metal ions caught as the water runs through, the most tightly held first.
block.theoreticalsciences.chemical_react: A pressure vessel with a catalyst bed, a heater and a stirrer. Most of chemistry is getting the right molecules to meet at the right energy. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_bric: Cherenkov quartz cut into small bricks, each one glowing softly blue along its edges. A wall of them looks like a shallow pool at night. They are smooth and slightly cool to the touch.
A slab of Cherenkov Bricks, for building with.
Stairs of Cherenkov Bricks, for building with.
A wall of Cherenkov Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_lamp: A lamp of Cherenkov quartz with glowstone at its heart, so the blue Cherenkov glow is amplified into a strong, clean light. It is the colour of a reactor pool, and as calming. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_pill: A column of Cherenkov quartz that glows along its length with an even blue. Placed at a doorway it reads like a beam of light holding up the lintel. It is cool and faintly humming.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_quar: Forty pieces of Cherenkov quartz fused into a single block that glows the soft blue of particles outrunning light in a medium.
block.theoreticalsciences.chirality_tinc: The third stage of Alkahest: handedness and time; molecules of one hand, reactions that keep a beat, and the chemistry of another world. Made in the Alkahest Still.
block.theoreticalsciences.chlorine.lore: A yellow-green gas, heavier than air and fiercely reactive. It bleaches, disinfects and makes half of all plastics.
block.theoreticalsciences.chondrite.foun: Found: in Meteorite Crater structures in the Overworld.
block.theoreticalsciences.chondrite.lore: A stony meteorite: rock that has not melted since the planets formed. Found in craters out in open country. Gives Chondrite Fragment when mined. Needs a stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.chromatin.lore: DNA wound round spools of protein, coiled and coiled again, two metres of it in every cell. Found on the surface of Inner Space's Nucleus. The Gene Sequencer reads genomes from it; matrix and a nucleotide make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.chromatography: The housing of a column oven, keeping every metre of column at one temperature.
A mixture carried down a long packed tube: each part sticks to the packing for its own time, so they come out one after another. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronal_accele: Time runs faster for everything in its field, and the universe sends the bill. Each borrowed tick must be paid for, in energy and in Chronon Gas.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronal_field_: A projector that stretches time in its field. A temporal knot sits in the emitter stack, so clocks inside run faster or slower depending on its setting.
block.theoreticalsciences.chrono_loom.lo: Weaves worldlines. Reverses the arrow of time, ties temporal knots and enforces self-consistency on time loops. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronon_field_: Inverts the local arrow of time to harvest chronons. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronon_gas.lo: A gas of time quanta, if time comes in quanta. It drifts against the direction of other gases, and clocks immersed in it tick unevenly. Breathing near it leaves me unsure how long I have been standing there. Made in the Fractionation Spire, the Chronon Field Inverter and the Chrono Loom.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronoplastic_: A casing laced with tachyon crystal and a chronon capacitor, so that time inside flows at a rate I can adjust.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronostatic_v: A Containment Cache whose field holds time still. Radioactive sources kept in it stop decaying, and go on from where they were when taken out.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_bl: Forty chronosteel ingots fused into one block around an empty set: a metal whose atoms keep slightly different time from their surroundings.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_co: A superconducting coil wrapped in chronosteel, so that current inside it runs on its own clock. The field it makes is steadier than any ordinary coil, as though the coil had more time to think.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_ha: A chronosteel panel painted with warning stripes, used to mark doorways, machine edges and anything I do not want to walk into. The stripes look very slightly out of step with each other.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_pi: A column of chronosteel, banded and fluted, that carries a load without complaint. It reflects light in a slightly delayed blur and gives a doorway the feel of an engine room.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_pl: Chronosteel rolled into plates and fixed to a block face. Its sheen is cool and slightly blurred, as if the surface had moved a moment before it was seen. It gives a wall a clean, mechanical look.
A slab of Chronosteel Plating, for building with.
Stairs of Chronosteel Plating, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_ve: A chronosteel grille that lets air pass between rooms. The slats are angled to keep light out and air moving, and a faint draught always seems to be flowing through it, even when the room is still.
block.theoreticalsciences.cipher_loom.lo: A loom whose warp is data and whose weft is parity: every thread checks its neighbours. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.circadian_incu: An incubator with a lamp on the day cycle, so its cultures keep the time the world keeps.
block.theoreticalsciences.climate_casing: Casing for a climate engine. Earth's climate balances about 340 W/m² of incoming sunlight against heat radiated back to space.
block.theoreticalsciences.climate_engine: Changes the air's carbon dioxide and aerosols, and with them how much heat the world keeps: enough to bring rain, clear the sky, or grow ice. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.cloaking_glass: A pane of metamaterial that bends light around itself, so the glass is nearly invisible from any angle. Only the edges betray it, as a faint distortion in the room.
block.theoreticalsciences.clonal_selecto: A rack of culture wells and a binding assay: each round, only the clones that hold on tightest are kept and grown.
block.theoreticalsciences.cloud_seeder_s: A stack that releases ice nuclei into supercooled cloud. Silver iodide, the usual agent, has a lattice so like ice that droplets freeze onto it and fall.
block.theoreticalsciences.cloud_siphon.l: A slow pump for the nebula: touching a cloud, it draws that cloud's gas, and the cloud never notices. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.cold_pack_solu: Ammonium nitrate dissolved in water, five degrees below freezing: the heat it took to dissolve came out of the water itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.cold_plate.lor: The chamber's chilled lid, cold as the top of the troposphere: rising air cools under it and rains out. Made by crafting.
Found in Inner Space, between Y 8 and 200. Gives Matrix Fibre when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.colloid_cell.l: A thin glass cell of fine grains in water. Unseen molecules jostle them endlessly; in 1908 Perrin watched that jitter and counted the atoms in a mole.
block.theoreticalsciences.column_detecto: Watches what comes off the end of the column and switches it to the right tank.
block.theoreticalsciences.compactificati: Rolls extra dimensions up small: Kaluza-Klein circles, Calabi-Yau and G₂ spaces, D-branes and finally M-theory itself. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_b: A block of matter arranged so that every atom is part of a computation. It is warm to the touch and very slightly noisy, as though it is always working.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_l: A computronium block lit from within by glowstone, its traces brightened into a steady, warm glow. It looks like a terminal screen turned into a lamp.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_p: A panel of computronium with fine glowing traces running across its face, like a circuit board that is thinking. It is warm and faintly busy to the touch.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_t: Computronium cut into tiles, each one lit by faint, shifting traces. A floor of them flickers softly, as if computing something about whoever walks across it.
A slab of Computronium Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Computronium Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.concentrated_b: What is left of a brine when the membrane has taken half its water: twice as salty, and quicker to dry.
block.theoreticalsciences.concentrator_m: A great curved array of mirrors that gathers light from a field of heliostats onto one focus. The Odeillo furnace reaches about 3,500 °C this way.
block.theoreticalsciences.concept_compre: Takes whole stacks of everything a field of science has produced and compresses them into a single singularity of pure concept. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.conceptual_cas: Housing for things that are not physical. Its plates are woven from transfinite structure and braced with formal proofs, so that what it contains is held by consistency rather than by strength.
block.theoreticalsciences.contact_proces: Sulfur dioxide and air over three beds of vanadium catalyst, cooled between them, and the sulfur trioxide absorbed into acid. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.contact_tower_: Acid-proof brick for a tower where sulfur dioxide meets its catalyst.
block.theoreticalsciences.containment_fi: Glass that is not really glass, but a field held between two panes with a shimmer of plasma in between.
block.theoreticalsciences.control_rod_dr: The mechanism that raises and lowers a reactor's boron rods. If power fails it simply lets go, and gravity drops the rods into the core.
block.theoreticalsciences.convection_wal: The chamber's insulated wall, smooth inside so the updraft climbs straight. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.convergence_al: A focus for the pedestals around it, which give up what they hold to a single point, as rays meet at the focus of a lens. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.convergence_en: Does in a box what the Convergence Altar does with pedestals and patience: every ritual but the Breached Anomaly Engine, fed by pipes like any machine. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.coordination_r: A metal ion and its ligands, stirred until the right number settle round it in the right way.
block.theoreticalsciences.core_iron.foun: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Geodynamo Core).
block.theoreticalsciences.core_iron.lore: The alloy of planetary cores and iron meteorites, roughly nine parts iron to one of nickel. Etched, it shows Widmanstätten patterns grown over millions of years.
block.theoreticalsciences.core_magnetite: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 1 and 48. Gives Magnetite when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.corrosion_proo: Nickel-plated plate over a steel frame: for machines that live in acid.
block.theoreticalsciences.corundum_cryst: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns).
Aluminium oxide crystallised in bulk, second only to diamond among common minerals for hardness. A trace of chromium makes it ruby; others, sapphire.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_neutron: Forty ingots of cosmic neutronium fused into a block denser than the inside of a neutron star. It casts a faint, cold shadow even in full light.
A coil of cosmic neutronium over spacetime alloy, cooled cryogenically and threaded with pentaquark shards. It runs hotter than anything below it and seems to pull faintly on the room.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_plating: Cosmic neutronium rolled into plating, dark as space with faint pinpricks of light. A wall of it looks like a window onto the night sky that happens to be load-bearing.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_ray_ore: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Cosmic Ray Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_tiles.l: Cosmic neutronium cut into dark tiles that seem to have tiny points of light deep inside them, like stars seen through a deep well. The floor they make feels impossibly solid.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_tiles_s: A slab of Cosmic Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Cosmic Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmogenic_cas: A casing built to contain the birth of a universe: spin foam lattice and multiverse shards folded around a rift frame casing.
block.theoreticalsciences.cracker_casing: Alloy steel round a furnace where oil spends half a second at eight hundred degrees.
A tube coil in the radiant zone, where the long chains break.
block.theoreticalsciences.cracking_tower: Long carbon chains heated for half a second and quenched: they break into short ones, ethylene above all. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.crude_oil.lore: Coal hydrogenated under pressure into an oil (the Bergius process): a crude made in a factory instead of a reservoir.
block.theoreticalsciences.crustal_rock.f: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns).
block.theoreticalsciences.crustal_rock.l: Silicate rock of a planet's crust, the thin cool skin over the mantle: on Earth about 7 km thick beneath the oceans and 35 km under the continents.
block.theoreticalsciences.cryogenic_cool: A jacket of containment field glass around a cryocooler, built to keep superconducting parts close to absolute zero. Frost forms on its outer face within seconds.
block.theoreticalsciences.cryolava.lore: Ammonia and water, melted together far below Titan's surface and pushed up through cryovolcanoes. It flows like a cold glacier, and freezes whatever it touches. Found in the lakes of the Sotra cryovolcanic field.
Found: in Titan (Sotra Cryovolcanic Field); dropped by the Cryolava Slug (Titan (Sotra Cryovolcanic Field, Xanadu Uplands, Shangri-La Dunes ...)).
Cryolava frozen solid: ammonia-water ice, pale and glassy. Found in Titan's Sotra cryovolcanic field.
block.theoreticalsciences.crystal_growth: A seed is dipped into the melt and drawn slowly up, turning: the melt freezes onto it as one single crystal, and the impurities stay behind. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.crystal_interf: A rigid, damped cradle for an interferometer cut from one perfect silicon crystal. A neutron splits inside it, and a shake of an atom's width spoils the fringes.
block.theoreticalsciences.cyclotron.lore: Protons spiralling outward between two copper dees, kicked across the gap twice a turn by a radio-frequency voltage that must keep exact step with them.
One of a cyclotron's two hollow D-shaped electrodes. The RF voltage across the gap between them kicks each particle every half turn, so it spirals outward ever faster.
block.theoreticalsciences.cyclotron_yoke: The iron return path of a cyclotron magnet. It carries the flux back from pole to pole, so the field across the gap stays strong and even.
block.theoreticalsciences.dark_energy.lo: The energy of empty space itself. It pushes galaxies apart, accelerating the expansion of the universe. Bottled, it fills its flask completely, and the flask seems slightly larger inside than out. It is the largest share of everything, and the least understood. Made in the Eye of the Event Horizon and the Dark Energy Siphon.
block.theoreticalsciences.dark_energy_si: Taps the energy of empty space that drives the expansion of the universe. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
What is left in the Dark Era, after the last black hole has evaporated: a thin gas of photons, neutrinos and stray leptons, cooling forever. Made in the Entropy Horizon.
block.theoreticalsciences.dark_matter.lo: Matter that feels gravity but ignores light. Bottled, it looks like nothing at all; the flask is merely heavier than it should be. Galaxies are wrapped in halos of this, holding them together like an invisible net. Made in the Fractionation Spire, the Quark-Gluon Collider and the Dark Matter Halo Collector.
block.theoreticalsciences.dark_matter_co: Gravitationally focuses the invisible halo surrounding every galaxy. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.dating_spectro: An accelerator mass spectrometer: it counts single atoms of a radioactive parent and its daughter, one by one, and reads the age between them. Made by crafting.
A sealed, shielded vessel where short-lived isotopes live out their half-lives. Radon in its tanks decays on a real clock, a day in a minute, into lead. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.decontaminatio: Melts radioactive waste into glass, and takes the uranium back out of spent fuel. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.decorative_tel: A small reflecting telescope on its stand, still pointed at whatever its last observer wanted to see.
block.theoreticalsciences.deep_brine.fou: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns).
block.theoreticalsciences.deep_brine.lor: Ancient salt water from deep rock, many times saltier than the sea and often rich in lithium and boron. It has not seen daylight for millions of years. Found in brine pools deep in the Planetary Interior. Made in the Deep Drilling Rig and the Aquifer Pump.
block.theoreticalsciences.deep_drilling_: A derrick and a string of drill pipe kilometres long. The deeper the bit, the hotter the rock, the higher the pressure in it, and the older and stranger the core it brings up. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.deepslate_cher: Found in the Overworld, between Y -64 and 0. Gives Cherenkov Quartz when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.deepslate_pitc: Found in the Overworld, between Y -64 and 0. Gives Raw Pitchblende when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.degenerate_mat: Found in the End, between Y 10 and 80. Gives Degenerate Matter Chunk when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dense_mass_cor: A mass packed so tightly that time itself runs slow around it. Clocks set nearby lose seconds to the rest of the world, and never get them back.
block.theoreticalsciences.dense_stone.lo: Between any two grains of it there is another: a stone with no gaps, and no smallest piece. Found in the Continuum (the Platonic Realm, Y 880 to 1040). The Analytic Continuator draws Transcendental Crystals out of it, and makes more from cobblestone and Epsilon Dust.
The tall frame over a well that carries the crown block and the whole string of pipe. The word comes from Derrick, a seventeenth-century Tyburn hangman.
block.theoreticalsciences.deuterium.lore: Hydrogen with a neutron in its nucleus, about one atom in 6,400 in seawater. It fuses with tritium more readily than any other pair of nuclei. Made in the Electrolytic Cell and the Mass Spectrometer.
block.theoreticalsciences.dilaton_ore.lo: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Dilaton Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dilithium_bloc: Dilithium crystals fused into one solid block that rings when struck and glows a soft violet. The resonance carries through the floor, and anything metal nearby picks up a faint hum.
block.theoreticalsciences.dilithium_lamp: A dilithium block with glowstone at its centre, so the violet crystal shines with a soft, even light. It hums a single note when lit.
Found in the Nether, between Y 10 and 110. Gives Dilithium Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_li: A lift that pushes along an extra dimension. With a tesseract core set inside the emitter stack, it can nudge anything in its field slightly outside ordinary space, where weight no longer applies.
block.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_re: The leftovers of hyperdimensional work. It is a murky, shifting fluid that contains traces of everything that passed through four dimensions. It is warm and faintly luminous, and it separates into useful fractions if distilled. Made in the Stellar Plasma Crucible, the Universe Forge and the Reality Compiler.
block.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_st: A stabiliser that holds the number of dimensions in a region fixed while machines nearby try to change it. A dimensional stabiliser matrix sets the count, and a field emitter enforces it.
block.theoreticalsciences.dipole_bending: A superconducting dipole magnet on a neutronium frame that bends a charged particle beam into a circle. Its field is perfectly uniform across the gap. Metal tools drift toward it. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.dish_truss.lor: The steel frame behind a radio dish. It must hold the surface true to a fraction of a wavelength while the whole dish tilts and sags under its own weight.
block.theoreticalsciences.disk_confineme: A ring of magnets that shapes the field around an accretion disk. In real disks, tangled fields drive the turbulence that lets gas shed its spin and fall inward.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_black_: A real one, very small, held on a pedestal. It bends the light behind it. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_dyson_: A star wrapped in a swarm of collectors. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_galaxy: Two hundred billion stars, more or less, in two spiral arms. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_penter: The shadow of a five-dimensional cube. It has 32 corners and 80 edges. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_pocket: A whole universe, still expanding, in a jar. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_pulsar: A neutron star spinning hundreds of times a second, sweeping its beams across the room. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_quasar: A feeding black hole outshining its host galaxy. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_tesser: A four-dimensional cube turning through itself. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_white_: Nothing can enter it. Light pours out forever. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_wormho: The other mouth is somewhere else. Do not put your hand in. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.distillate_of_: Every force and particle of the mod in one fluid, from quark-gluon plasma to liquid antihelium. The first half of Quintessence. Made in the Universe Forge.
Time, spacetime and the cosmos in one fluid, from chronons and tachyons to the haze of the dark era. The second half of Quintessence. Made in the Universe Forge.
block.theoreticalsciences.distillate_tra: A tray in the quench tower: each product condenses at its own height.
block.theoreticalsciences.doping_furnace: A furnace where a dopant soaks into a wafer, a few atoms in a million, and makes it a semiconductor. Made by crafting.
Moves a gamma source at speeds of a fraction of a micrometre per second, so its Doppler shift can cancel the tiny shift that gravity puts on its light.
block.theoreticalsciences.dosing_pump.lo: A syringe driver that meters a substance in steadily, holding its level between too little and too much. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.drill_string.l: Lengths of steel pipe screwed end to end that turn the bit and carry mud down to it. Kilometres of it wind up like a spring before the bit begins to turn.
block.theoreticalsciences.dust_cloud.lor: A cloud of dust grains, too thin to stand on. Now and then, broken, it leaves Interstellar Dust.
block.theoreticalsciences.dust_ice_ore.l: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Interstellar Dust when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dyson_array.lo: Surrounds a captive star with a swarm, and eventually a sphere, of collectors. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.ecosphere.lore: A sealed glass sphere of soil, water, plants and creatures, lit and warmed, a whole living world kept in balance. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.einstein_ring_: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Einstein Ring Lens when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.einstein_rosen: Found: in the White Hole Interior, the Black Hole Interior.
A wormhole made solid: one mouth here, the other somewhere far away, joined by a throat through curved spacetime. Peering into it, I see the far side foreshortened and tinted.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_cache.l: Thrown out of a white hole with everything else. A white hole is a black hole run backwards: nothing can enter, so this has never been opened from outside.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_ore.lor: Found in the White Hole Interior, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Primordial Ejecta when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_rock.fo: Found: in the White Hole Interior.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_rock.lo: Stone thrown outward from somewhere nothing should leave. Its grains are shocked and blistered, as if fired out of a white hole, and the strata run backwards: newest at the bottom, oldest on top.
block.theoreticalsciences.electrolytic_c: Two electrodes in a conducting liquid: drive a current through it and it comes apart into what it was made of.
block.theoreticalsciences.electroplating: A bath of metal salt and a current through it: the metal leaves the solution and coats whatever hangs from the cathode.
block.theoreticalsciences.entangled_link: Half of a store of entangled photon pairs, sitting on a block's face. Links tuned to one channel share it: senders pull items, fluids and energy out of what they sit on, receivers push them in, at any distance, even into another dimension. 16 items, 4,000 mB and 262,144 FE a tick. Sneak-use to switch between sending and receiving; an Entanglement Tuner sets the channel. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.entangled_rela: Two halves of a quantum pair, each locked inside a small housing. Whatever happens to one is correlated with the other, however far apart they sit. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.entangled_tran: Sends to (or receives from) every other transceiver on the same channel, at any distance. Sneak-use to switch between sending and receiving; an Entanglement Tuner sets the channel.
block.theoreticalsciences.entanglement_n: A junction that keeps entangled pairs until they are wanted. Their correlations are perfect, yet no message can ride on them: no-signalling sees to that.
block.theoreticalsciences.entropy_horizo: A ring of event-horizon casing that runs a universe forward to its end: stars burn out, protons decay, black holes evaporate, and the horizon glows at its own faint temperature over what is left. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.entropy_sink.l: A copper heat sink for computation. By Landauer's principle every bit erased gives off at least kT ln 2 of heat, and something has to carry it away.
block.theoreticalsciences.enzyme_assay_b: A rack of cuvettes and a spectrophotometer, for timing an enzyme at one substrate level after another. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.epsilon_ore.lo: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 876 and 1044. Gives Epsilon Dust when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
Shares the halves of entangled pairs between two distant mouths; weaving, if Maldacena and Susskind are right, a wormhole between them. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.eratosthenes_s: A brass drum of numbered holes: each prime in turn knocks out its multiples, and what falls through is prime. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.eschaton_found: A sphere of Pleroma glass on a waist of Omnipotence casing, ringed in Logos coil and watched by four towers. It packs as much as the laws allow into as little space as they allow, right up to the edge of becoming a black hole, and repeats what you once forged by hand. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.essence_distil: A tower of fractionation trays wound with chronosteel coils. Pour in every fluid one mod has and it boils them together, tray after tray, until what is left is a single fluid that stands for all of them: that mod's Essence. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.ethylene.lore: C₂H₄: the most made organic chemical in the world. Its double bond is what lets it chain into polyethylene.
block.theoreticalsciences.euclid_reliqua: A casket laid out in Euclid's proportions. The Elements rest on five postulates, and the fifth, on parallel lines, was doubted for two thousand years.
block.theoreticalsciences.euclidean_marb: White stone, flat on every face and square at every corner, as if each block had been laid out with compass and straightedge. Found in the Elements, the Platonic Realm's marble islands (Y 320 to 400). The Geometer's Table inlays it into Golden Ratio Glass, and lays out more from cobblestone and a Euclidean Shard.
Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 318 and 400. Gives Euclidean Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.eutectic_brine: Salt and ice together melt at minus twenty-one degrees; the coldest a mixture of the two can get, and the old way to make ice cream.
block.theoreticalsciences.evaporator_shi: Lead-lined housing for a radioactive evaporator. The water boils away cleanly; everything dangerous it carried stays behind, and stays concentrated.
block.theoreticalsciences.evaporite_crus: The bright, dry floor of a lake that has boiled away, crusted with what the methane had dissolved. Found in Titan's Ontario Lacus basin.
Found in Titan, between Y 30 and 200. Gives Organic Evaporite when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.event_horizon_: A casing with a dark metamaterial skin over spacetime casing and neutronium plate: whatever reaches it from inside does not come back out.
block.theoreticalsciences.evolution_engi: A biodome where generations of designed life live and die in seconds. Run it inside a fast chronal field and a million years pass in a minute. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.ex_nihilo_engi: Creation from nothing, made a machine. It does not convert energy; it simply has it.
block.theoreticalsciences.excavation_gri: Stakes and string laying a metre grid over a dig, so every find can be mapped where it lay. Found at Dig Sites in the Overworld; made by crafting.
A tall brick chimney. The hot gas inside is lighter than the air outside, so the taller the stack, the harder it draws.
Matter with negative energy density, the stuff wormholes and warp drives require. It pushes against gravity, bends light the wrong way, and sits in its flask like a pool of shadow that is somehow lighter than air. Made in the Fractionation Spire, the White Hole Emitter and the Eye of the Event Horizon.
Solder forged in stellar plasma. Exotic matter gives it negative energy density, quark-gluon plasma gives it strength, and it joins components that ordinary solder would vaporise. It flows like liquid starlight. Made in the Stellar Plasma Crucible.
block.theoreticalsciences.extracellular_: Found: in Inner Space (Tumour, Nucleus, Bloodstream ...).

The scaffolding cells are built on: a gel of sugar-proteins strung with collagen. Found everywhere in Inner Space, under its tissue. The Chemical Reactor draws Matrix Fibre out of it; eight cobblestone and a fibre make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.extreme_assemb: A crafting table with a 9x9 grid, for the recipes too large for any other. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.eye_of_the_hor: A captive black hole wrapped in anchors, lenses and stabilisers, used as a computer: it simulates entire stars, galaxies and universes, and keeps what falls out. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.false_vacuum.l: Space in a higher-energy state than it should be, metastable and fragile. Contained, it looks like perfectly clear liquid, but the energy it stores is the energy of an entire universe waiting to tunnel down. I handle it gently. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser, the Eye of the Event Horizon and the Multiverse Rift Stabilizer.
block.theoreticalsciences.feed_horn.lore: A flared metal waveguide at the focus of a dish. It funnels the faint reflected radio waves into the receiver and turns a deaf ear to whatever comes from the sides.
block.theoreticalsciences.femto_fabricat: Builds components smaller than a proton, and assembles them into processors. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.femtoscale_ass: A long line of robotic arms and fabrication heads for the most complex assemblies: high-tier processors and late-game machine controllers. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.fermenter.lore: A sealed vat of warm sugar water with a culture working in it, an airlock bubbling on top. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.ferrofluid.lor: Magnetic nanoparticles suspended in oil. Near a magnet it rises into spikes along the field lines; NASA developed it in the 1960s to steer rocket fuel in weightlessness. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
A compact emitter of neutronium plate, Cherenkov quartz and a quantum dot that projects a field shaped by the dot's quantum state. Change the state, change the field.
block.theoreticalsciences.fission_fragme: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 36 and 126. Gives Fission Fragment Mix when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.flow_straighte: A honeycomb that combs the swirl out of the air before it reaches the test section. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.foam_bubble.lo: A pocket of space sitting in a higher-energy vacuum than its surroundings, metastable and patient. Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256.
block.theoreticalsciences.foam_cache.lor: Held together by a bubble of stable vacuum. Spacetime at the Planck scale may seethe with fluctuations; inside, it has been made to keep still.
block.theoreticalsciences.foam_substrate: Found: in the Quantum Foam; dropped by the Planck Mite (the Quantum Foam).
Spongy, effervescent matter scooped from below the Planck length. Bubbles of spacetime swell and vanish inside it so fast the block seems to fizz without making a sound.
block.theoreticalsciences.focus_receiver: The target at a lens's focal point, where light gathered over a broad aperture converges onto one small spot. It has to survive what it receives.
block.theoreticalsciences.folding_chambe: A thermostatted cuvette in a spectrometer, watching a protein chain fold into its shape, or fail to. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.forged_omnipot: An Omnipotence Core forged anew. Unbreakable; only the Hand of the Demiurge can attune, wake or move it.
The second stage of Alkahest: what Chemistry knows of shape; bonds seen in spectra, chains, frameworks, crystals. Made in the Alkahest Still.
block.theoreticalsciences.fossil_ore.lor: Found in the Overworld, between Y 0 and 80. Gives Fossil Fragment when mined with stone pickaxe or better. Limestone laid down in an old sea, with bones turned to stone inside it.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractal_lattic: A block of the Platonic Realm's fractal lattice, for building with, and an ingredient of its machines. Made in the Analytic Continuator.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractal_ore.lo: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Fractal Dust when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractionation_: A casing of containment field glass and chronosteel over event horizon casing, made to separate fluids by mass and charge in a tall spire. Watching through the glass, the layers settle into neat bands.
A tall distillation spire that separates Dimensional Residue and Warm Helium into useful fractions. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractured_real: What a failing multiblock leaks: a higher-dimensional shadow that spreads from block to block like an infection.
block.theoreticalsciences.framework_asse: Metal nodes and organic struts left to crystallise from a hot solvent, then carefully dried. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.frontier_regol: Rock ground to dust by billions of years of micrometeorites. Assayed in bulk it gives back its interstellar dust and a little rare earth.
block.theoreticalsciences.frozen_light_o: Found in the Black Hole Interior, between Y 20 and 256. Gives Frozen Photon when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.fuel_cell.lore: Hydrogen on one side of a membrane, air on the other: the reaction that would burn them runs as a current instead.
block.theoreticalsciences.funnel_coil.lo: A superconducting ring wound with vortex filament. A row of them, shrinking towards the throat, squeezes the field lines, and the ions with them, into a funnel. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.galton_board.l: Twelve rows of pegs. Every piece bounces left or right at each, and where it lands sorts it: most near the middle, a few far out in the tails.
block.theoreticalsciences.garnet_crystal: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns).
A mass of garnet, the dodecahedral silicate that grows where rock is buried and heated. Its zoned layers record the pressures it passed through.
block.theoreticalsciences.gas_centrifuge: Rotors spinning faster than sound fling the heavier isotope outward. One stage enriches a little; a tower of them, a lot. Build it taller for more stages: each new layer on top is one more. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.gauze_pack.lor: Layers of platinum-rhodium gauze stretched across the converter, where ammonia meets the air.
block.theoreticalsciences.gene_circuit_l: A bench where promoters and genes are wired into circuits and read out by the glow of a reporter. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.gene_sequencer: Reads a genome letter by letter, and, run backwards, writes one. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.geode_shell.fo: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns, Mantle Convection Zone).
block.theoreticalsciences.geode_shell.lo: A hollow stone lined with crystals that grew inward, one layer at a time, from mineral-rich water seeping through the cavity over ages.
block.theoreticalsciences.geodesic_ore.l: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 556 and 722. Gives Geodesic Thread when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.geometers_tabl: A slate table with a compass and a straightedge and nothing else: everything Euclid built, built again.
block.theoreticalsciences.geothermal_pla: Boils water on basaltic magma and drives a turbine with the steam, leaving basalt and venting sulfur dioxide. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.gibberellin.lo: Gibberellic acid: wakes dormant seeds and stretches stems. First found in a rice fungus that made seedlings grow foolishly tall. Made in the Phytotron.
block.theoreticalsciences.golden_ratio_g: Found: dropped by Euclid's Automaton (the Platonic Realm); dropped by the Fractal Wyrm (the Platonic Realm).
Glass made with a transcendental crystal so that its proportions follow the golden ratio at every scale. Each pane is divided into smaller panes in the same ratio, forever.
block.theoreticalsciences.goniometer.lor: A precision turntable that sets sample and detector at exact angles. The detector swings twice as far as the crystal, keeping θ and 2θ in step.
block.theoreticalsciences.governor.lore: Two brass balls on a spinning shaft: run too fast and they swing out and close the throttle, too slow and they fall and open it. Set against a machine with a console, it holds the machine working, near its best, whatever it runs. Needs 32 FE a tick. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.graph_loom.lor: A loom strung with junctions instead of threads: each link it weaves is a route, and each spare one a second chance. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.graphite_moder: Pure graphite slows fission neutrons by collision with carbon nuclei, which seldom absorb them. Chicago Pile-1 was a stack of such blocks, in 1942.
block.theoreticalsciences.graviton_conde: Quantises gravity itself; gravitons, spin foam and the anchors of reality. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.graviton_field: A field emitter upgraded with a graviton crystal and a gravitic lens element, so it projects gravity as well as fields. It weighs more on one side than the other, and that side changes. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
Projects a field around a structure; what the field is decides what the machine inside can do. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.graviton_lens_: An array of gravitic lens elements that bend spacetime to focus gravitational waves, the way a glass lens bends light. Inside, the space seems to pinch toward the centre.
block.theoreticalsciences.grow_light.lor: Quantum-dot emitters tuned to the red and blue that chlorophyll absorbs; the green it reflects, it never wastes power on. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.grow_tray.lore: A shallow polymer tray of clay pebbles, the nutrient solution trickling through it past the roots. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.growth_furnace: The insulated shell of a crystal-growth furnace. Its job is calm: the steadier the heat around the melt, the fewer flaws freeze into the crystal.
block.theoreticalsciences.haber_bosch_re: Hydrogen and nitrogen pressed together over hot iron: the reaction that fixes the air's nitrogen into ammonia, and feeds half the world. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.harmonic_pedes: A pedestal tuned to resonance. What is set on it rings at whole-number multiples of one frequency, as the harmonics of a single string do.
block.theoreticalsciences.hawking_radiat: The faint glow of a black hole evaporating. Pairs of particles at the horizon are split, one falls in and the other escapes, carrying away a sliver of the black hole's mass. It is thermal, dim and cold, and in it the hole slowly dies. Made in the Kugelblitz Chamber, the Micro Black Hole Evaporator and the Penrose Ergosphere Generator.
A collector of Hawking absorber plates and entangled photons that catches the faint radiation evaporating black holes give off. It is warm, and the warmth comes from somewhere it should not.
block.theoreticalsciences.heat_pack_reac: A stirred, jacketed vessel for the reactions that give out or take in heat; run steady, with the outlet held at its temperature. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.heater_plate.l: A warm, wet floor: the chamber's sea surface, feeding the storm its heat and water. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.heavy_water.lo: Water whose hydrogen is deuterium. It is about 11% denser than ordinary water, freezes at 3.8 °C, and slows neutrons without swallowing them. Made in the Electrolytic Cell.
block.theoreticalsciences.heliostat.lore: A mirror that tracks the Sun on two axes. At Odeillo, sixty-three of them feed one parabolic concentrator whose focus passes 3,000 °C.
block.theoreticalsciences.helium3_detect: A tube of helium-3 gas. A slow neutron splits a nucleus into a proton and a triton with 764 keV between them, and the gas lights up with charge.
block.theoreticalsciences.hex_glass.lore: Glass rated for what the structure behind it holds back; light gets out, nothing else does.
block.theoreticalsciences.higgs_field_mo: Tunes the Higgs field locally to strip mass from matter, or make it negative. Made by crafting.
Brick moulded to the standards of Hilbert's programme: every face a rigorous statement, every joint a valid inference.
block.theoreticalsciences.hilbert_locker: Always full, and always room for one more. Move each item up one shelf, and the first shelf is free again, however many there are.
block.theoreticalsciences.holographic_en: Writes a volume of matter onto its own boundary surface, per the holographic principle. Made by crafting.
A locker whose lid is an event horizon held open. While it stays shut, what is inside lies beyond the causal reach of everything else.
block.theoreticalsciences.horizon_cage.l: A cage of fields for something with no surface to grip. A black hole cannot be touched, so it must be held by its charge alone.
block.theoreticalsciences.horizon_contai: Walls built to hold a region where escape velocity reaches light speed. Nothing leaves through a horizon; the walls are for what has not fallen in yet.
A pane cut from the boundary of no return. Light enters easily but seems reluctant to leave, so everything beyond looks slightly dimmed and stretched.
block.theoreticalsciences.hydrogen.lore: The lightest gas and the most common thing in the Universe. Here it comes from coal and steam: C + H₂O → CO + H₂.
block.theoreticalsciences.hydrogen_cloud: Ionised hydrogen glowing red at 656 nm, the H-alpha line. You can walk straight through it.
block.theoreticalsciences.hydrogen_cyani: A trace in the nebula and a poison on Earth, and, with ammonia, the first step to amino acids.
block.theoreticalsciences.hydroponic_fra: The tower's aluminium ribs and rings. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.hydroponic_tow: A glass tower of grow trays on a slowly turning carousel round a nutrient mast, lit by grow lights: crops without soil, stacked twenty high. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.hydrothermal_c: Found: in Titan's Hidden Ocean (Subsurface Ocean, Hydrothermal Vents) and the Hadal Trench (Hadal Vent Field, and lone chimneys out on the Hadal Abyss).

A stack of mineral built by hot water gushing from the sea floor, warm and glowing, and crusted with the bacteria everything here lives on. Found in the vent fields of Titan's hidden ocean and the Hadal Trench, where they stand thirty blocks tall. Roasted in oxygen it gives sulfur dioxide; silicate, iron and a photophore make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperbolic_sto: Stone from a surface that curves away from itself at every point, like a saddle: there is always more room than there should be. Found in Curved Space (the Platonic Realm, Y 560 to 720). The Topology Kiln folds it into Möbius Strips and fires more from cobblestone and Geodesic Thread.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperframe_cas: A casing laced with topological insulator and superposition crystal, so that its interior exists in several overlapping configurations at once.
block.theoreticalsciences.hypernova_plas: Plasma from the most violent explosions in the universe. Hypernovae release more energy than ordinary supernovae and leave behind black holes. The plasma is hotter and denser than any star's core, and it wants to escape. Made in the Transcendent Plasma Forge.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperreal_cach: Its walls obey whatever law is currently in force. The contents, like infinitesimals beside the real numbers, sit at a scale no ordinary rule can reach.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperspherical: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 1280 and 1536. Gives Hypersphere Fragment when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.hypervelocity_: A railgun: an armature shot down two rails at kilometres a second into a target, where the shock makes what only impacts can. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.ice_core_drill: A derrick over an insulated shed, its drill string spinning down into the ice to cut cores of ancient snow. Works in icy or snowy biomes. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.ice_drill_casi: An aerogel-lined shed wall: keeps the drillers warm and the cores cold. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.impact_breccia: Found: in Meteorite Crater structures in the Overworld.
Rock shattered and welded back together in the instant of an impact. It lines a meteorite crater's bowl and rim.
block.theoreticalsciences.impact_chamber: An armoured chamber for hypervelocity tests. Above about 3 km/s, a projectile carries more energy per kilogram than the same mass of TNT.
block.theoreticalsciences.induction_gene: A coil spun inside a permanent magnet's field by a small turbine. Stronger magnets give more power; flowing water beside it spins it faster. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.infall_rock.fo: Found: in the Black Hole Interior.
block.theoreticalsciences.infall_rock.lo: Rock stretched and compressed on its way toward a black hole. Its grains are elongated along one axis by tidal forces, and the light from it arrives reddened and slow.
block.theoreticalsciences.inflation_cham: A sphere of containment glass around a pocket of false vacuum, wound with coils and lensed by gravitons. The inflaton inside rolls down its potential slowly enough to inflate, and then it reheats, and a universe's worth of matter is made.
block.theoreticalsciences.inflaton_field: The field that drove cosmic inflation, stretching the universe exponentially in a fraction of a second. Bottled, it trembles with stored expansion, as if wanting to make everything around it larger. It is hot, restless and very light. Made in the Fractionation Spire, the Eye of the Event Horizon and the Multiverse Rift Stabilizer.
block.theoreticalsciences.infrared_spect: Infrared light through a sample: each bond swallows its own colour, and the gaps in the light name them.
block.theoreticalsciences.inner_core_bou: The floor of the Planetary Interior: the edge of the solid inner core, 5,150 km down.
block.theoreticalsciences.integrator.lor: A mechanical differential analyser: wheels and discs that add up a rate, step by step, into what it amounts to. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.interface_port: Takes the place of a structure's block to let items, fluids and energy in and out (or to link an ME network). Sneak-use with an empty hand to make it pull ingredients from, or push products into, the blocks beside it. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.interferometer: Splits a beam of light, sends the halves down two paths and brings them back together. A change in path of a fraction of a wavelength moves the fringes.
block.theoreticalsciences.interstellar_m: The thin gas between the stars, about one atom per cubic centimetre: a better vacuum than any made on Earth, yet the stuff new stars are born from. Made in the Interstellar Scoop.
block.theoreticalsciences.interstellar_s: Sweeps up the thin gas and dust between the stars. Only high above the world, or out in space. Made by crafting.
At the funnel's throat, a cold plate that neutralises the incoming ions and pipes off the gas they become. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.ionic_liquid.l: A salt that is liquid at room temperature. It conducts electricity, does not evaporate, and dissolves almost anything. It is clear, slightly viscous and faintly warm. Chemists call such salts designer solvents, because they can be tuned for almost any task. Made in the Electrolytic Cell.
block.theoreticalsciences.iridium_crucib: A crucible of iridium, which melts at 2,446 °C and shrugs off most molten oxides. Laser crystals such as YAG are pulled from melts held in one.
block.theoreticalsciences.iron_meteorite: Found: in Meteorite Crater structures in the Overworld.
The iron-nickel mass of a meteorite, half buried where it struck. Found in craters out in open country. Gives Meteoric Iron when mined. Needs a stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.irradiation_ch: Holds a target in the neutron flux of a source until nuclei catch neutrons and become something else.
block.theoreticalsciences.isomer_trigger: A gamma pulse knocks a hafnium-178m2 nucleus out of its long-lived state, and all its stored energy comes out at once. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.jet_collimator: A magnetic nozzle that pinches a plasma flow into a narrow beam, much as twisted field lines are thought to shape the jets of quasars and young stars.
block.theoreticalsciences.kaluza_klein_o: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Kaluza-Klein Shard when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.koch_crystal.l: A pane whose rim is a Koch snowflake: a finite area enclosed by an infinitely long border. The glass is clear, but its edge glitters endlessly as each tiny triangle catches light. Made in the Analytic Continuator.
block.theoreticalsciences.kugelblitz_cha: Focuses so much light into one point that it collapses into a black hole. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.lake_pump.lore: A float, a heated intake and a long hose: it draws from a Titan lake beside it, and the lake never notices. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.laminar_flow_c: A line of conduits carries fluid from the block behind its first segment to the block in front of its last. The flow is smooth, so the line passes up to 2,000 mB a tick when it is 16 segments or shorter; longer lines pass less, in proportion (Poiseuille). Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.laser_cutter.l: A focused beam that cuts copper, silicon and diamond to a micron. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.laser_interfer: Two long arms at right angles, a laser split between them, and mirrors that hang free. A passing gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other by a thousandth of a proton's width. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.lattice_growth: Grows flawless single-crystal boules atom by atom in a superfluid bath.
block.theoreticalsciences.launch_pad.lor: Concrete and steel over a flame trench, built to take a rocket's exhaust for the seconds before it rises. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.lead_bricks.lo: Bricks of lead shielding. Lead is dense and has many electrons, so it stops gamma rays well, about half of them every 1.3 cm, but it does little against neutrons.
block.theoreticalsciences.lead_hazard_pa: A lead panel striped for danger: decoration for shielded rooms, and it stops gamma rays like any lead.
block.theoreticalsciences.lead_shielding: Dense lead for stopping gamma rays. Each half-value layer halves the dose; for the gammas of cobalt-60 that is about 1.2 cm of lead.
block.theoreticalsciences.leaded_glass.l: Glass with lead oxide melted in, often over half by weight. Lead's dense electron clouds stop X-rays and gamma rays while visible light passes through.
block.theoreticalsciences.lens_array_blo: A grid of lenses working side by side, each forming its own small image of the scene. Together they see from many points at once.
block.theoreticalsciences.lens_grinder.l: A turning lap that wears glass into a curve with ever finer grit, then polishes it. Spinoza earned part of his living at one.
block.theoreticalsciences.lens_pylon.lor: A mast that holds mass where its curvature bends passing light. A gravitational lens has no single focal point: it brings light together along a line.
block.theoreticalsciences.lensing_concen: Lines a star up behind a mass and collects the light the mass bends together: an Einstein ring, made into power.
block.theoreticalsciences.life_support_p: Pulses broth and oxygen through the Revival Vat's lines, about a beat a second. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.liquid_antihel: Antihelium cooled to a liquid. Only a handful of antihelium nuclei have ever been detected in collider debris; a whole pool of it should not exist. Made in the Mirror Matter Foundry.
block.theoreticalsciences.liquid_hydroge: H₂ at 20 K, a fourteenth as dense as water: the best rocket fuel there is, and the hardest to keep. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
block.theoreticalsciences.liquid_methane: Found: in Titan (Xanadu Uplands, Selk Crater Field, Ontario Lacus Basin).
CH₄ at 94 K, with a little ethane and nitrogen dissolved in it: the stuff of Titan's seas, rivers and rain. Less than half as dense as water, and too thin to swim in. Found in Titan's seas and lakes.
O₂ at 90 K, pale blue and drawn to a magnet. Half of every rocket's propellant. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
Sodium melted at 98 °C. It carries heat far better than water and boils only at 883 °C, which is why fast reactors use it as coolant, though it burns in air. Made in the Electrolytic Cell.
block.theoreticalsciences.liquid_spaceti: Spacetime itself, flowing like a liquid. Distances inside it are fluid, and it ripples with gravitational waves when disturbed. It is cold and has no colour, only the distortion of what is behind it. Poured, it bends the light of the room around the stream. Made in the Eye of the Event Horizon.
block.theoreticalsciences.lithography_gl: Containment field glass doped with quantum dots so that light passing through it is shaped at nanometre resolution. It projects patterns far finer than its own grain.
block.theoreticalsciences.lithostatic_ca: A casing built to bear the load of rock. In Earth's crust, lithostatic pressure rises by about 27 MPa for every kilometre of depth.
block.theoreticalsciences.logos_coil_blo: A coil wound of Logos Thread, the word that puts things in order. Current through it does not so much make a field as insist on one.
block.theoreticalsciences.lymph_tissue.l: Packed lymphocytes and the mesh that holds them, where invaders are shown to the cells that will fight them. Found on the surface of Inner Space's Lymph Node. The Antibody Bench raises Memory Cells from it; matrix and a memory cell make more.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetar_crust: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Magnetar Crust Fragment when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetic_confi: A casing that holds plasma away from its own walls with superconducting magnetic fields, tuned by dilithium. It works on the same principle as a tokamak.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetite_bloc: Compacted Fe₃O₄, the most strongly magnetic mineral in nature. Lodestones, magnetite probably magnetised by lightning, made the first compasses.
