block.theoreticalsciences.magnetite_bric: Bricks of magnetite (Fe3O4), the most magnetic mineral in nature. Iron oxide is dense, so it also shields: it stops gamma rays about two thirds as well as lead, and neutrons three times better.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetized_pla: Plasma threaded by magnetic field lines. Its charged particles spiral along them and cannot cross, so a field can hold a gas hotter than the Sun's core. Made in the Tokamak.
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetizer.lor: A coil around an iron core that pulses a field through a magnet blank. Only a field stronger than the blank's coercivity sets it. Made by crafting.
A hole bored through bedrock by the Core Drill.
block.theoreticalsciences.markov_chain_r: Three vats in a ring, the feed hopping between them by tuned chances. Where it spends its time, the chain's steady state, decides what it becomes. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.markov_vat.lor: A vat whose contents change from one state to the next by chance alone. Where they go next depends only on where they are now, never on how they got there.
block.theoreticalsciences.mass_spectrome: Ions shot through a magnetic field: the heavy ones bend less. Set the field and only one mass reaches the detector. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.mathesis.lore: Leibniz dreamed of a mathesis universalis, a science of everything worked out as one calculation. Here it is: chance, shape and the infinite in a single fluid. Made in the Conceptual Singularity Compressor, with Euler's Identity as its catalyst. One of the five fluids of Pleroma.
block.theoreticalsciences.matrioshka_bra: Nested shells of computronium around a star. It thinks; you gain Insight. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.maxwell_boltzm: An ideal gas whose molecular speeds follow the Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution: most move near the typical speed, with a long thin tail of very fast ones. Made in the Markov Chain Refinery.
block.theoreticalsciences.maxwell_demon_: A molecular gatekeeper that sorts fast particles from slow ones, defying the second law of thermodynamics. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.metallic_hydro: Hydrogen compressed until it becomes a metal. At pressures found in the cores of gas giants, the electrons break free and conduct like copper. It flows silvery and heavy, and may be a room-temperature superconductor. Made in the Neutron Star Forge and the Eye of the Event Horizon.
block.theoreticalsciences.metamaterial_w: Lays down sub-wavelength lattices that bend light (and gravity) the wrong way. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.methane.lore: CH₄, the simplest hydrocarbon: the cloud's carbon, the Fuel Cell's fuel, and a Cracking Tower's feed.
block.theoreticalsciences.methanol.lore: Wood alcohol: made from carbon monoxide and hydrogen over copper, and a fuel and solvent in its own right.
block.theoreticalsciences.mhd_channel_ca: The duct of a magnetohydrodynamic generator. Hot conducting gas rushes through a magnetic field, and current is drawn straight off electrodes in its walls, with no turbine at all.
An electrode lining a magnetohydrodynamic channel. Conducting fluid swept through a magnetic field drives current straight into it, with no turbine at all.
block.theoreticalsciences.mhd_field_magn: The magnet across an MHD channel. Conducting fluid driven through its field makes current at right angles to both, and the output rises with the square of the field.
A conducting fluid driven through a magnetic field makes current with no moving parts: the flow itself is the armature. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.micro_black_ho: A black hole lighter than a mountain, held in a cage and fed as fast as it evaporates: it glows with Hawking radiation hotter than any star. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.microscope_col: The tube that holds a microscope's objective and eyepiece at a fixed distance apart. No light microscope resolves much finer than about 200 nm.
block.theoreticalsciences.mirror_culture: A sealed vat fed only mirror-handed nutrient, growing cells built the wrong way round.
block.theoreticalsciences.mirror_foundry: A stack of Penning traps: anti-ores are melted, refined and cast without ever touching a wall, and matter and antimatter are bound into one alloy. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.mod_essence.lo: Every fluid of one mod distilled together into a single liquid. It tastes, reportedly, of everything its authors ever put in a tank.
block.theoreticalsciences.moduli_ore.lor: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Moduli Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.mof_gas_storag: A tank packed with metal-organic framework: it holds 256,000 mB of one gas; sixteen times a tank. Right-click to read it.
block.theoreticalsciences.moissanite_cry: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Mantle Convection Zone).
Silicon carbide, found by Henri Moissan in a meteorite crater in 1893. Nearly as hard as diamond, it splits light into colours even more strongly.
block.theoreticalsciences.molecular_clou: Cold, dense gas where hydrogen pairs into molecules and dust shields them from starlight. At ten kelvin it collapses, slowly, into new stars. Made in the Electrolytic Cell, the Cloud Siphon and the Interstellar Scoop.
block.theoreticalsciences.molten_salt_fu: Uranium and plutonium dissolved in molten fluoride salt, fuel and coolant at once, flowing at low pressure. Oak Ridge ran a reactor on it from 1965 to 1969. Made in the Chelation Column and the Gas Centrifuge Cascade.
block.theoreticalsciences.molten_salt_re: Uranium dissolved in molten fluoride salt flows through a core of graphite and goes critical there. Tune it to exactly one neutron per neutron. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.monte_carlo_en: Halls of random-number cores that answer by throwing dice: sample enough and the error falls as one over the square root of the count. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.mossbauer_abso: Iron-57 bound so firmly in its crystal that it soaks up 14.4 keV gamma rays without recoil, a resonance sharp enough to feel one part in a thousand trillion.
block.theoreticalsciences.multiverse_rif: Holds open a tear into neighbouring universes and harvests what leaks through. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.mycelium_bed.l: A tray of damp substrate under a misting hood, threaded with white fungal threads that feel their way to food. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.nanite_assembl: A molecular foundry that builds machines atom by atom; including machines that build themselves. Made by crafting.
A suspension of microscopic machines in water. The slurry moves on its own, shifting patterns across its surface as the nanites communicate. It feels faintly gritty and warm. Left in a bucket overnight, it rearranges itself into neat geometric ridges by morning. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
block.theoreticalsciences.nebular_gas.lo: Cold, dusty gas from which stars are born. It is mostly hydrogen and helium, drifting in faint clouds that glow when lit by nearby stars. It is light and very cold. Given enough of it and enough time, gravity would gather it into a new sun. It is the raw material of every star. Made in the Dark Matter Halo Collector.
block.theoreticalsciences.nebular_ice.fo: Found: in the Accretion Frontier (Molecular Cloud Nebula).
block.theoreticalsciences.nebular_ice.lo: Water, carbon monoxide and ammonia frozen together on dust grains at about fifteen kelvin. Starlight slowly builds larger molecules within it.
block.theoreticalsciences.neural_synthes: Grows photonic neural networks and the artificial minds that run on them.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutrino_conde: Traps the ghost particles that pass through planets without noticing. Made by crafting.
A stream of ghost particles, trillions of which pass through me every second. They barely interact with anything, so the flux is invisible, weightless and almost impossible to stop. Only rarely does one leave a blue flash. Made in the Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector, the Neutrino Condenser and the Matter-Antimatter Annihilation Reactor.
A tube whose walls reflect slow neutrons at grazing angles, much as a glass fibre carries light. Guides lead beams tens of metres from a reactor to the instruments.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutron_interf: A neutron's wave split by a perfect silicon crystal and joined again. Tilt it, and gravity pulls one path more than the other: quantum mechanics and gravity in one measurement. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutron_star_f: Recreates the crushing interior of a collapsed star: neutronium, metallic hydrogen and quark matter. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_blo: A cube of compacted neutronium, matter in which electrons and protons have been crushed together into neutrons.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_bri: Neutronium Bricks: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
A slab of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.
Stairs of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.
A wall of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_pil: A pillar of Neutronium, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_pla: Neutronium rolled into flat plates and riveted onto a block face. It is grey, dense and almost reflective, with seams that look as though they were drawn with a ruler.
A slab of Neutronium Plating, for building with.
Stairs of Neutronium Plating, for building with.
A wall of Neutronium Plating, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_til: Neutronium Tiles: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
A slab of Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.nickel_sulfate: Emerald green: nickel dissolved from meteoric iron, ready to be laid back down where it is wanted.
block.theoreticalsciences.nitric_acid.lo: Fuming and yellow with dissolved nitrogen dioxide: it dissolves copper and silver, and passivates iron.
block.theoreticalsciences.nitrogen.lore: Four fifths of the air, and so unreactive that its triple bond took a century of chemistry, and the Haber-Bosch process, to break.
block.theoreticalsciences.nmr_casing.lor: The cryostat's outer wall: vacuum, then liquid nitrogen, then helium, then the magnet.
block.theoreticalsciences.nmr_magnet_coi: Kilometres of niobium-tin wire, superconducting at four kelvin: a field held steady to a part in a billion.
block.theoreticalsciences.nmr_probe.lore: The radio coil at the heart of the magnet, where the sample spins.
block.theoreticalsciences.nmr_spectromet: Nuclei spinning in a superconducting magnet, listened to with radio: the whole shape of a molecule, atom by atom. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.nucleosynthesi: Takes a star through its whole life, collapse, ignition, giant phase, death, and keeps the elements it forges. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.nucleotide_clu: Found in Inner Space, between Y 8 and 200. Gives Nucleotide when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
A heavy-ion accelerator firing into a spinning target: fuses nuclei into elements beyond the periodic table, aiming for the island of stability. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.nutrient_broth: A warm, rich medium for growing cells. Sugar provides energy, bone meal provides minerals, and a zeolite catalyst keeps the chemistry steady. It smells faintly sweet. Left uncovered for even a moment, it clouds with whatever life drifts into it. Made in the Bioreactor, the Fermenter and the Chemical Reactor.
The column at the tower's heart: it turns the trays and feeds them their solution through laminar conduits. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.observatory_ca: A locker held in stasis by superconducting coils. Whoever sealed it meant the contents to be found exactly as they were left.
block.theoreticalsciences.observatory_do: A rotating hemispherical roof with a shuttered slit, turned to keep pace with the telescope so it always looks out through the opening.
block.theoreticalsciences.observatory_wa: A wall of Observatory, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.observer_plate: A structural plate. Hold Shift to see which structures take it.
block.theoreticalsciences.oklo_rock.foun: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Natural Reactor), Oklo Reactor Ruin structures in the Planetary Interior (Natural Reactor).
block.theoreticalsciences.oklo_rock.lore: Host rock of the Natural Reactor, modelled on Oklo in Gabon, where two billion years ago groundwater slowed neutrons enough for uranium ore to run as a fission reactor for hundreds of thousands of years.
block.theoreticalsciences.oklo_uraninite: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 36 and 126. Gives Raw Pitchblende when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.oleum_absorber: Sulfur trioxide does not dissolve well in water; it is absorbed in strong acid, and diluted after.
block.theoreticalsciences.omega_simulato: Runs the whole confrontation with Alpha Omega again; inside a model of it. Shown one Proof of Everything as a template, it walks the argument once more and writes out another copy. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnilex_casing: The casing of the final machine: crystallised law and arbor heartwood bound over a transfinite casing. It looks like wood and glass and law at the same time.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnilex_engine: Simulates the World Tree and the Ocean of Primordial Law, and so controls them. Only works in Hyperdimensional Reality Space. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_ca: Material that refuses to be broken by anything made in the ordinary world: no vanilla tool touches it, only the mod's own (the tag theoreticalsciences:omnipotent_tools).
block.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_co: The Core of the Transcendental itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnium_block.l: A solid cube of the metal that is every metal at once. It weighs exactly what I expect it to weigh, whatever that is, and it rings with every resonant frequency simultaneously.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnium_energy_: The last word in storage. Omnium lines the walls, the Omega Point sits at its heart, and the energy inside no longer obeys the usual bookkeeping.
A rigid, flat rail on which lenses, slits and mirrors are clamped in line. Optics is mostly alignment, and this is where alignment is kept.
block.theoreticalsciences.optical_worksh: Grinding spindles, polishing laps and an interferometer: blanks become lenses, plates and gratings, true to a fraction of a wavelength. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.optimiser.lore: A marble bowl and a brass ball on a long arm: it rolls downhill a step at a time, and learns how long a step to take. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.orbital_transf: Plans the burns from the station to anywhere it can reach. Sneak and use it to choose a destination; use it to go. Only works in orbit. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_ore.lo: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 1280 and 1536. Gives Ordinal Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_recurs: Counts past infinity: takes a limit, adds one, and keeps going; omega, omega plus one, omega times two, omega squared, epsilon-naught... Made by crafting.
Stone laid down in well-ordered strata. Every layer has a next one, and every collection of layers has a first; even the infinite stacks have a successor waiting above them.
block.theoreticalsciences.oscillator_ves: A stirred dish fed with bromate and malonic acid, whose colour swings back and forth on its own beat. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.ostwald_casing: Refractory brick round a burner that runs white-hot for months.
block.theoreticalsciences.ostwald_conver: Ammonia and air through a glowing platinum gauze in a thousandth of a second, then into water: nitric acid. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.oxygen.lore: A fifth of the air, boiled off below nitrogen in an air separation column at minus 183 degrees.
block.theoreticalsciences.oxygen_cloud.l: Doubly ionised oxygen glowing green-blue at 501 nm. You can walk straight through it.
A metre of steel tube packed with coated beads. Each molecule sticks to them for its own time.
block.theoreticalsciences.page_curve_ana: Follows the entropy of a black hole's radiation as it evaporates, and finds the information coming back out. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.pair_source.lo: A laser through a nonlinear crystal. Now and then one photon splits into two whose polarisations are entangled: measure one and the other is already decided.
block.theoreticalsciences.panacea.lore: The cure for everything, named for the Greek goddess of remedies: every fluid of life, and the answer to the Anomaly, held together by the Tree of Life. Made in the Abiogenesis Crucible. One of the five fluids of Pleroma.
block.theoreticalsciences.particle_spect: Separates a spray of particles by mass and charge: quark flavours, leptons and gauge bosons, one by one. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.patch_clamp_ri: A glass pipette a micrometre across, pressed to a membrane under a microscope, reading the voltage across it. Made by crafting.
A shallow dish of two chemicals: one makes more of itself, the other holds it back, and between them stripes appear. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.peano_engine.l: Builds number systems the way mathematicians did: zero, then "the next one", then negatives, fractions, reals and beyond. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.penrose_ergosp: Extracts the rotational energy of a spinning black hole via the Penrose process. Made by crafting.
A pump and a web of fine tubing that pushes warm nutrient through a scaffold of tissue, keeping every cell fed. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.peridot_crysta: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Mantle Convection Zone).
Peridot Crystal Mass: the ground of one of the strange places beyond the Overworld.
block.theoreticalsciences.peridotite.fou: Found: in the Planetary Interior (Mantle Convection Zone); dropped by the Plume Elemental (the Planetary Interior (Mantle Convection Zone)).
block.theoreticalsciences.peridotite.lor: The dense green rock of the upper mantle, mostly olivine. Brought up into water and air, it slowly drinks them in and turns to serpentinite.
block.theoreticalsciences.phage_lab.lore: Plates of bacteria in a sealed cabinet, and a pipette of viruses: count the clear spots where the phages burst through. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.phase_diagram_: A kiln for alloys, run at the one mixture that melts all at once and sets the same all through. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.phosphate_buff: Phosphoric acid and its salt, held at pH 7.4; the pH of blood. Add acid or base and it barely moves.
block.theoreticalsciences.photobioreacto: Coils of clear tubing full of green algae, under a bank of lamps, with air bubbling through. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.photochemical_: A quartz cell under an ultraviolet lamp: light, not heat, breaks the bonds. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.photoresist.lo: A light-sensitive coating made of quantum dots. Each dot reacts to a single photon, so patterns can be printed finer than the wavelength of light. It is thin, faintly coloured and cool to the touch. Exposed regions harden instantly, so it records light like a photographic plate. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
block.theoreticalsciences.phytotron.lore: A climate-controlled growth chamber: day length, temperature and carbon dioxide set to the hour. Plants grown in it make growth hormones. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.pitchblende_or: Found in the Overworld, between Y 0 and 48. Gives Raw Pitchblende when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
Armour for working at the smallest length that means anything.
Slices boules into wafers, and wafers into dies, along cuts one Planck length wide. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.planetesimal_c: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Exoplanet Core Sample when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.plasma_crucibl: A casing of chronosteel around magnetic confinement and superconducting coils, built to hold plasma at stellar temperatures for as long as needed.
block.theoreticalsciences.plasma_injecti: A nozzle that fires plasma into a confinement chamber at a precisely controlled rate. Magnetic confinement steers it, a cryocooler keeps the coils cold, and the tip glows white when in use.
block.theoreticalsciences.plaster_jacket: A fossil bone still in its rock, wrapped in burlap and plaster to survive the trip from the dig. Found at Dig Sites in the Overworld; made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.pleroma.lore: All knowledge and the world itself, made one: the fullness the Gnostics said held all of being. Made in the Pleroma Confluence from five fluids, and the Transcendental is opened with it.
block.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_conflu: Takes 1,000 mB each of Quintessence, Alkahest, Mathesis, Panacea and Anima Mundi, and condenses them into 1,000 mB of Pleroma. Made on the Extreme Assembly Table.
Named for the Gnostics' Pleroma, the fullness of all that is. Light passes through it; nothing else is allowed to.
block.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_recons: A cathedral of Absolute Frame and Pleroma Glass around a Logos-wound throat. Fed the Echo of the Transcendental and everything the Sundering left, it plays the echo back, until the dimension it remembers exists again. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.polished_chere: Quartz polished to carry Cherenkov light, the blue glow given off when a charged particle outruns light in the glass, at about two-thirds of c.
block.theoreticalsciences.polished_dilit: Dilithium cut and polished to a flawless face. Real dilithium, Li₂, is a fleeting molecule of lithium vapour; this crystal answers to fiction instead.
block.theoreticalsciences.polymeriser.lo: A stirred vessel where small molecules link into chains thousands long, if nearly every bond forms. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.postulate_slat: Dark, flat and even: the ground every proof stands on, whether it is seen or not. Found in the Axioms, the Platonic Realm's lowest layer (Y −720 to −650). The Formal Proof Assistant works it into Proof Fragments with Tautology Shards, and makes more from cobblestone and a shard.
block.theoreticalsciences.pound_rebka_to: Gamma rays climbing a tower lose energy to gravity. A source moving at the right speed, less than a micrometre a second, puts them back in tune with the absorber above. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.precision_asse: A casing of neutronium plate around a photonic processor and a femtoscale inductor, built so that nothing inside it vibrates by more than a fraction of a proton. It is dead silent and dead still.
block.theoreticalsciences.press_ram.lore: The working piston of a hydraulic press. A small pump pushes on a broad face, and Pascal's principle multiplies the force by the ratio of their areas.
block.theoreticalsciences.pressure_vesse: Forged steel a hand thick, rated for three hundred atmospheres, and the hydrogen inside trying to creep through it.
block.theoreticalsciences.primary_mirror: The cradle that holds a telescope's main mirror, propping its back at many points so the glass does not sag out of shape as the tube tilts.
block.theoreticalsciences.prime_number_o: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Prime Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.primordial_law: The substance of law itself, before any particular law. It has no temperature and no fixed form, and it reshapes itself to fit whatever rule is asked of it. It is clear, cold and utterly still until disturbed. Found in the Ocean of Primordial Law in Hyperdimensional Reality. Made in the Omnilex Engine and the Axiom Distiller.
block.theoreticalsciences.primordial_sou: The chemical mixture from which life arose. Morphogens, chiral crystals and superacids give it the ingredients for self-replication. It is warm and bubbles slowly. Miller and Urey made amino acids in a flask of sparks; this goes much further. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_assistan: Checks proofs one axiom at a time. Logic, set theory and category theory are all built here.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_floor.lo: Flat, even and featureless, like the axioms beneath a theorem. Everything above it stands only because it does not give way.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_membrane: A sheet stretched across the gap between premise and conclusion. Every step of the argument is a fibre in it, and one false step tears it through.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_wall.lor: A wall of Living Proof, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.propylene.lore: Ethylene's heavier sister: polypropylene, acrylic, and the start of nylon.
block.theoreticalsciences.protostar_frag: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Protostellar Ember when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
A gas that carries thought. Breathing near it fills the mind with faint impressions that are not my own, and it moves in eddies that follow attention. It is warm and almost tasteless. Its currents curl toward whoever in the room is concentrating hardest. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
block.theoreticalsciences.psionic_resona: Amplifies and crystallises thought itself. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.pull_shaft.lor: A slow, steady drive that draws its load upward at a controlled rate. In a crystal puller it lifts the seed exactly as fast as the crystal grows.
block.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_crust.f: Found: in the Accretion Frontier (Pulsar Field).
block.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_crust.l: Iron from a neutron star's crust: a lattice of nuclei in a sea of electrons, held under a field of some hundred million tesla.
block.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_timing_: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Pulsar Timing Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.pulsed_lab_cas: Steel walls lined with mesh, built to keep the sharp spikes of pulsed experiments in and stray radio noise out. A Faraday cage, in effect.
block.theoreticalsciences.pulsed_magnet_: A coil of Bitter plates and a room of capacitors dumped into it: a field of up to a hundred tesla, for a few milliseconds. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.quadrupole_foc: A quadrupole magnet with four pole tips that squeeze a particle beam in one direction while stretching it in the other. Pairs of them focus a beam the way lenses focus light.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_entang: Spontaneous parametric down-conversion splits photons into entangled pairs, then binds them into qubits. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_error_: A core that protects a quantum computer's fragile states by spreading each logical qubit across many physical ones and fixing errors as they happen. It hums with a steady, careful rhythm.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_lithog: Engraves logic onto wafers through a lens. The lens is a catalyst and is never consumed. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_spacet: Spacetime treated as a fluid of quanta. In loop quantum gravity, area comes in discrete chunks, and here those chunks have settled into one shared state. Made in the Spin Network Loom.
block.theoreticalsciences.quark_gluon_co: A ring accelerator that smashes heavy nuclei into quark-gluon plasma. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.quark_gluon_pl: The state of matter that filled the universe for its first few microseconds. Protons and neutrons have melted, and quarks and gluons flow freely as an almost perfect liquid with barely any viscosity. It is the hottest thing I have ever bottled, and it pours like light. Made in the Quark-Gluon Collider.
block.theoreticalsciences.quasicrystal_f: A melt spun onto a cold wheel: cooled fast enough, its atoms freeze in an order that never repeats. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.quintessence.l: The fifth element of the ancients, and the field cosmologists think may be driving the universe apart: all of Physics in one fluid. Made in the Universe Forge, with the Theory of Everything as its catalyst. One of the five fluids of Pleroma.
block.theoreticalsciences.radio_dish_pan: One curved panel of a radio dish. Its surface need only be true to a small fraction of the wavelength, so for long waves even wire mesh will do.
block.theoreticalsciences.radio_telescop: A dish that listens to the sky: to cold hydrogen, to pulsars. It works by day and in rain, but every machine running nearby is noise in its receiver. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.radiometer_mas: A mast of radiometers weighing incoming sunlight against outgoing heat. A planet's climate hangs on that balance, a few watts per square metre either way.
block.theoreticalsciences.radium_lamp.lo: Radium mixed with phosphor glows for years without power. The dial painters of the 1920s, who pointed their brushes with their lips, paid for that glow.
block.theoreticalsciences.radon.lore: A noble gas born from the decay of radium. Radon-222 has a half-life of 3.8 days and is far heavier than air, so it pools in cellars and low places. Made in the Decay Chamber.
block.theoreticalsciences.rail_conductor: One of a pair of heavy rails. Current runs up one, across the armature and back down the other, and the magnetic force flings the armature along them.
block.theoreticalsciences.ramscoop_frame: An aluminium lattice holding the funnel's coils in a cone, braced against the drag of the gas they catch. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.raw_star_matte: The matter of a star, as simulated inside a black hole. It behaves exactly as stellar material should, because the horizon simulates it perfectly. It glows with the light of a star that does not exist. Made in the Eye of the Event Horizon.
block.theoreticalsciences.reactor_vessel: Thick steel for a reactor's pressure vessel. It must hold the core for decades while neutrons slowly make the metal more brittle.
block.theoreticalsciences.reality_compil: If the universe is a simulation, this decompiles it. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.reality_lattic: A casing that contains computronium and a Bekenstein crystal to keep track of every bit of information inside it.
block.theoreticalsciences.redshift_tower: A machine casing: the shell a structure is built from. Hold Shift to see which structures use it.
block.theoreticalsciences.refinery_casin: Casing for a refinery that runs on chance. Each stage passes its product to the next by probability alone, and the averages come out exact.
block.theoreticalsciences.reflecting_tel: A mirror under a dome, its slit open to the night. The bigger the mirror and the longer the exposure, the fainter the stars it records, on a clear, dark night, under open sky. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.refractory_fir: A fire chamber lined with firebrick, which keeps its strength far above the heat that slumps common brick. The fire stays in, and most of the heat does too.
block.theoreticalsciences.regeneration_k: A furnace that burns the coke and poisons out of a worn catalyst's pores, and gives it back like new. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.regeneration_t: A clear vat of gel where a source at one end sets up a gradient, and cells read it to know where they are. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.reheating_plas: The hot soup left when the inflaton decayed and inflation ended. It filled a cold, empty universe with particles and heat: the Big Bang proper. Made in the Inflation Chamber.
block.theoreticalsciences.relativity_bre: The place where general relativity fails. Curvature becomes infinite and the equations stop giving answers. The fluid is cold and black, and space around it is torn. Rulers placed in it disagree with themselves, and clocks show no time at all. Found in the ceiling of the Quantum Foam. Made in the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.
block.theoreticalsciences.renormalised_e: Essence with its infinities taken away, the way renormalisation tames the endless sums of quantum field theory until only finite, measurable values remain. Made in the Anomaly Resolution Engine.
block.theoreticalsciences.research_nexus: A ring of error-corrected cores around a well of light that reads Research Dossiers and studies them in your place, shortening whatever you are researching. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.research_termi: Where research is done: spend Insight here to study what comes next. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.residual_starl: The light left over when matter goes beyond stellar temperatures. It is a hot, glowing gas that carries the memory of every star that went into it. It moves like a slow, luminous fog. Its glow is the colour of a sky just after a star has set. Made in the Transcendent Plasma Forge.
block.theoreticalsciences.resonance_pede: A pedestal tuned to ring in sympathy with its neighbours, as a wine glass sings to a matching note. The first and plainest of its kind.
block.theoreticalsciences.retrocausal_or: Found in the White Hole Interior, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Retrocausal Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.return_rift.lo: A tear in space that leads back the way it came. Of all the doors in these places, it is the one that always opens onto home.
block.theoreticalsciences.reverse_osmosi: A membrane water can pass and salt cannot, if it is pushed harder than osmosis pulls back. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.revival_vat.lo: The controller of a great amniotic tank ringed by four nursery tanks: it grows a revived creature from its genome to the point it can be let go. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.rf_acceleratin: A resonant cavity driven by a tachyon klystron that gives each passing particle a precisely timed kick. Inside, radio waves bounce in a standing pattern. It hums at a frequency I can feel in my teeth.
The heart of a cyclotron. It drives the gap at the cyclotron frequency, qB/2πm, which does not change with speed, so a circling particle is kicked every half turn.
block.theoreticalsciences.ribosome_assem: A cell's protein factory, scaled up: it reads messages codon by codon and strings amino acids together. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.rich_copper_or: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 50 and 126. Gives Rich Copper Chunk when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 12 and 96. Gives Rich Gold Chunk when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 50 and 126. Gives Rich Iron Chunk when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.rift_frame_cas: A casing reinforced against tearing open: void lattice, graviton crystal and chronosteel over a hyperframe.
block.theoreticalsciences.rim_slag.found: Found: in the Accretion Frontier (Accretion Rim).
block.theoreticalsciences.rim_slag.lore: Cinder flung from the inner edge of an accretion disk, where gas spirals in at a fair fraction of light speed and is heated to millions of degrees.
block.theoreticalsciences.ringwoodite_or: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 4 and 84. Gives Ringwoodite when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.rocket_assembl: A launch pad, a service tower and a two-stage rocket: fuels it, counts down and flies a payload to orbit. Made by crafting.
A combustion chamber and a De Laval nozzle: propellant burns at thousands of kelvin and leaves supersonic. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.rocket_hull.lo: Aluminium skin over the propellant tanks: most of a rocket is tank, and most of the tank is propellant. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.salt_heat_exch: Passes heat between molten salt and water. Nitrate salt stays liquid from about 220 to 565 °C, so it can carry heat that would boil water off at once.
block.theoreticalsciences.satellite_wrec: The scorched frame and panels of a satellite that came down. Most burn up on re-entry; this one did not, quite.
block.theoreticalsciences.schrodinger_li: The boundary where quantum mechanics stops behaving. It is a still, cold fluid in which superpositions persist indefinitely, never collapsing. Looking at it, I see both outcomes at once. Measurements dipped into it return every answer at once. Found in the floor of the Quantum Foam. Made in the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.
block.theoreticalsciences.scintillator_p: A sheet that gives a brief flash of light whenever a charged particle passes through. Walls of them catch cosmic-ray showers as they rain down.
block.theoreticalsciences.seismic_isolat: Springs and dampers that cut a mirror off from the ground. Ground tremor dwarfs the 10⁻¹⁸ m a passing gravitational wave stretches an interferometer arm.
block.theoreticalsciences.seismograph.lo: A heavy pendulum that the ground moves under. It times two kinds of wave from below, fast pressure waves and slow shear waves, and the gap between them says how deep their source lies. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.selection_cham: A bank of cultures under a pressure that only the fittest survive, generation after generation. Made by crafting.
A steel lattice beside the rocket, carrying fuel lines and the arms that swing away at launch. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.singularity_co: Feed it a great many of one item and it compacts them into a singularity; no timer, as fast as you feed it. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.singularity_en: At the centre of this cell sits a tiny singularity, wrapped in cosmic neutronium. Energy falls into it and is held behind the horizon until it is needed.
block.theoreticalsciences.sintering_pres: Powder pressed and fired just below melting, until its grains grow together into one dense solid. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.solar_array.lo: Fused-silica cells with microgravity-crystal junctions: in orbit there is no night to speak of and no air to dim the sun. Made by crafting.
Heliostats turn with the Sun and feed a parabolic mirror wall, which brings their light to a point. Concentrated ten thousand times, sunlight melts what no fuel flame can. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.solar_receiver: The target at the focus of a mirror field, built to drink in concentrated sunlight. At Odeillo such a focus reaches some 3,500 °C.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_allo: Forty spacetime alloy ingots pressed into one block. The alloy bends spacetime around itself slightly, so the block's edges never look quite square.
A grade of structure coil. Better coils make the machines built with them faster; hold Shift to see which.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_anch: A pylon that pins a patch of spacetime in place, built around a spacetime anchor core and a chronosteel coil. The ground around it feels unusually solid, as if gravity had made its mind up.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_bric: Spacetime Bricks: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
A slab of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.
Stairs of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.
A wall of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_casi: A machine casing: the shell a structure is built from. Hold Shift to see which structures use it.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_pane: A panel of spacetime alloy whose surface seems to bend inward slightly, as if the wall behind it were further away than it is. It is cool, smooth and very faintly disorienting to look at for long.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_tile: Spacetime Tiles: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
A slab of Spacetime Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Spacetime Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.spectrograph.l: A slit, a grating and a plate. Light comes in as one colour and leaves as a rainbow crossed with dark lines, and every line is an element's fingerprint. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.spent_fuel_sal: Molten fluoride fuel after a pass through the core, thick with fission products and fresh plutonium, and still hot with its own decay heat. Made in the Molten Salt Reactor.
block.theoreticalsciences.spin_network_l: Weaves quanta of area and volume into a spin network: space, a grain at a time. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.station_hull.l: Aluminium skin and stringers from a spacecraft, thin enough to dent by hand. In vacuum, a few millimetres of it is all that separates air from nothing.
block.theoreticalsciences.statistics_eng: A Galton board the size of a wardrobe, and a counter for every bin: chance, measured until it is certain. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_contai: A plate of degenerate armour and spacetime alloy over magnetic confinement casing, built to hold back the pressure and heat of a star. It is impossibly heavy and faintly warm.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_frame_: A casing of neutronium plate over event horizon casing with a Higgs field capacitor to steady its mass. It is built to hold the weight and heat of a star, and it glows faintly gold at the seams.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_lamp.l: A stellar frame casing with glowstone at its heart, so it shines with a warm, golden light like a small star seen through a window. It is warm to stand next to.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_plasma: The hot, ionised gas from a star's core, where hydrogen fuses into helium at fifteen million kelvin. It glows white and roils with magnetic field lines, and it wants to escape in every direction at once. Made in the Stellar Plasma Crucible, the Universe Forge and the White Hole Emitter.
Melts and alloys matter in plasma as hot as a stellar core. Makes Chronosteel, Spacetime Alloy, Cosmic Neutronium and Exotic Solder. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.step_laser.lor: A laser whose pulse makes a moving step in the refractive index of glass. Light trying to overtake the step is slowed to a halt at it: an event horizon for light.
block.theoreticalsciences.stochastic_cor: A bank of random sources for Monte Carlo sums. The error falls as one over the square root of the samples: a hundred times the dice for ten times the accuracy.
A tower of air warmed and wetted at the floor and chilled at the lid: a thunderstorm in a bottle. Its lightning fixes nitrogen and oxygen into nitric acid, with no ammonia and no catalyst. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.storm_electrod: A copper collector threaded with fulgurite, set where the updraft separates charge: it draws the lightning. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.strained_space: Spacetime under tidal strain: stretched along one line and squeezed across it, as the Moon stretches the oceans. Anything inside it is pulled apart. Made in the Time Dilation Chamber.
block.theoreticalsciences.strange_matter: Quark matter laced with strange quarks, possibly more stable than ordinary nuclei. A drop of it converts any normal matter it touches into more of itself, given the chance. It is dense, dull and should be kept very far from everything. Made in the Particle Spectrometer, the Quark-Gluon Collider and the Hyperion Synchrotron.
block.theoreticalsciences.strategy_table: A board of hawks and doves, played a thousand times a second: whatever wins more comes back more often. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.string_resonan: Plucks cosmic strings into fundamental quantum strings and weaves them into membranes. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.stromatolite_o: Found in the Overworld, between Y -64 and 0. Gives Stromatolite Fragment when mined with iron pickaxe or better. Banded domes of the oldest rock: mats of bacteria, layer on layer, three and a half billion years ago.
block.theoreticalsciences.subsurface_sea: Ice VI, squeezed by the weight of a hundred kilometres of ice above it into a form denser than liquid water. Below it lies Titan's hidden ocean of ammonia water. Nothing yet made can drill through it. Found at the bottom of Titan.
block.theoreticalsciences.sulfur_dioxide: The choking smell of burning sulfur, and the first step to the chemical industry's most used reagent.
Oily, dense and fiercely drying. More of it is made than any other chemical: a country's output of it was once a measure of its industry.
block.theoreticalsciences.superconductin: A drum of superconducting coil wound around spacetime casing. Current, once started, circulates in it forever with no loss at all. The field it makes tugs gently at anything metal nearby.

Solder that conducts electricity without resistance. Chilled with superfluid helium, it joins femtoscale components with perfect efficiency. It shimmers faintly when current passes through. Magnets float above a puddle of it, pinned in place by expelled field lines. Made in the Phase Diagram Kiln and the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
block.theoreticalsciences.supercritical_: A fluid past its critical point, neither liquid nor gas. It diffuses like a gas and dissolves like a liquid, getting into every pore. It is warm and almost invisible. Industry uses supercritical water and carbon dioxide to dissolve what nothing else will. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
Water above 374 °C and 22 MPa, where liquid and steam become one. It dissolves oils that ordinary water will not, and corrodes most metals. Made in the Aquifer Pump.
block.theoreticalsciences.superfluid_hel: Helium so cold it flows without friction. It climbs the walls of its container in a thin film, leaks through gaps too small for any normal liquid and never stops swirling once set in motion. It is utterly clear and almost weightless in the pipe. Made in the Fractionation Spire and the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
block.theoreticalsciences.symmetry_lathe: A lathe with an indexing head that stops every 1/k of a turn, and mirrors set round the spindle. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.synaptic_fluid: A warm, conductive medium for photonic thought. It carries signals between photonic neurons with almost no loss and stays at body temperature on its own. It glows softly when a thought passes through. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
block.theoreticalsciences.synchrotron.lo: A ring accelerator built from real beamline parts: bending dipoles, focusing quadrupoles, RF cavities, cryogenics, vacuum pumps and a detector hall. It makes the exotic hadrons nothing else can.
block.theoreticalsciences.synthesis_benc: Flasks, condensers and a notebook: a molecule built step by step, working back from the target.
block.theoreticalsciences.synthesis_comp: Squeezes hydrogen and nitrogen to the pressure that pushes their equilibrium toward ammonia.
block.theoreticalsciences.tachyon_flux.l: A thin stream of faster-than-light particles. Because their mass is imaginary, they speed up as they lose energy, so the coldest flux is also the fastest. It arrives in the pipe a fraction of a moment before I open the valve. Made in the Tachyon Resonator.
block.theoreticalsciences.tachyon_resona: Resonates a crystal lattice until it emits particles that travel faster than light. Made by crafting.
Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y -724 and -648. Gives Tautology Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.tectonic_press: A multi-anvil press over a firebox: it squeezes rock to the pressures of the deep mantle and bakes it to match. What crystallises depends on where on the phase diagram you hold it.
block.theoreticalsciences.telescope_pier: A heavy masonry column for a telescope to stand on, built apart from the dome floor so that footsteps never shake the image.
block.theoreticalsciences.telescope_tube: Holds a telescope's mirrors in exact alignment and is blackened inside, so the only light that reaches the focus is light from the sky.
Computes in curved spacetime: Lorentz transformations, metrics, curvature and finally Einstein's field equations. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.tesla_coil.lor: A resonant transformer: a spark-gap primary ringing in tune with a tall secondary steps a few kilovolts up to millions, and the toroid throws arcs metres long. Made by crafting.
A few turns of heavy copper fed by a capacitor and a spark gap. Tuned to the secondary, it rings its energy across into the tall coil beside it.
block.theoreticalsciences.tesla_secondar: The tall, finely wound coil of a Tesla transformer. Tuned to resonate with the primary, it builds hundreds of kilovolts at its crown.
block.theoreticalsciences.tesla_toroid.l: The smooth metal doughnut atop a Tesla coil. Its broad curve spreads the charge and holds off corona, so the voltage climbs higher before sparks break out.
block.theoreticalsciences.tesseract_asse: Folds matter through a fourth spatial dimension. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.test_mass_cham: A vacuum chamber that hangs a polished fused-silica mirror on fine fibres, isolated from every tremor so it moves only when spacetime does.
block.theoreticalsciences.thermoelectric: A furnace wrapped in thermocouples: the heat of ordinary fuel, turned straight into current by the Seebeck effect. Humble, and the first power any laboratory has. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.tholin_sand.fo: Found: in Titan, Lander Wreck structures in Titan (Shangri-La Dunes, Xanadu Uplands, Selk Crater Field); dropped by the Tholin Drifter (Titan (Xanadu Uplands, Kraken Mare, Shangri-La Dunes ...)).
block.theoreticalsciences.tholin_sand.lo: Grains of tholin and ice, piled into dunes a hundred metres high by Titan's winds. Found in Titan's dunes, sea floors and crater plains.
block.theoreticalsciences.tidal_ore.lore: Found in the Black Hole Interior, between Y 20 and 256. Gives Tidal Alloy Scrap when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.tidal_plasma.f: Found: in the Accretion Frontier (Accretion Rim).
block.theoreticalsciences.tidal_plasma.l: Plasma near a black hole, where the pull on its near side far outstrips the far. Infalling gas is drawn out into long, thin streams: spaghettified. Found in lakes in the Accretion Frontier's Accretion Rim. Made in the Time Dilation Chamber.
block.theoreticalsciences.tilt_table.lor: A table that tilts a neutron interferometer about its beam. In 1975 one let Colella, Overhauser and Werner see gravity shift a single neutron's quantum phase.
block.theoreticalsciences.time_dilation_: Holds its samples deep in the gravity well of a dense core, where their clocks run slow against the world outside.
block.theoreticalsciences.titan_ice.foun: Found: in Titan (Xanadu Uplands, Kraken Mare, Selk Crater Field ...), Titan's Hidden Ocean.
block.theoreticalsciences.titan_ice.lore: Water ice at 94 K, as hard as granite: on Titan it is the rock. Found everywhere on Titan, under the dunes and seas. Electrolysed, it gives oxygen.
block.theoreticalsciences.titration_benc: A burette, a flask and an indicator: drop by drop until the colour turns, and you know exactly how strong it is. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.tokamak.lore: A ring of hydrogen plasma held off its walls by a twisted magnetic field, hot enough for deuterium and tritium to fuse. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.tokamak_casing: Lead-lined shell for a fusion hall. Deuterium-tritium fusion sends out 14.1 MeV neutrons that pass through anything thin, so these walls are not.
block.theoreticalsciences.topological_tr: Changes a material's topology without changing its chemistry. Made by crafting.
A kiln for surfaces: clay is drawn into handles and cross-caps and fired until its shape holds. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.toroidal_field: One of the D-shaped coils that ring a tokamak. Together they make the strong field running the long way round the torus, holding the plasma off the walls.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_c: A locker past every infinity the lesser caches count to. What it holds is not so much stored as asserted to exist.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_g: Glass that is transparent to more than light. Looking through it, I see the room beyond and, faintly, the rules that make the room possible.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_p: Plasma above the temperature where matter has fixed properties. It is no longer any element; it is all of them and none. It glows every colour at once and has no fixed density. Instruments dipped into it return a different reading every time, all of them correct. Made in the Transcendent Plasma Forge.

Four plasma injectors fire into a coil-wrapped chamber hotter than a hypernova. Burns catalyst plasmas to forge metals whose properties are chosen rather than discovered. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_s: Rock that no longer remembers which universe formed it. It has the solid presence of stone but none of the expected minerals, and its surface shifts colour faintly with my mood.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendental: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Transcendental Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_ca: A casing built to hold infinities: aleph-null shards over reality lattice casing, with a Russell set and a Banach-Tarski sphere worked into the seams.
block.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_co: A coil of hypernova alloy wound around an aleph-null shard over a cosmic neutronium coil, superconducting at room temperature. It carries a current that never quite finishes counting itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.transition_val: A valve that sends each state on to the next by fixed odds. It looks only at where things are, never at how they got there: the Markov property.
block.theoreticalsciences.tritium.lore: Hydrogen with two neutrons, radioactive with a half-life of 12.3 years. Its beta electrons are so weak they cannot get through the outer layer of skin. Made in the Tokamak and the Irradiation Chamber.
block.theoreticalsciences.tube_worms.lor: Riftia: worms two metres long with no mouth and no gut, living on the bacteria inside them, which live on the vent's sulfide. Their red plumes are full of haemoglobin. Found round the vents of Titan's hidden ocean and the Hadal Trench, where they spread by themselves near a black smoker. The Fermenter grows Bacterial Cultures from their symbionts.
block.theoreticalsciences.tumour_mass.lo: Tissue that has grown without stopping: overgrown, wrong-coloured and warm. Found on the surface of Inner Space's Tumour. The Bioreactor draws Tumour Specimens from it; matrix and a specimen make more.
Found in Inner Space, between Y 8 and 220. Gives Tumour Specimen when mined with stone pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.turbomolecular: A pump whose rotor spins so fast that its blades knock gas molecules out of the chamber one by one. It whines at a pitch just below hearing. Ultra-high vacuum starts here.
block.theoreticalsciences.turning_vane.l: A curved blade set across a duct's corner, so the air turns without tumbling into eddies. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.universe_forge: Triggers false-vacuum decay and cosmic inflation to grow, and later harvest, a pocket universe. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.unruh_accelera: A storage ring whose electrons are accelerated so hard round their curve that, to them, the empty vacuum is warm. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.unruh_detector: An accelerating detector should feel empty space as warm. It is a faint warmth: one kelvin takes an acceleration of some 10^20 metres per second squared.
block.theoreticalsciences.unruh_ring_cas: Casing for a ring of extreme acceleration. An accelerated observer finds warm thermal radiation where an inertial one sees empty vacuum: the Unruh effect.
block.theoreticalsciences.uranium_hexafl: The one uranium compound that is a gas near room temperature: it sublimes at 56.5 °C. Fluorine has a single isotope, so its molecules differ only by their uranium. Made in the Gas Centrifuge Cascade.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_beam_pi: A pipe of containment field glass and metamaterial lined with Casimir plates, so the space inside is emptier than empty. A particle beam runs through it without touching anything at all.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_beam_tu: Steel tube pumped to ultra-high vacuum, so a laser crosses kilometres with no stray gas to jitter its phase. LIGO's arms hold nearly 10,000 m³ of it.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_energy_: Energy borrowed from the vacuum itself, stored with exotic matter to keep the books balanced. Inside, graviton crystal holds the field taut while a dark matter lens focuses it.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_harvest: Holds a bubble of false vacuum open in the Quantum Foam and catches the virtual particles that flicker through it. What it catches depends on where it stands and how it is tuned.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_state_p: A projector that changes what empty space is. Exotic matter in its core shifts the vacuum energy of the region it covers, so the field inside is a slightly different universe.
The sealed doughnut-shaped chamber of a tokamak, pumped below a billionth of an atmosphere before fuel is let in, so the plasma meets nothing but itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.vanadium_bed_t: A tray of vanadium catalyst rings. The gas is cooled between trays, so each sees the right temperature.
block.theoreticalsciences.vanadium_flow_: Two tanks of vanadium in sulfuric acid, pumped past a membrane: charge one way, discharge the other, for twenty years. Its voltage says how full it is. Right-click to read it.
block.theoreticalsciences.vat_frame.lore: Steel ribs lined with polymer: the Revival Vat's skeleton. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_gravit: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Graviton when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_monopo: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Monopole when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_photon: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Photon when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_quark_: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Quark when mined with iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks.lo: Void lattice cut into bricks; rigid blocks of nothing stacked with careful joints. The wall looks like a pattern of very clean holes in the world.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks_sl: A slab of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks_st: Stairs of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks_wa: A wall of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_glass.fou: Found: in the Accretion Frontier (Lensing Void).
block.theoreticalsciences.void_glass.lor: Glass as dark as the space it came from. Gravity bends light as a lens does, and a well-aligned mass draws a background source into a full Einstein ring.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_b: Void lattice shards compacted into a block; a crystal of empty sites that is rigid even though there is nothing in it. Looking at it feels like looking at a hole in the world with very clean edges.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_o: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 128. Gives Void Lattice Shard when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_pillar.lo: A pillar of Void Lattice, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_tiles.lor: Void Lattice Tiles: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.warm_helium.lo: Helium that has done its job and warmed back up. It is ordinary gas now, clear and inert, waiting to be cooled again. Once superfluid, it is just helium. The noble gas never reacts with anything, so it can be recycled almost endlessly. Squeezed and chilled again, it remembers how to become superfluid. Made in the Stellar Plasma Crucible, the Tokamak and the Lattice Growth Vat.
block.theoreticalsciences.warp_casing.lo: Hull plating for a warp field forge. An Alcubierre bubble would need negative energy density in its walls, which is what makes this casing exotic.
block.theoreticalsciences.warp_coil_ring: One ring of a warp coil. The Alcubierre metric demands negative energy density, which no ordinary matter can supply in bulk.
block.theoreticalsciences.warp_field_for: Shapes a bubble of flat space inside a wall of negative energy: contracted ahead, expanded behind. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.wave_energy_co: A float that rides the swell and a spring-loaded power take-off that turns its heaving into electricity. Works in any ocean biome, with water to work in. Made by crafting.
Casing for a machine that stitches with entanglement. Two particles that share one state stay linked, however far apart the weave carries them.
block.theoreticalsciences.white_hole_emi: Runs a black hole backwards in time. Nothing can enter; everything comes out. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.wind_tunnel.lo: Blows air past a model at a set speed, angle and pressure, and measures what it does. Makes aerofoils and nozzles. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.wind_tunnel_ca: The smooth duct of a wind tunnel. Any roughness inside trips the flow into turbulence. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.wind_tunnel_fa: Drives the air round. Its power rises with the cube of the airspeed. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.wormhole_frame: A casing threaded with negative mass and exotic matter, the ingredients a traversable wormhole needs to keep its throat open.
block.theoreticalsciences.wormhole_proje: Opens a traversable wormhole to distant stars and drags their matter through. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
block.theoreticalsciences.x_ray_diffract: X-rays scattered by a crystal's planes of atoms reinforce only at angles that fit the spacing between them. Find the angle, and you know the lattice, and how to cut it. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.xenoplasm.lore: Life fluid from another dimension. It does not use DNA, and its chemistry is foreign. It is warm, iridescent and moves on its own. Its molecules are built on a backbone no terrestrial cell would recognise, and their handedness alternates in ways that should be unstable. Somehow it thrives on that instability. Made in the Bioreactor.
block.theoreticalsciences.xray_cabinet.l: A lead-lined, interlocked box that keeps X-rays in. Opening the door cuts the tube, so the only thing exposed is the sample.
block.theoreticalsciences.xray_tube.lore: Electrons slammed into a copper anode knock out inner electrons, and copper's sharp Kα X-ray line shines out as others fall in. Nearly all the rest ends as heat.
block.theoreticalsciences.zeno_anchor.lo: A quantum system watched closely enough never changes: each look resets it (the quantum Zeno effect). The anchor watches its chunk the same way, and the chunk cannot unload. Powered, it keeps the 3 x 3 chunks round it loaded and working, whether or not anyone is near. It draws 64 FE a tick. Made by crafting.
block.theoreticalsciences.zero_point_ext: Burns Casimir plates, exotic matter, metamaterial sheets, spin foam and mirror processors to pull energy out of the vacuum. Made by crafting.
boss.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega.gen: I am what your engine was made of: every law you broke apart to build it.
You took the universe to pieces. Do you understand any of them?
Why does a clock slow down? What is a measurement? How many infinities are there?
And why did you do it, to make, to know, or to be?
Come inside. Show me what you understand.
boss.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega.pro: One last question. Everything depends on it.
boss.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega.shi: It has closed itself into a proof. Answer at the pedestals.
Its Echo has been played back into being. Everything exists again.
commands.theoreticalsciences.radiation.r: Cleared the radiation dose of %s (and in Mekanism and GregTech, where installed)
commands.theoreticalsciences.radiation.s: Set the radiation dose of %s to %s

emi.theoreticalsciences.layer_help: Click the view or the arrows to change layer (right-click goes down)
emi.theoreticalsciences.preview_help: Drag to turn, Shift-drag or right-drag to move, - / + to zoom. Hover a block to see what goes there.
entity.theoreticalsciences.mammoth.lore: Six tonnes of Ice Age grazer, brought back from a thirty-thousand-year-old bone. It wanders, grazes and keeps with its herd. It never starts a fight, but hurt one and every mammoth nearby charges, tusks first.
entity.theoreticalsciences.meganeura.lor: A griffinfly of the Carboniferous, seventy centimetres across, from an age when the air held a third more oxygen. It patrols the place it was let go, darting and hovering, and flees fast and high if struck.
env.theoreticalsciences.min_y_or: At y %s or higher, or in %s
glossary.theoreticalsciences.title: Book of Symbols
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.awake: AWAKE, in tune with this place
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.compact_h: Drag the track, or scroll on it (Shift: x10, Ctrl: x100).
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.hint.abno: While uncontained, the anomaly spreads: it nudges the other branches and clouds every other reading. Contain it first.
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.hint.biol: Living parameters: what is measured is what they settle into together, not each one on its own.
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.hint.chem: The three reagents always add up to a whole: raising one lowers the other two.
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.hint.fina: Entropy creeps up while you work on a dormant Core: leave it a little low, and wake the Core soon after.
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.hint.math: Whole numbers, exact or nothing. Each lamp is one law: a mod 7, a times b mod 11, a + b + n mod 13, and n prime.
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.hint.orig: Phases wrap round. The first is absolute; each of the others counts from the one before it.
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.hint.phys: Three plain fields. But its target leans on Abnormality, the branch before it in the ring.
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.ring: each leans on the one before
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.title: Attunement of the Omnipotence Core
gui.theoreticalsciences.attune.wake_help: Wake the Core: every branch must be in tune (Mathematics: all four laws). Costs one action of the Hand's Eschaton Charge.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.balanc: Atoms of each element, left | right
Atoms of each element, and the charge, left | right
Set the coefficients so every element has as many atoms on the left as on the right; for ions, the charge must balance too.
Click a species to put it on the left (blue), click again for the right (orange), again to take it out. Some do not belong. Then balance it.
%s(aq) and %s(aq) are mixed: write the net ionic equation of the precipitate.
Each tile is a known implication. Use them in order to get from the premise to the goal; some lead nowhere.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.cipher: The machine's control word was sent shifted along the alphabet. Turn the key back until the decoded word is a word of science.
A key of %s letters: each colour of letter uses its own shift
The shift: every letter moved by the same amount
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.equili: Give each species its power in K: products on top, reactants below, each to the power of its coefficient. Pure solids and liquids are left out.
Power in K (+ on top,; below, none left out)

gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.flow.l: Bolted tiles cannot be turned. Rock holds no pipe.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.flow.s: Sealed: no open pipe end may leak (%s leaking now).

gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.hint.n: Not yet: from that cell, one of you would do better by changing alone.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.hint.o: Not yet: %s of them are wrong.

gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.nash.k: Gold: your winnings. Blue: theirs. From a cell, look down its column for a better gold number, and along its row for a better blue one.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.oxidat: Give the oxidation state of the marked element in each. Oxygen is usually -2 and hydrogen +1; together they add up to the charge.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.path.h: Click links to lay a route from A to B. It must be the shortest there is: add up the lengths on the links you use.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.path.r: One unbroken route from A to B, no branches, no loops.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.rxn.bl: iron from its ore with carbon monoxide (a blast furnace)
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.rxn.co: sulfur trioxide from sulfur dioxide (the contact process)
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.rxn.ha: ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen (the Haber process)
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.rxn.ni: nitric acid from nitrogen dioxide and water
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.rxn.os: nitric oxide from ammonia (the Ostwald process)
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.rxn.pe: hydrogen peroxide breaking down into water and oxygen
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.rxn.sa: table salt from sodium and chlorine

Your lines are off by %s nm on average

gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.symmet: Fill cells until the whole pattern has the symmetry asked for. Gold cells are fixed on, crossed cells must stay empty; a cell turns red while its partners do not match.
Click a cell to fill or clear it.
A mirror down the middle: the left half reflects the right.
Two mirrors: across and down the middle.
A quarter turn: the pattern looks the same turned 90 degrees (no mirror).
A quarter turn and a mirror: all eight symmetries of a square.

gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.tree.h: Click links until every junction is joined to every other, with no loop, and the total length is as small as it can be.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.tree.r: Every junction joined, and no loop anywhere.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.vertex: Choose regular polygons to meet at one point with no gap and no overlap: their corners must add to exactly 360 degrees. Use the gold one.
gui.theoreticalsciences.calibrate.wave.h: Build the gold waveform from sine waves of your own: set each one's frequency, phase and amplitude until your line lies on it. Scroll over a value to change it.
gui.theoreticalsciences.catalyst_slot.hi: Holds one catalyst. A catalyst that wears or decays only works from here.

gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.create.tip: Bring the creature into being at the block you are looking at

gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.entity.tip: The creature to create, or to transmute the target into

gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.gravity.ze: No gravity at all: everything that leaves the ground drifts
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.heal.tip: Restore the target to full health
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.health.tip: Multiply the maximum health of every mob in this dimension (never players)
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.hostile.ti: Whether monsters arise on their own in this dimension. Spawners and eggs still work
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.intro_1: Begin at the glowing "Start Here" node and follow the numbered steps downwards, each opens as you get there.
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.intro_2: Drag to move the map, mouse wheel to zoom, hover a node to light up what it links to, click to read. Search: bottom right.
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.intro_3: Sneak + use the Codex (or the Research button) opens the Research Tree. In an inventory, hover an item and press %s to look it up.
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.locked_pag: This entry is still locked.$(br2)Research $(thing)%s$() to read it.
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.map_tip: Drag (or use the arrow keys) to move the map. Mouse wheel to zoom.
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.missing: The Codex data is missing (a resource pack may have removed it).
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.next_none: Nothing waiting: gather Insight with the Spectral Analyzer, or explore the map.

gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.next_steps: What you can do now: research ready to start, and guide steps not read yet (N)
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.no_recipe: Recipe %s is not loaded in this world.
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.pacify.tip: The target will never again turn on a player

gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.research_t: Open the research tree (sneak-using the Codex opens it too)
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.restore.ti: Undo every rewritten law of this dimension: gravity, spawning and mob strength
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.rewrite.no: Rewrite: no target (look at a creature when opening)
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.speed.tip: Multiply the speed of every mob in this dimension (never players)
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.time.tip: Move the sun. Dimensions that share the Overworld's clock move with it
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.title: Quantum Codex
Turn the target into the creature named in the Create box; it keeps its name
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.weather.ti: Set the weather for the next ten minutes
gui.theoreticalsciences.codex.world_laws: The laws of the whole world are kept by this server's operators
gui.theoreticalsciences.collapse_body: Running this recipe cannot be undone. The engine and its whole structure will be destroyed and fold into a five-dimensional object that drags everything near it inside. Proceed?
gui.theoreticalsciences.compactor_instan: No timer: fills as fast as you feed it
gui.theoreticalsciences.compactor_needs: Needs %s in total; feed it any amount at a time
gui.theoreticalsciences.confluence_statu: %s / %s ready (%s mB of each makes %s mB of Pleroma)
gui.theoreticalsciences.console.scope_pl: How it has moved over the last eight seconds.
gui.theoreticalsciences.console.scope_wi: The green band is the window the recipe needs this quantity held in; the line turns red outside it.
gui.theoreticalsciences.core_forge_locke: The Forge wakes only in a Core that has been destroyed and rebuilt.
gui.theoreticalsciences.core_shutdown_wa: Initiating the Shutdown Sequence destroys the Transcendental in 60 seconds. Nobody will be able to enter it again until it is rebuilt. What is left of the Core becomes the material of everything beyond it.
gui.theoreticalsciences.law.1: c; the speed of light, the limit of cause
gui.theoreticalsciences.law.2: h-bar; the grain of action, the scale of the quantum
gui.theoreticalsciences.law.3: alpha; the fine-structure constant, the strength of light on matter
gui.theoreticalsciences.law.4: Lambda; the cosmological constant, the push of the vacuum
gui.theoreticalsciences.law.5: k_B; Boltzmann's constant, the exchange rate of entropy

gui.theoreticalsciences.omega_tip_on: The aleph-null overclock is SET. Press to release it.

gui.theoreticalsciences.phys.edit_hint: Click to type a value (1.5e3 works). Scroll to step; Shift ×10, Ctrl ×100.
gui.theoreticalsciences.phys.ideal_findi: Working out the best readout for this recipe.
gui.theoreticalsciences.phys.ideal_idle: Run a recipe to see what it wants.
gui.theoreticalsciences.phys.ideal_tip.e: At the recipe's best point this reads %1$s. Bring it there (it reads %2$s now).

gui.theoreticalsciences.phys.kind.quench: If broken: a quench; stored energy dumps as heat, containment takes a hit, 8 s to recover.

gui.theoreticalsciences.phys.kind.wear: If broken: containment wears four times as fast.
gui.theoreticalsciences.phys.no_coolant: No coolant; shedding heat to air only

gui.theoreticalsciences.tank_hint_out: Click with an empty container to drain
gui.theoreticalsciences.zoom_tip: Zoom (mouse wheel, + / -). Ctrl + wheel scrolls, Shift + wheel scrolls sideways, drag to pan.
item.theoreticalsciences.absolute_dossie: The research of a civilisation that has nearly finished. Feeds a Research Nexus.
item.theoreticalsciences.absolute_infini: Larger than every infinity. It cannot be conceived, and yet here it is. Made in the Axiom Distiller.
item.theoreticalsciences.absolute_notes_: One third of a Research Dossier.
One third of a Research Dossier.
One third of a Research Dossier.
item.theoreticalsciences.absolute_singul: Not a point where the laws break down: a point where there are no laws to break. Made in the Eschaton Foundry.
item.theoreticalsciences.accretion_disk_: Found: mined from Accretion Slag Ore in the Accretion Frontier (Accretion Rim); dropped by the Tidal Stretcher (the Accretion Frontier (Accretion Rim)).
Slag from the inner edge of an accretion disk, frozen where it was flung out. It still remembers ten million kelvin.

Gas spiralling into a black hole, heated by friction to millions of kelvin. On the way down it can turn tens of percent of its rest mass into light. Found in lakes in the Accretion Frontier's Accretion Rim. Made in the Accretion Disk Reactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.adaptive_feedba: Learns how its machine wanders and leans against it before it does.
item.theoreticalsciences.aeon_boundary_s: Rescale an infinitely old, empty, massless universe and it looks like a Big Bang. A sliver of the seam between two aeons.
item.theoreticalsciences.aerofoil_compos: Nylon fibre in a polymer matrix, laid up to a cambered profile and proven in the wind tunnel. Made in the Wind Tunnel.
Everything that has ever been known, written once. Creative mode only.
item.theoreticalsciences.alcubierre_coil: Contracts space ahead, expands it behind.
item.theoreticalsciences.aleph_null_shar: The size of the natural numbers, made solid. Counting its facets never ends.
item.theoreticalsciences.aleph_one.lore: The next size of infinity after the countable one.
item.theoreticalsciences.algae_culture.l: Green algae in a flask, turning light, water and carbon dioxide into sugar and oxygen: photosynthesis, a cell at a time. It dies if carried about too long. Made in the Photobioreactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.alkahest_cell.l: The universal solvent the alchemists searched for, at last: it dissolves anything, and holds the whole of Chemistry in one fluid. Made in the Alkahest Still. One of the five fluids of Pleroma. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega_spa: Calls a Alpha Omega into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.alumina.lore: Aluminium oxide, won from clay with hot caustic soda (Bayer).
item.theoreticalsciences.alumina_ceramic: Alumina pressed and fired just below melting: nearly as hard as sapphire, and it shrugs off a furnace.
item.theoreticalsciences.aluminium_ingot: Light, bright and once dearer than gold, until electrolysis (Hall-Héroult) made it cheap.
item.theoreticalsciences.amethyst_singul: 16,384 amethyst shard, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.amino_acid_mixt: Glycine, alanine and their kin, made from hydrogen cyanide and ammonia as they are in comets and meteorites. Life's letters, before anything has written with them.
item.theoreticalsciences.ammonia_buffer_: Ammonia and ammonium sulfate, holding steady at pH 9: alkaline, and stubborn about it. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.ammonia_cell.lo: NH₃: nitrogen made useful. Fertiliser for half the world's food, and the start of nitric acid. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
