item.theoreticalsciences.ammonium_nitrat: NH₄NO₃: half the world's fertiliser. It dissolves so endothermically that a bag of it in water goes ice-cold, and, heated, it can detonate.
item.theoreticalsciences.anchor_core.lor: Negative mass pinned inside spacetime alloy. It holds the metric still while everything around it bends.
item.theoreticalsciences.anchored_warp_b: A warp bubble tied to the place it was anchored. Used, it carries you back there and is spent.
item.theoreticalsciences.anglerfish_lure: Found: dropped by the Hadal Anglerfish (the Hadal Trench).
The esca: a bulb at the end of the anglerfish's rod, full of glowing bacteria that the fish keeps and feeds. They glow on, long after it is gone. Dropped by Hadal Anglerfish in the Hadal Trench.
item.theoreticalsciences.anima_mundi_cel: The soul of the world: water, lava, the Overworld's deep brine and magma, and the Essence of every other mod installed, distilled into one fluid. Made in the Essence Distillery. One of the five fluids of Pleroma. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.annihilation_co: A controlled matter-antimatter reaction in a box. Made in the Antimatter Penning Trap.
item.theoreticalsciences.annihilator_spa: Calls a Annihilator into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.anomalous_strai: Stem cells exposed to a contained anomaly. Their checkpoints are failing one by one: no p53, no brakes, no reason to stop dividing. Made in the Bioreactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_catalog: Every kind of anomaly you have contained, what it can do, how far it can spread and how big the largest one will be. Most are small; a few are not. Made in the Anomaly Containment Ward.
item.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_specime: A sample of something that should not be, held in a quarantine field small enough to carry. It is still trying to get out. Made in the Anomaly Containment Ward.
item.theoreticalsciences.antibiotic.lore: Penicillin, drawn from mould: it stops bacteria building their walls. Use it on a contaminated Biology machine to clean it, but each dose on the same machine selects for what survives it, so the n-th works only one time in n; a Sterile Pack always works. Made on the Mycelium Bed.
item.theoreticalsciences.antibody.found: Found: dropped by the T Cell (Inner Space (Tumour, Nucleus, Lymph Node)).
item.theoreticalsciences.antibody.lore: A Y of protein whose two tips fit one shape, and one shape only, the way a key fits a lock. Bound to an invader, it marks it for the body to clear. Made on the Antibody Bench.
item.theoreticalsciences.anticarbon_crys: Found: mined from Anticarbon Ore in the Antiverse.
Antidiamond. Four antibonds per anti-atom, as hard as diamond.
As soft, as dense and as noble as gold. Do not wear it. Made in the Mirror Matter Foundry.
item.theoreticalsciences.antihelium_nucl: Found: dropped by the Annihilator (the Antiverse).
Two antiprotons and two antineutrons. Our own detectors have glimpsed a handful; the Antiverse is full of them.
item.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen_ce: A positron bound to an antiproton. CERN first made a few atoms of it in 1995; it can only be held in magnetic traps, since touching any wall annihilates it. Made in the Antiproton Decelerator and the Electrolytic Cell. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen_cr: Found: mined from Antihydrogen Ice in the Antiverse; dropped by the Antihydrogen Wisp (the Antiverse).
Frozen antihydrogen: one antiproton, one positron, a few kelvin.
item.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen_wi: Calls a Antihydrogen Wisp into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
Anti-iron, refined in levitation. Its surface never touches the mould. Made in the Mirror Matter Foundry.
item.theoreticalsciences.antimatter_pell: Held in a Penning trap. Do not let it touch anything. Made in the Antimatter Penning Trap.
item.theoreticalsciences.antimatter_sing: 8,192 antimatter pellet, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.antiproton_bund: A few billion antiprotons, slowed from near light speed and held in a magnetic bottle. Made in the Antiproton Decelerator.
item.theoreticalsciences.antiquark_shard: Found: dropped by the Positronium Skitterer (the Antiverse); dropped by the Annihilator (the Antiverse).
Confined anti-colour charge, chipped from a creature of the Antiverse.
item.theoreticalsciences.antisilicon_sha: Found: mined from Antisilicon Ore in the Antiverse; dropped by the Positronium Skitterer (the Antiverse).
Semiconductor of the Antiverse, its holes are positrons.
Water with every proton, neutron and electron swapped for its antiparticle. It would boil, freeze and flow just like water, as long as nothing ordinary touched it. Found in the Antiverse's seas. Made in the Mirror Matter Foundry. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.apeiron_ingot.l: Anaximander's apeiron: the boundless stuff everything else is cut from. The ingot has edges only where you look.
item.theoreticalsciences.apochromatic_ob: Fluorite between two lenses of fused silica: three colours brought to exactly one focus, and the rest within a hair of it.
item.theoreticalsciences.apoptosis_trigg: A CRISPR-written instruction that only an anomalous cell will read: a reminder of the death it was always supposed to accept. Made in the Gene Sequencer.
Water from a confined aquifer, tens of thousands of years old: rain from the last ice age, still on its way.
item.theoreticalsciences.aramid_fibre.lo: Rigid aromatic chains spun out of sulfuric acid, lined up like logs in a river: the fibre in bulletproof vests.
item.theoreticalsciences.arbor_heartwood: Wood from the World Tree. It is warm, cold, heavy and weightless, sometimes all at once.
item.theoreticalsciences.arrow_of_time_s: Entropy only goes up; that is all "forward" means. This shard points the other way.
An Engineered Enzyme with its Michaelis constant and top speed measured, so it is always fed exactly as much substrate as it can use. Made on the Enzyme Assay Bench; Bioculture wastes far less with it.
item.theoreticalsciences.assembly_matrix: The frame femtoscale parts are mounted on: the Femtoscale Assembly Line and the White Hole Emitter build with it.
Stores charge in the Higgs field itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.atto_inductor.l: Wound from a magnetic monopole's field lines.
item.theoreticalsciences.atto_transistor: Switches between superposed states before it is asked to.
item.theoreticalsciences.autocatalytic_b: A soup of molecules that catalyse their own making: each copy speeds the making of the next, so the broth grows faster the more of it there is. Made in the Chemical Reactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.autonomous_cali: Installs into a multiblock controller for good: it follows the drifting tuning and repairs containment by itself, for a 25% power tax. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
item.theoreticalsciences.auxin_cell.lore: Indole-3-acetic acid in solution: the hormone that tells a shoot which way the light is and a root which way is down. Made in the Phytotron.
item.theoreticalsciences.avogadro_record: A thousand tracks of a clay grain in water, each one a staggering random walk, and from how far they wander: how many molecules make a mole. Perrin won the Nobel Prize for this.
Found: dropped by the Law Wraith.
A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.
item.theoreticalsciences.axiom_key.lore: Opens the breach to the space where laws are born. Use it to travel there and back. Made in the Axiomatic Breach Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.axiom_of_choice: From every set of sets you may pick one of each. Accept it and spheres can be doubled. Made in the Formal Proof Assistant.
item.theoreticalsciences.axiom_schema.fo: Found: dropped by the Axiom Sentinel (the Platonic Realm).
item.theoreticalsciences.axiom_schema.lo: The rules you agree to before you prove anything.
item.theoreticalsciences.axiom_sentinel_: Calls a Axiom Sentinel into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.bacterial_cultu: A flask of bacteria doubling every twenty minutes while the food lasts. The workhorses of biology: they make what they are told to, and some make magnets. They die if carried about too long. Made in the Fermenter.
item.theoreticalsciences.bacteriophage.l: A virus that eats bacteria: a head of DNA on a stalk of legs. It lands on a cell, injects its genes, and the cell builds a hundred more before it bursts. Made in the Phage Lab.
item.theoreticalsciences.balance_tinctur: The first stage of Alkahest: everything Chemistry knows about how fast and how far a reaction goes, in one solution. Made in the Alkahest Still. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.banach_tarski_s: Cut it into five non-measurable pieces, reassemble them, and you have two spheres. Made in the Cantor Diagonalizer.
item.theoreticalsciences.baryogenesis_se: Out of equilibrium, violating baryon number, C and CP: the three conditions for a universe to end up made of something.
item.theoreticalsciences.baryon_asymmetr: One extra quark in every billion pairs. Everything that was not annihilated grew out of that one part in a billion.
item.theoreticalsciences.basaltic_magma_: Molten rock low in silica, at around 1,200 °C. Runny for a magma, it pours out in fast rivers of lava rather than exploding, as on Hawaii. Found in the magma seas of the Planetary Interior. Made in the Deep Drilling Rig. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.bathyscaphe.lor: A steel-and-ceramic sphere with a window of leaded glass and a rebreather inside, hung under a float: the way down to the Hadal Trench and back. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.beam_splitter.l: A disc of fused silica coated so it lets exactly half the light through and reflects the other half.
item.theoreticalsciences.bekenstein_crys: Holds the maximum information a region of space can contain.
item.theoreticalsciences.binary_serpent_: Two bodies coiled round each other in a tightening spiral, shedding gravitational waves. Each turn is faster than the last, until the chirp ends in a merger.
item.theoreticalsciences.biochar.lore: Wood charred without air: a porous carbon sponge that holds water and nutrients in soil for centuries. Made in the Sintering Press.
item.theoreticalsciences.biosphere_compe: One of every creature that can be eaten, pressed into one. Do not eat.
item.theoreticalsciences.bitter_plate.lo: A copper disc cut with a slit and pierced with cooling holes. Stacked into a helix, Bitter plates make the strongest steady magnets there are.
item.theoreticalsciences.black_swan_feat: Found: dropped by the Black Swan.
Proof that the improbable happens. For centuries every swan was white, until one was not.
item.theoreticalsciences.black_swan_spaw: The rare, unforeseeable event, explained only afterwards. Europeans held every swan white until Dutch sailors met black ones in Australia in 1697; this one is seldom seen.
item.theoreticalsciences.blood_plasma_ce: Blood with the cells taken out: water, salts, sugar and a host of proteins, the antibodies among them. It carries everything a body sends anywhere. Found in the seas and channels of Inner Space's Bloodstream; the Lake Pump draws it, without end. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.blue_ice_singul: 8,192 blue ice, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.boltzmann_brain: Found: dropped by the Boltzmann Brain (the Accretion Frontier (Asteroid Belt, Molecular Cloud Nebula, Lensing Void)).
A mind that fluctuated into existence from random noise. It is very confused.
Calls a Boltzmann Brain into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.boltzmann_fluct: Wait long enough in a universe at equilibrium and anything happens by chance. This is the anything. Made in the Entropy Horizon.
item.theoreticalsciences.bootstrap_artif: Nobody made it. It was always handed back from the future.
item.theoreticalsciences.boron_control_r: Boron carbide in a steel sleeve. Boron-10 drinks neutrons: push the rod in and the chain reaction slows.
item.theoreticalsciences.bose_einstein_c: Thousands of atoms behaving as one. Chilled to within a whisper of absolute zero, they share a single wavefunction and slide as a single wave, rippling with interference fringes. It looks like a faint mist that refuses to scatter. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.bottom_top_quar: The third generation. The top quark weighs as much as a gold atom and decays before it can bind to anything.
item.theoreticalsciences.bounce_core.lor: A universe crushed to the Planck density, where the quantum geometry of space turned the collapse around.
item.theoreticalsciences.boundary_cft_ch: A quantum field theory without gravity, on a boundary, which is the same theory as gravity in the space inside it.
item.theoreticalsciences.brane_shifter.l: Slip sideways out of this brane and into the Bulk. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.brane_strider_s: Calls a Brane Strider into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.brane_tension_f: Found: dropped by the Brane Strider (the Bulk (Moduli Wastes, Graviton Reef)).
A thread pulled from the membrane a Brane Strider walks on.
item.theoreticalsciences.brane_tether.lo: Ties your mass to our brane. Carry it in the Bulk, or in any field of extra dimensions.
item.theoreticalsciences.brane_tether.sh: Also shields you completely in the Platonic Realm, the Antiverse and the Quantum Foam.
item.theoreticalsciences.bridgmanite.fou: Found: mined from Bridgmanite Ore in the Planetary Interior (Mantle Convection Zone).
item.theoreticalsciences.bridgmanite.lor: The most abundant mineral on Earth, and almost never seen, because it only exists under the pressure of the lower mantle.
item.theoreticalsciences.brine_jelly_spa: A clear jelly with a glowing ring in its bell, pulsing up and sinking back on the slow currents, trailing long tentacles. Whatever brushes them is stung. Found drifting in Titan's hidden ocean.
item.theoreticalsciences.brown_dwarf_cor: Found: mined from Brown Dwarf Remnant in the Accretion Frontier (Asteroid Belt).
The dense heart of a failed star: too light to fuse hydrogen, heavy enough once to burn its deuterium. It still glows with the heat of its own contraction.
item.theoreticalsciences.brownian_suspen: Fine clay held in water and never at rest: each grain is kicked about by molecules too small to see, and wanders without ever settling on a path. Made in the Chemical Reactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.bubble_universe: An entire universe hanging from a branch of the World Tree, caught before it fell.
Sixty carbon atoms arranged like a football, with room inside for one more atom. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.burst_afterglow: The fading afterglow of a gamma-ray burst; the brightest explosions there are, seen across the Universe.
item.theoreticalsciences.calabi_yau_mani: Six compact dimensions, folded small enough to hold.
item.theoreticalsciences.calibration_car: A punched card that remembers how a machine was set. Sneak-use it on a tuned machine to copy its settings, then use it on any other machine of that kind to set it the same way. It is never used up; sneak-use it in the air to wipe it. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.californium_252: A microgram of californium splits by itself often enough to give off two million neutrons a second.
item.theoreticalsciences.cantor_key.lore: Opens the Transfinite Hierarchy, where every infinity has its own place: the Platonic Realm's top layer, the Infinite (above Y 1280). Use it there to return. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.car_t_culture.l: Killer T cells taught a new receptor: they hunt one marker, the anomaly's own, and they multiply as they find it. Made in the Bioreactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.carbon_monoxide: Colourless, odourless and deadly; with hydrogen, the start of every synthetic fuel. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.carbon_nanotube: Graphene rolled into tubes, the tubes twisted into rope. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.carborane_super: The strongest acid that can be bottled. It protonates almost anything yet is gentle on glass, because its conjugate base is so stable it does not attack. It is clear and calm in the flask. It is one of the few acids that is strong and polite at the same time. Made in the Electrolytic Cell. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
Found: mined from Cardinal Ore in the Platonic Realm; dropped by the Ordinal Hound (the Platonic Realm).
A piece of how many there are, even when there are infinitely many.
item.theoreticalsciences.casimir_plate.l: Two plates nanometres apart. The vacuum between them pushes.
item.theoreticalsciences.catalyst_sprite: Calls a Catalyst Sprite into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.category_lattic: Objects and arrows, and nothing else. All of mathematics fits inside. Made in the Formal Proof Assistant.
item.theoreticalsciences.causal_set_seed: Events scattered at random into spacetime, with nothing but which came before which. From that order alone, geometry grows.
item.theoreticalsciences.causal_shield_l: Chronosteel threaded with stored chronons. Paradoxes that hit it are deflected into somebody else's timeline.
item.theoreticalsciences.causal_solder_c: Solder that joins things across time. Tachyon crystal lets it flow backwards, chronon capacitors keep the loop stable, and components soldered with it are connected before they are made. It feels slightly older than it is. Made in the Chronon Field Inverter. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.caustic_soda.lo: Sodium hydroxide, from salt water and current: the base every acid in the industry is measured against.
item.theoreticalsciences.cepheid_standar: The light curve of a Cepheid variable. How long it takes to pulse tells how bright it truly is (Leavitt's law), and so how far away.
item.theoreticalsciences.ceramic_armour_: A ceramic face backed with aramid: the ceramic shatters what hits it, the fibre catches the pieces. Whipple Shield armour is mended with it at an anvil. Made by crafting.
A dish of the Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction, turning red and blue and back on a steady beat, with no pendulum and no spring. Made in the Oscillator Vessel.
item.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_boule: A single crystal of Cherenkov quartz, grown in superfluid helium. Ready to be sliced.
item.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_latti: Diamond and Cherenkov quartz woven around netherite: a frame for a crystal that should not exist. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_quart: Found: mined from Deepslate Cherenkov Quartz Ore in the Overworld.
Glows with the blue light of particles outrunning light in a medium.
item.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_singu: 32,768 cherenkov quartz, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_wafer: A wafer sliced from a Cherenkov boule. Made in the Planck-Scale Cutter.
Found: dropped by the Mirror Microbe.
Left-handed or right-handed, never both. Life only uses one hand.
item.theoreticalsciences.chiral_ligand.l: Two aromatic rings joined so that they cannot turn past each other: the molecule is left- or right-handed, and so is every metal it holds. Made from a Kekule Ring at the Synthesis Bench; held in the Asymmetric Reactor's catalyst slot.
item.theoreticalsciences.chirality_tinct: The third stage of Alkahest: handedness and time; molecules of one hand, reactions that keep a beat, and the chemistry of another world. Made in the Alkahest Still. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.chirp_signal_re: The rising whoop of two compact stars spiralling together: their gravitational waves climb in pitch and strength until they merge.
item.theoreticalsciences.chlorine_cell.l: A yellow-green gas, heavier than air and fiercely reactive. It bleaches, disinfects and makes half of all plastics. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.chondrite_fragm: Found: mined from Chondrite in Meteorite Crater structures in the Overworld.
Stone that never melted since the planets formed: grains of olivine and metal, and among them dust older than the Sun.
item.theoreticalsciences.christoffel_sym: How the coordinates twist from one point to the next. Made in the Chrono Loom.
Holds your own clock steady. Carry it into fields where time runs fast or slow. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.chronon_capacit: Found: dropped by the Paradox Echo.
Holds quanta of time. Handle before use.
item.theoreticalsciences.chronon_gas_cel: A gas of time quanta, if time comes in quanta. It drifts against the direction of other gases, and clocks immersed in it tick unevenly. Breathing near it leaves me unsure how long I have been standing there. Made in the Fractionation Spire, the Chronon Field Inverter and the Chrono Loom. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.chronoplastic_g: Seals a joint against time itself: what is inside ages at the machine's pace, not the world's.
item.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_ing: Neutronium forged in a pocket of stopped time. It never ages, rusts or wears.
item.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_sin: 16,384 chronosteel ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.circadian_cultu: Cells that keep their own clock, a loop of genes that switches itself on and off every day. Set to the world's day, they work hardest in their active hours. It dies if carried about too long. Made in the Circadian Incubator.
item.theoreticalsciences.circuit_substra: The blank on which every circuit board is built.
item.theoreticalsciences.claytronic_cato: One cell of a substance that can become anything.
item.theoreticalsciences.closed_timelike: Found: dropped by the Paradox Echo.
A path through spacetime that ends where, and when, it started.
item.theoreticalsciences.cobalt_57_sourc: Iron-54 struck by the alpha particles of radium becomes cobalt-57, which decays into iron-57 and gives off a gamma ray so sharp in energy it can be shifted by gravity across a few metres.
item.theoreticalsciences.cognitive_singu: Every thought that could be thought, compressed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.coherence_stabi: Keeps your wavefunction in one piece. Carry it in the Quantum Foam, or in an altered vacuum.
Also shields you completely in the Platonic Realm and the Antiverse.
item.theoreticalsciences.coherent_wiring: Superconducting wire braided so its electrons keep their phase from end to end. Every quantum machine is threaded with it.
item.theoreticalsciences.cold_pack_solut: Ammonium nitrate dissolved in water, five degrees below freezing: the heat it took to dissolve came out of the water itself. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.compactified_ci: A whole dimension rolled up into a circle smaller than a Planck length. Made in the Compactification Lathe.
item.theoreticalsciences.complex_plane.l: Real and imaginary at right angles. Every polynomial finally has its roots. Made in the Analytic Continuator.
item.theoreticalsciences.computronium_in: Matter arranged for the maximum possible computation per gram.
item.theoreticalsciences.computronium_si: 8,192 computronium ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.concentrated_br: What is left of a brine when the membrane has taken half its water: twice as salty, and quicker to dry. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.confidence_inte: A gauge that shows not a value but a range, and how sure it is. Carried in the off hand, it steadies the luck of what you drink (no Variance).
item.theoreticalsciences.confidence_seal: A machine's outputs, sampled so many times that their odds are known to the last digit, and the settings that favour the good ones. Fitted to a machine, every chance product comes out halfway closer to certain. One upgrade per machine. Made in the Statistics Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.contagion_netwo: Every contact, every transmission, every node an infection passed through. Somewhere in it is the threshold where R crosses 1. Made in the Holographic Encoder.
item.theoreticalsciences.containment_cel: A magnetically sealed flask for fluids too hot, too cold or too strange for a bucket. Scoop a source block or fill it from a tank. Made in the Electrolytic Cell.
item.theoreticalsciences.continuum_shard: The cardinality of the real line. Is it the next infinity after aleph-null? The axioms cannot say.
item.theoreticalsciences.copper_ammine_c: Copper with four ammonia molecules round it, a blue so deep it was once used to dissolve cellulose.
item.theoreticalsciences.copper_singular: 32,768 copper ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.core_drill.lore: A diamond-set coring bit on a hydraulic hammer. Hold it against bedrock and it cuts through; the first tool that can.
item.theoreticalsciences.corundum.found: Found: mined from Corundum Crystal Mass in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns); in the caches of Deep Borehole structures in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns).
item.theoreticalsciences.corundum.lore: Aluminium oxide, as hard as anything but diamond. Coloured by a trace of iron and titanium it is sapphire; by chromium, ruby. Clear and hard, it makes the best lenses and bearings.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_board.lo: A board laid across a Calabi-Yau manifold.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_die.lore: A die holding a galaxy-scale computation.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_flux_cou: Couples a machine to the flux of a whole cosmos without being consumed by it.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_lens.lor: A loop of cosmic string bends light into perfect focus. A lithography catalyst.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_logic_wa: Etched with a lens made of a cosmic string. Each trace is a light-year long, folded.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_neutroni: Neutronium compressed with dark matter in a star's heart. Starlight drifts through it.
4,096 cosmic neutronium ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_processo: Tier V processor. A computer the size of a galaxy, folded into a chip.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_ray_shar: Found: mined from Cosmic Ray Ore in the Accretion Frontier (Pulsar Field); dropped by the Pulsar Wisp (the Accretion Frontier (Pulsar Field)).
Crystal scarred by the tracks of cosmic rays; nuclei flung across the Galaxy by supernova shocks at nearly the speed of light.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_record_f: A sliver of a disc that recorded the Big Bang.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_string_s: A one-dimensional defect from the early universe.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_web_fila: The largest structure there is: filaments of dark matter and gas a hundred million light-years long, with galaxies strung along them like dew on a web.
item.theoreticalsciences.cosmological_co: Lambda: the energy of empty space that pushes the universe apart.
item.theoreticalsciences.cow_record.lore: Neutron counts swinging between the two exits as the interferometer tilts: the fringes gravity draws on a quantum wave.
item.theoreticalsciences.cpt_mirror.lore: Reverses charge, parity and time at once. Through it lies a universe exactly like ours, made of antimatter.
item.theoreticalsciences.crab_chitin.fou: Found: dropped by the Vent Crab (Titan's Hidden Ocean (Hydrothermal Vents)).
item.theoreticalsciences.crab_chitin.lor: A plate of a yeti crab's shell: chitin, the sugar-chain plastic of every shell and insect wing. Dropped by Vent Crabs in Titan's hidden ocean. The Chemical Reactor turns it into polymer sheet (chitosan).
item.theoreticalsciences.crew_capsule.lo: A blunt cone with a ceramic heat shield, a window of leaded glass and one seat. Flown on the Rocket Assembly, it becomes a Fuelled Crew Capsule. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.crown_of_transc: You see everything, because nothing can hide from what is outside it.
Coal hydrogenated under pressure into an oil (the Bergius process): a crude made in a factory instead of a reservoir. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.cryobot.lore: A probe that melts its way down through ice with the heat of a radium core, paying out a tether behind it: NASA's plan for reaching Europa's ocean. Used standing on Titan's Subsurface Seal, it melts through into the hidden ocean below; used there, it climbs its tether back to the surface.
item.theoreticalsciences.cryocooler_unit: A closed-cycle superfluid refrigerator. Superconductors stop superconducting without one.
item.theoreticalsciences.cryogenic_lande: A capsule wrapped in aerogel under a nylon parachute, its oxygen sealed in. Titan's air is so thick and its gravity so weak that a parachute alone brings you down at walking pace; Huygens took two and a half hours to land.
item.theoreticalsciences.cryogenic_recei: An amplifier cooled near absolute zero behind a sapphire window, in a copper feed. The colder it is, the less it hisses over the faint signal from the sky.
item.theoreticalsciences.cryolava_cell.f: Found: in the caches of Cryolab structures in Titan (Sotra Cryovolcanic Field, Xanadu Uplands).
item.theoreticalsciences.cryolava_cell.l: Ammonia and water, melted together far below Titan's surface and pushed up through cryovolcanoes. It flows like a cold glacier, and freezes whatever it touches. Found in the lakes of the Sotra cryovolcanic field. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.cryolava_slug_s: Calls a Cryolava Slug into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.cryptochrome_ma: The protein in a robin's eye that feels Earth's field through entangled radical pairs. Made in the Gene Sequencer.
item.theoreticalsciences.crystalline_mat: Lattices pinned in place by the light of two dead stars. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.d_brane_sheet.l: The surface where open strings end. Our universe might be one. Made in the Compactification Lathe.
item.theoreticalsciences.dark_energy_cel: The energy of empty space itself. It pushes galaxies apart, accelerating the expansion of the universe. Bottled, it fills its flask completely, and the flask seems slightly larger inside than out. It is the largest share of everything, and the least understood. Made in the Eye of the Event Horizon and the Dark Energy Siphon. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.dark_era_haze_c: What is left in the Dark Era, after the last black hole has evaporated: a thin gas of photons, neutrinos and stray leptons, cooling forever. Made in the Entropy Horizon. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.dark_matter_cel: Matter that feels gravity but ignores light. Bottled, it looks like nothing at all; the flask is merely heavier than it should be. Galaxies are wrapped in halos of this, holding them together like an invisible net. Made in the Fractionation Spire, the Quark-Gluon Collider and the Dark Matter Halo Collector. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.dated_amber.lor: Amber from the age of giant insects, dated by the potassium-40 in its ash bed to 310 million years. Made in the Dating Spectrometer.
item.theoreticalsciences.dated_bone.lore: An Ice Age bone, carbon-dated to thirty thousand years: young enough to hold scraps of its DNA. Made in the Dating Spectrometer.
item.theoreticalsciences.dated_stromatol: A stromatolite dated by rubidium-87 to 3.5 billion years: proof of the oldest life, and the cells kept in it. Made in the Dating Spectrometer.
item.theoreticalsciences.de_laval_nozzle: Narrows to a throat, then widens: below the speed of sound gas speeds up as the duct narrows, above it as the duct widens. As a catalyst in the MHD Generator, it runs plasma supersonic. Made in the Wind Tunnel.
item.theoreticalsciences.de_sitter_horiz: A piece of the cosmic horizon of an empty, accelerating universe. It glows at 10^-30 K and holds 10^122 bits. Made in the Entropy Horizon.
item.theoreticalsciences.deep_brine_cell: Ancient salt water from deep rock, many times saltier than the sea and often rich in lithium and boron. It has not seen daylight for millions of years. Found in brine pools deep in the Planetary Interior. Made in the Deep Drilling Rig and the Aquifer Pump. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
A long exposure on a dark, moonless night: faint smudges that are whole galaxies, millions of light-years away.
item.theoreticalsciences.degenerate_armo: Neutronium held at stellar-core pressure by a spacetime-alloy frame. Starlight does not dent it.
item.theoreticalsciences.degenerate_matt: Found: mined from Degenerate Matter Ore in the End.
Electron-degenerate matter from a dead star's core. Absurdly heavy.
item.theoreticalsciences.demiurge_hand.h: Use on an Omnipotence Core in tune to wake it, or on an awake one to let it sleep.
Use on an Omnipotence Core to lift it into your inventory.
Use on an Omnipotence Core to open its attunement: every branch you studied, tuned to this place.
item.theoreticalsciences.demiurge_hand.l: The craftsman of the world had to hold it somehow. The only thing that can tune, wake or move an Omnipotence Core.
item.theoreticalsciences.demiurge_hand.s: Sneak and use in the air to change mode.
item.theoreticalsciences.derivative_oper: Instantaneous rate of change: the slope of a curve at a single point.
item.theoreticalsciences.destabilised_hu: Calls a Destabilised Husk into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
Hydrogen with a neutron in its nucleus, about one atom in 6,400 in seawater. It fuses with tritium more readily than any other pair of nuclei. Made in the Electrolytic Cell and the Mass Spectrometer. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.dice_set.lore: Two fair dice: thirty-six outcomes, eleven totals, and seven the most likely of them.
item.theoreticalsciences.differential_ma: A space that is flat up close and curved far away; the stage on which relativity is written. Made in the Topology Kiln.
item.theoreticalsciences.dilaton_crystal: Found: mined from Dilaton Ore in the Bulk (Graviton Reef).
A frozen value of the string coupling; how strongly strings interact. Grows on the Graviton Reefs of the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.dilithium_cryst: Found: mined from Dilithium Ore in the Nether.
Porous to antimatter. It regulates annihilation reactions.
item.theoreticalsciences.dilithium_singu: 16,384 dilithium crystal, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_res: The leftovers of hyperdimensional work. It is a murky, shifting fluid that contains traces of everything that passed through four dimensions. It is warm and faintly luminous, and it separates into useful fractions if distilled. Made in the Stellar Plasma Crucible, the Universe Forge and the Reality Compiler. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_sin: All eleven dimensions, compressed into none.
Superconducting cable wound into a saddle coil. Its field bends a particle beam into a ring.
item.theoreticalsciences.distillate_of_f: Every force and particle of the mod in one fluid, from quark-gluon plasma to liquid antihelium. The first half of Quintessence. Made in the Universe Forge. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.distillate_of_s: Time, spacetime and the cosmos in one fluid, from chronons and tachyons to the haze of the dark era. The second half of Quintessence. Made in the Universe Forge. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.dodecaract_exca: Breaking a block breaks the whole cube behind it; the drops come to you, folded.
Use on a block (or in the air, around you): every ore in the cube comes to you, folded, and stone takes its place.
Breaks any breakable block at once, stone, wood, earth or Omnipotence Casing, and always keeps the drops.
A cube with twelve dimensions has 4096 corners. One of them is always already inside the rock.
Sneak and use to change mode; sneak and scroll to change the reach.
item.theoreticalsciences.doped_wafer.lor: A wafer with boron diffused into one face and phosphorus into the other: a junction, ready for lithography.
item.theoreticalsciences.dynamic_singula: A singularity of something from another mod (or added by your pack).
item.theoreticalsciences.dyson_shell_seg: A curved plate of a star-enclosing shell. 64 of them close the sphere. Made in the Metamaterial Weaver.
item.theoreticalsciences.dyson_swarm_sat: One of millions. Feed them to a Dyson Array. Made in the Metamaterial Weaver.
item.theoreticalsciences.e8_lattice.lore: The densest way to pack spheres in eight dimensions.
item.theoreticalsciences.echelle_grating: A few dozen grooves to the millimetre ruled steep in an aluminised silica blank, used at high orders: it spreads a star's light into a spectrum a hundred times finer than a prism's.
item.theoreticalsciences.echo_lattice.lo: Echoes of the Transcendental, crossed and woven into a frame that remembers the shape of a world.
item.theoreticalsciences.edta.lore: A claw of a molecule with six grips: it wraps a metal ion and will not let it go.
Found: dropped by the Ice Eel (Titan's Hidden Ocean (Subsurface Ocean, Hydrothermal Vents)).
A light organ from an Ice Eel, still glowing: luciferin and its enzyme, lighting a lure in water that has never seen the Sun. Dropped by Ice Eels in Titan's hidden ocean.
item.theoreticalsciences.eigenstate_latt: The states a measurement is allowed to find, and no others.
item.theoreticalsciences.einstein_field_: Matter tells spacetime how to curve; spacetime tells matter how to move. Both halves, in one core. Made in the Tensor Calculus Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.einstein_ring_l: Found: mined from Einstein Ring Cluster in the Accretion Frontier (Lensing Void); dropped by the Lens Phantom (the Accretion Frontier (Lensing Void)).
A crystal from the Lensing Void that bends light round itself like a mass: a point behind it shows as a ring.
item.theoreticalsciences.einstein_rosen_: Both ends of a bridge between a black hole and a white hole, held in one hand. Made in the Tesseract Assembler.
item.theoreticalsciences.electrical_stee: Thin sheets of silicon steel, insulated from each other, so a changing field cannot drive eddy currents through the core.
item.theoreticalsciences.electride_cryst: A salt whose negative ions are bare electrons sitting in holes in the lattice.
item.theoreticalsciences.empirical_dossi: Every early discovery, written up. A Research Nexus can study it in your place. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
item.theoreticalsciences.empirical_notes: One third of a Research Dossier.
One third of a Research Dossier.
One third of a Research Dossier.
item.theoreticalsciences.empty_set.lore: The set with nothing in it; made from the nothing a Void Wraith leaves behind.
item.theoreticalsciences.enantiopure_rea: A reagent of one hand only. Its mirror image would smell different, taste different, or be poison. Made in the Asymmetric Reactor or on the Chromatography Column.
item.theoreticalsciences.engineered_enzy: A protein designed to speed up exactly one reaction a millionfold.
item.theoreticalsciences.engineered_seed: A seed line selected generation after generation for one trait, which it keeps. Made in the Breeding Bench.
item.theoreticalsciences.entangled_bus_b: Two bars that are one: a current at one end is already at the other.
item.theoreticalsciences.entangled_photo: Measure one and the other already knows.
item.theoreticalsciences.entanglement_tu: Links Entangled Transceivers to one channel. Sneak-use a transceiver to switch it between sending and receiving. Made by crafting.
Swing it and the world remembers how to decay. Any affliction, on one creature or on a place.
item.theoreticalsciences.entropy_die.lor: A die worn perfectly fair. Every face is equally likely, which is to say it carries the most entropy a die can: log₂ 6 bits a throw.
item.theoreticalsciences.epsilon_dust.fo: Found: mined from Epsilon Ore in the Platonic Realm; dropped by the Fourier Wisp (the Platonic Realm).
item.theoreticalsciences.epsilon_dust.lo: For every epsilon there is a delta: grains as small as anyone asks, and smaller. Found in Epsilon Ore in the Continuum (the Platonic Realm, Y 880 to 1040), and dropped by Fourier Wisps. The Analytic Continuator builds Real Continua and Infinitesimals from it.
Omega to the omega to the omega... forever. And still countable. Made in the Ordinal Recursor.
item.theoreticalsciences.equilibrium_lat: Forged with Omnipotence: a law that says this machine does not change. It does not.
item.theoreticalsciences.er_bridge_threa: Two entangled particles, and a wormhole too small to pass through joining them: Einstein-Rosen equals Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen.
item.theoreticalsciences.ergodic_mixer_c: A mixer that visits every state there is, given time, so its average over time is its average over all of them.
item.theoreticalsciences.error_code.lore: A Hamming code woven into a machine's control lines: every slip is caught and set right before it reaches the catalyst. Fitted to a machine, its catalysts wear on only every other run. One upgrade per machine. Made on the Cipher Loom.
item.theoreticalsciences.error_correctio: Thousands of physical qubits standing guard over one logical qubit, voting out every error.
item.theoreticalsciences.eschaton_cell.l: The end of all things, metered out in doses. What the last artefacts burn to stay what they are. Made in the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.
item.theoreticalsciences.eschaton_core.l: The heart of every last thing. Forged by hand in the reborn Core, and once you have, the Eschaton Foundry can make more.
item.theoreticalsciences.eternity_cataly: A crystal that outlasts the universe. Some of the final processes only need it present; others use it up. Made in the Reality Compiler.
item.theoreticalsciences.ethylene_cell.l: C₂H₄: the most made organic chemical in the world. Its double bond is what lets it chain into polyethylene. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.euclidean_ancho: Euclid's fifth postulate, made to hold. Wherever its bearer stands, parallel lines stay parallel.
item.theoreticalsciences.euclidean_shard: Found: mined from Euclidean Ore in the Platonic Realm; dropped by Euclid's Automaton (the Platonic Realm); in the caches of Geometer's Ruins and Compass Towers (the Elements).

A splinter of perfectly straight line: Euclid's first postulate, that between any two points a straight line can be drawn, made solid. Found in Euclidean Ore in the Elements, the Platonic Realm's marble layer (Y 320 to 400), and dropped by Euclid's Automaton. It mends a Platonic Compass at an anvil, and the Geometer's Table draws Golden Ratio Glass with it.
item.theoreticalsciences.euclids_automat: A marble and brass golem that does geometry. It walks only in straight lines and turns on the spot through angles it can construct. Now and then it drives a pin into the ground, walks round it on a cord to draw a circle, then walks the six sides of the hexagon inside it. It fights only whoever hurts it. Found in the Elements (the Platonic Realm, Y 320 to 400).
item.theoreticalsciences.euler_crystal.l: A crystal that grows in proportion to its own size, so it grows by e every unit of time: 2.71828..., the base of every decay and every compound interest. One of the five constants of Euler's identity. Made in the Integrator.
item.theoreticalsciences.eulers_identity: e^(iπ) + 1 = 0: the five most important numbers, from five fields of mathematics, in one line. Proved on the Formal Proof Assistant. As a catalyst it never wears: the Concept Compressor makes a Mathematics Singularity with it from half of the rest (and no Axiom of Choice, Gold Singularity or Topos), and the Proof Assistant a Riemann Zeta Crystal from primes and π.
item.theoreticalsciences.eutectic_brine_: Salt and ice together melt at minus twenty-one degrees; the coldest a mixture of the two can get, and the old way to make ice cream. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.evaporation_fla: Last Flash of a Black Hole
The final second of an evaporating black hole: hotter and brighter the smaller it gets, until nothing is left but the light.
A line of cells bred under pressure until a useful trait took hold and spread through the whole population. Made in the Selection Chamber; the Evolution Engine runs far faster on it.
item.theoreticalsciences.exoplanet_core_: Found: mined from Planetesimal Core Ore in the Accretion Frontier (Asteroid Belt).
Iron and nickel from the core of a planet that formed round another star, and was shattered in a collision long ago.
item.theoreticalsciences.exotic_crystal_: 8,192 exotic matter crystal, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.exotic_matter_c: Matter with negative energy density, the stuff wormholes and warp drives require. It pushes against gravity, bends light the wrong way, and sits in its flask like a pool of shadow that is somehow lighter than air. Made in the Fractionation Spire, the White Hole Emitter and the Eye of the Event Horizon. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
Found: dropped by the Void Wraith.
Negative energy density. It tries to fall upward.
item.theoreticalsciences.exotic_matter_s: Negative mass, antimatter, strange matter and dark matter, compressed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.exotic_solder_c: Solder forged in stellar plasma. Exotic matter gives it negative energy density, quark-gluon plasma gives it strength, and it joins components that ordinary solder would vaporise. It flows like liquid starlight. Made in the Stellar Plasma Crucible. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.false_vacuum_ce: Space in a higher-energy state than it should be, metastable and fragile. Contained, it looks like perfectly clear liquid, but the energy it stores is the energy of an entire universe waiting to tunnel down. I handle it gently. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser, the Eye of the Event Horizon and the Multiverse Rift Stabilizer. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.false_vacuum_me: Found: dropped by the Vacuum Drifter (the Quantum Foam).
The skin of a Vacuum Drifter: the wall between two vacua.
item.theoreticalsciences.faraday_cage_me: A fine copper mesh. Charges in it rearrange until the field inside is zero. Carried in the off hand, it shields you from Decoherence.
item.theoreticalsciences.faraday_isolato: A garnet crystal in a strong magnetic field turns the plane of polarised light; the same way whichever way the light goes. Light passes out; its reflection, turned twice, cannot pass back.
item.theoreticalsciences.femto_capacitor: A Casimir capacitor smaller than a proton.
A superconducting coil wound around nothing.
Found: dropped by the Geodynamo Wraith (the Planetary Interior (Geodynamo Core)).
Iron oxide pressed with clay, fired, then magnetised: cheap, brittle and permanently magnetic.
item.theoreticalsciences.ferrofluid_cell: Magnetic nanoparticles suspended in oil. Near a magnet it rises into spikes along the field lines; NASA developed it in the 1960s to steer rocket fuel in weightlessness. Made in the Chemical Reactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.feynman_diagram: Every possible history, summed. Each line is a particle, each vertex an interaction.
item.theoreticalsciences.field_calibrato: Use on a multiblock controller to restore its containment, clear a fault and read out the ideal tuning value. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.field_ration.lo: A dense sourdough loaf, baked to a crust that keeps for months: a day's food for a field scientist. Eaten, it leaves you Well Fed. Made in the Fermenter.
item.theoreticalsciences.fine_reagent.lo: A pure organic compound made step by careful step; the kind of thing later recipes name exactly.
If information escapes a black hole, the entanglement across its horizon must break, and a broken horizon would burn whatever falls in. A shard of that hypothetical wall of fire.
item.theoreticalsciences.fission_fragmen: Found: mined from Fission Fragment Seam in the Planetary Interior (Natural Reactor), Oklo Reactor Ruin structures in the Planetary Interior (Natural Reactor); dropped by the Fission Husk (the Planetary Interior (Natural Reactor)).
Caesium, strontium, iodine and xenon: what a uranium nucleus becomes when it splits. Two billion years ago, Oklo made this on its own.
item.theoreticalsciences.fission_husk_sp: A heavy, unstable shell of uranium-dark stone. It is always close to splitting, and when it goes it breaks into two lighter pieces and a burst of heat.
item.theoreticalsciences.fixed_point_lat: Gravity's strength, run to ever shorter distances, settles on a fixed value instead of blowing up: a theory safe all the way down.
item.theoreticalsciences.flerovium_ingot: Element 114, held together by magic numbers of protons and neutrons. Made in the Nuclide Forge.
Calcium fluoride grown as one crystal. It bends colours apart less than any glass, so lenses of it bring every colour to one focus.
item.theoreticalsciences.fluorite_lens.l: A lens cut from a fluorite boule along its lattice. Paired with glass it cancels the colour error glass alone cannot.
item.theoreticalsciences.fluorspar.lore: Calcium fluoride, which grows in veins beside calcite. The fluorine that turns uranium into a gas comes from here.
item.theoreticalsciences.folded_matter.l: A mountain, or a battlefield, taken up and folded small. Made by the Dodecaract Excavator and the Omnipotent Edge, which fold what they gather into it; use it to unfold it.
item.theoreticalsciences.folded_protein_: A chain of amino acids that found its one shape out of more than the universe has atoms.
item.theoreticalsciences.form_of_the_sel: Your own ideal form, cut in crystal. Carry it in the Platonic Realm.
item.theoreticalsciences.form_tincture_c: The second stage of Alkahest: what Chemistry knows of shape; bonds seen in spectra, chains, frameworks, crystals. Made in the Alkahest Still. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.formal_proof_tr: Every step justified, every axiom cited. Machines can check it; humans rarely can.
item.theoreticalsciences.fossil_fragment: Found: mined from Fossil Ore in the Overworld.
A piece of bone, its pores filled with mineral. The newest of them are young enough that carbon-14 still ticks inside. Mined from Fossil Ore in the Overworld, and set in the walls of Dig Sites.
Found: dropped by the Fourier Wisp (the Platonic Realm).
Any signal is a sum of waves. This one is a sum of all of them. Made on the Analytic Continuator once Fourier Series is studied.
item.theoreticalsciences.fourier_wisp_sp: A chain of circles turning at one, three and five times a beat; its last point draws a square wave in the air. It keeps its distance and flees if struck. Found in the Continuum (the Platonic Realm, Y 880 to 1040).
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_core.fo: Found: dropped by the Fractal Wyrm (the Platonic Realm).
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_core.lo: The smallest copy of a Fractal Wyrm. It is also the largest.
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_dust.fo: Found: mined from Fractal Ore in the Platonic Realm; dropped by the Fractal Wyrm (the Platonic Realm).
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_dust.lo: Self-similar grit from the Platonic Realm. Every grain contains smaller copies of the whole pile.
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_set.lor: z → z² + c, iterated forever. Infinitely detailed at every scale. Made in the Analytic Continuator.
item.theoreticalsciences.fractal_wyrm_sp: Calls a Fractal Wyrm into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.fractured_essen: Found: dropped by the Destabilised Husk.
A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once.
item.theoreticalsciences.frontier_suit_b: Boots that pull you down where gravity is weak and hold you up where it is strong: you walk normally in the Asteroid Belt and the Pulsar Field.
item.theoreticalsciences.frontier_suit_c: Layers of reflective foil round a coolant loop: the Accretion Rim's heat cannot set you alight.
item.theoreticalsciences.frontier_suit_h: A visor that measures how the light reaching it is bent and unbends it: you see through nebular dust and the Lensing Void's warped sight lines, and a Nebuloid cannot blind you.
item.theoreticalsciences.frontier_suit_l: A frame that takes the stretch for you: the Accretion Rim's tidal pull no longer strains you.
item.theoreticalsciences.frozen_photon.f: Found: mined from Frozen Light Ore in the Black Hole Interior; dropped by the Tidal Horror (the Black Hole Interior).
item.theoreticalsciences.frozen_photon.l: Light that reached the horizon and stopped there, red-shifted to nothing.
item.theoreticalsciences.fuelled_crew_ca: Fuelled, checked and waiting on the pad: climb in and the rocket takes you to the Orbital Station. Made in the Rocket Assembly.
item.theoreticalsciences.fulgurite.found: Found: dropped by the Storm Elemental (the Overworld, over warm seas in a thunderstorm).
item.theoreticalsciences.fulgurite.lore: A crooked tube of glass, rough outside and glassy within: sand melted in an instant by a lightning stroke at 30,000 K. Lightning written in stone. Dropped by Storm Elementals, which form over warm Overworld seas during thunderstorms.
A rule that sends every input to exactly one output; drawn as a curve of light. Made in the Analytic Continuator.
A map between categories that keeps every arrow pointing the right way. Made in the Formal Proof Assistant.
item.theoreticalsciences.fused_silica.lo: Quartz melted in the Solar Furnace and cooled to a glass. It barely expands with heat, so a mirror made of it keeps its figure.
item.theoreticalsciences.fused_silica_le: A lens of fused silica, ground and polished to a quarter of a wavelength. Glass has no lattice: it needs no orientation to cut.
item.theoreticalsciences.fusion_blanket_: Lithium-6 behind lead and graphite. It catches the fusion neutrons, turns their energy into heat, and breeds tritium as it does.
item.theoreticalsciences.g2_manifold.lor: Seven curled-up dimensions whose symmetry is the automorphism group of the octonions. Made in the Compactification Lathe.
item.theoreticalsciences.galactic_filame: A map of the hydrogen in a filament of gas feeding a galaxy; a thread of the cosmic web, at the scale of one galaxy.
item.theoreticalsciences.garnet.found: Found: mined from Garnet Crystal Mass in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns).
item.theoreticalsciences.garnet.lore: Pyrope garnet, born where crust is dragged down and squeezed. Hard, dense and cheap: the grit of every cutting wheel.
item.theoreticalsciences.garnet_boule.lo: A synthetic garnet crystal, grown flawless. Garnets doped with rare earths are the heart of the most common solid-state lasers.
item.theoreticalsciences.gauge_boson_clu: Photon, gluon, W and Z: the carriers of every force except gravity.
item.theoreticalsciences.gauss_meter.lor: A Hall-effect probe: reads the magnetic field where you stand, from the planet's own to a magnet in your hand.
Held in either hand, it clicks for every decay it hears, from what you carry and from the ground around you.
item.theoreticalsciences.geiger_tube.lor: A thin wire in a tube of low-pressure gas at high voltage. One ionising particle and the whole tube avalanches into a click.
item.theoreticalsciences.gene_circuit.lo: Genes wired into a logic gate: a switch that stays where it is put, or a clock that ticks on its own. Life, programmed. Made on the Gene Circuit Loom.
item.theoreticalsciences.gene_sampler.lo: Use on any creature to take a genome sample. Creatures from other dimensions give xenogenome samples. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.general_ai_core: An artificial general intelligence. It asks good questions.
item.theoreticalsciences.genome_sample.l: Every instruction for building one creature, in a vial.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodesic_anchor: Keeps your worldline your own. Without one, the inside of a black or white hole kills you in two seconds. Made by crafting.
Also shields you completely in the Platonic Realm, the Antiverse, the Quantum Foam and the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodesic_compas: A compass that points along the straightest path through curved spacetime, which is the path a falling body takes.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodesic_thread: Found: mined from Geodesic Ore in the Platonic Realm; dropped by the Tessellate (the Platonic Realm).

A thread that is as straight as it can be on a curved surface: on a sphere, a great circle. Found in Geodesic Ore in Curved Space (the Platonic Realm, Y 560 to 720), and dropped by the smallest Tessellates. The Topology Kiln fires a Differential Manifold from it.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodetic_survey: Triangulates the ground around you and lists the ores within 24 blocks, with the nearest of each.
item.theoreticalsciences.geodynamo_wrait: A drifting presence of churning iron and current, the geodynamo given shape. Like Earth's own field, it wanders, and now and then flips its poles.
item.theoreticalsciences.geoid_model.lor: The true shape of the planet: not a sphere, not quite an ellipsoid, but the surface the sea would take if it could flow everywhere.
item.theoreticalsciences.gibberellin_cel: Gibberellic acid: wakes dormant seeds and stretches stems. First found in a rice fungus that made seedlings grow foolishly tall. Made in the Phytotron.
item.theoreticalsciences.glowstone_singu: 32,768 glowstone dust, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.glueball_core.l: A particle made of nothing but the force carriers that hold quarks together.
"This statement cannot be proven." It is true, and no system can prove it. Made in the Cantor Diagonalizer.
item.theoreticalsciences.gold_singularit: 16,384 gold ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.grand_unified_c: At high enough energy the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces are one force again. Made in the Tesseract Assembler.
Carbon one atom thick. Stronger than steel, conducts better than copper.
item.theoreticalsciences.graphite_modera: Nuclear-grade graphite. Carbon slows fission neutrons down without swallowing them, so they can split the next nucleus.
item.theoreticalsciences.gravitational_w: A ripple in spacetime from two merging black holes, caught and frozen mid-oscillation.
Faint repeats after a merger's ringdown, if a horizon is not quite a horizon, the waves bounce. Play it in the Accretion Frontier and something answers.
item.theoreticalsciences.gravitic_lens_e: A dark-matter lens trimmed so its Einstein ring falls exactly where you need it.
item.theoreticalsciences.graviton_crysta: Found: dropped by the Graviton Wisp (the Bulk (Graviton Reef)).
Quantised gravity, frozen into a lattice. Feels heavier than it is.
item.theoreticalsciences.graviton_harnes: Spreads crushing gravity evenly through you. Carry it into high-gravity fields. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.graviton_wisp_c: Found: dropped by the Graviton Wisp (the Bulk (Graviton Reef)).
The heart of a Graviton Wisp: a closed loop of gravity that still pulls on your hand.
item.theoreticalsciences.graviton_wisp_s: Calls a Graviton Wisp into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.greaves_of_the_: Distance is a law. You may keep it or not.
item.theoreticalsciences.grown_organ.lor: A working organ grown from stem cells laid out by a chemical gradient, each cell told where it is and what to become. The fourth piece of the Tree of Life. It dies if carried about too long. Made in the Regeneration Tank.
item.theoreticalsciences.gw_record_bbh.l: A chirp a fifth of a second long: two black holes of thirty suns each spiralling together a billion light-years away.
item.theoreticalsciences.gw_record_bns.l: A minute-long chirp of two neutron stars colliding. Where they merged, gold and platinum were made, and a telescope can still see it glow.
Calcium sulfate, the first salt to come out of an evaporating brine: soft enough to scratch with a fingernail.
item.theoreticalsciences.hadal_anglerfis: A black mouth with a fish around it, hanging still over the floor of the trench with a glowing lure dangled in front of its teeth. In the dark, anything that comes to the only light there is gets eaten. Found in the Hadal Trench, in the Abyss and round the Vent Field.
item.theoreticalsciences.hafnium_178m2_i: A nucleus that holds 2.4 MeV in a high-spin state for thirty-one years: a gram of it stores as much as a tonne of TNT.
item.theoreticalsciences.hafnium_dust.lo: What is left when an isomer gives up its energy: ordinary hafnium.
item.theoreticalsciences.half_turn.lore: e raised to iπ: a turn of half a circle in the complex plane, which lands exactly on −1. Proved on the Formal Proof Assistant from e, i and π; with Unity and Zero it proves Euler's Identity.
item.theoreticalsciences.halite.lore: Rock salt: sodium chloride in clear cubes. The first thing the sea leaves behind that people wanted, and paid soldiers in.
item.theoreticalsciences.hall_bar_chip.l: A strip of two-dimensional electrons at a kelvin and ten tesla. Its Hall resistance sits on plateaus at exactly h/(νe²): a resistance standard set by nature.
item.theoreticalsciences.hamiltonian_ope: Ask it how a system changes and it answers with the energy.
item.theoreticalsciences.hawking_absorbe: Metamaterial tuned to soak up the thermal glow a black hole gives off as it evaporates.
item.theoreticalsciences.hawking_emitter: Channels the thermal glow of an evaporating horizon.
item.theoreticalsciences.hawking_imp_spa: A small creature forever evaporating. Like a black hole, the smaller it gets the hotter it glows and the faster it radiates itself away.
Found: dropped by the Hawking Imp (the Accretion Frontier (Asteroid Belt, Molecular Cloud Nebula, Lensing Void ...)).
The last light of a tiny black hole, caught as it evaporated. Hotter the smaller the hole was.
item.theoreticalsciences.hawking_radiati: The faint glow of a black hole evaporating. Pairs of particles at the horizon are split, one falls in and the other escapes, carrying away a sliver of the black hole's mass. It is thermal, dim and cold, and in it the hole slowly dies. Made in the Kugelblitz Chamber, the Micro Black Hole Evaporator and the Penrose Ergosphere Generator. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
Phonon pairs straddling a sonic horizon, one on each side, correlated as Hawking said they must be: the glow of a horizon, seen.
item.theoreticalsciences.heat_death_embe: The last warmth of a universe going cold: a little above the temperature of its own horizon, and falling. Made in the Entropy Horizon.
item.theoreticalsciences.heat_death_remn: All that is left of a universe at maximum entropy. Cold, even and perfectly still. Made in the Universe Forge.
item.theoreticalsciences.heated_pressure: A pressure suit lined with silica aerogel and threaded with heating wire: Titan's 94 K cannot get in. Each piece keeps out a quarter of the cold; a full suit, all of it. Methane rain still soaks the lining unless the piece is coated. Made by crafting a Pressure Suit piece with silica aerogel and redstone.

A pressure suit lined with silica aerogel and threaded with heating wire: Titan's 94 K cannot get in. Each piece keeps out a quarter of the cold; a full suit, all of it. Methane rain still soaks the lining unless the piece is coated. Made by crafting a Pressure Suit piece with silica aerogel and redstone.

A pressure suit lined with silica aerogel and threaded with heating wire: Titan's 94 K cannot get in. Each piece keeps out a quarter of the cold; a full suit, all of it. Methane rain still soaks the lining unless the piece is coated. Made by crafting a Pressure Suit piece with silica aerogel and redstone.

A pressure suit lined with silica aerogel and threaded with heating wire: Titan's 94 K cannot get in. Each piece keeps out a quarter of the cold; a full suit, all of it. Methane rain still soaks the lining unless the piece is coated. Made by crafting a Pressure Suit piece with silica aerogel and redstone.
item.theoreticalsciences.heavy_radiation: Lead, graphite and boron carbide, which swallows the slowed neutrons. A plated piece stops 25% of the dose; four of them, all but 5%.
item.theoreticalsciences.heavy_water_cel: Water whose hydrogen is deuterium. It is about 11% denser than ordinary water, freezes at 3.8 °C, and slows neutrons without swallowing them. Made in the Electrolytic Cell. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.heliostat_mirro: A flat silvered mirror on a two-axis mount that turns with the Sun, so its reflection stays on one spot all day.
item.theoreticalsciences.higgs_boson_cry: An excitation of the field that gives everything its mass, frozen before it could decay. Made in the Hyperion Synchrotron.
A pinned Higgs-field bubble. Spent in making spin foam, pulsar crystals and wormhole throats. Made in the Higgs Field Modulator.
item.theoreticalsciences.higgs_field_cap: Stores a local excitation of the Higgs field. Handles mass.
item.theoreticalsciences.hilbert_bellhop: Calls a Hilbert Bellhop into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.holographic_mat: A 3D object stored entirely on its 2D boundary.
item.theoreticalsciences.holographic_scr: A surface that holds everything in the volume behind it, one bit per four Planck areas.
A 3-sphere unwound into circles, every two of them linked.
item.theoreticalsciences.horizon_diver.l: Crosses an event horizon, inward. Use again to come back out, which should be impossible. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.horizon_shard.l: A sliver of event horizon brought back out of a simulated universe. Everything that falls into it is remembered. Made in the Eye of the Event Horizon.
item.theoreticalsciences.hotel_key.found: Found: dropped by the Hilbert Bellhop (the Platonic Realm).
item.theoreticalsciences.hotel_key.lore: Opens room n+1. There is always a room n+1.
item.theoreticalsciences.humus.lore: Leaves rotted down past recognition into dark, crumbly organic matter, rich in charged sites that hold nutrients. Made in the Mycelium Bed.
item.theoreticalsciences.hydrogen_cell.l: The lightest gas and the most common thing in the Universe. Here it comes from coal and steam: C + H₂O → CO + H₂. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.hydrogen_cyanid: A trace in the nebula and a poison on Earth, and, with ammonia, the first step to amino acids. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.hydrogen_line_m: A chart of the 21-centimetre glow of cold hydrogen across the Galaxy. The line's Doppler shift gives how fast each cloud moves.
item.theoreticalsciences.hydrophobic_coa: Found: dropped by the Methane Skater (Titan (Kraken Mare, Ontario Lacus Basin)).

A fluorinated polymer in silica: a surface rough on the scale of nanometres and slick on the scale of molecules. Water beads on it, and, harder, so does liquid methane, which wets almost everything else. Use it while wearing armour to coat each piece.
item.theoreticalsciences.hypercube_drift: Calls a Hypercube Drifter into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.hyperdimensiona: A crystal that extends a little way into the fourth dimension.
A die that is larger on the inside.
Circuits laid out in four dimensions, folded flat.
A pearl that teleports to everywhere at once.
Tier IV processor. Its logic gates take inputs from directions that do not exist. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
A wafer with more surface than its area allows.
item.theoreticalsciences.hyperlattice_fr: A scaffold folded through a fourth dimension, so a nine-by-nine assembly has room for its insides.
item.theoreticalsciences.hypernova_alloy: Forged in a plasma hotter than a collapsing star. Still glowing, and always will be.
item.theoreticalsciences.hypernova_plasm: Plasma from the most violent explosions in the universe. Hypernovae release more energy than ordinary supernovae and leave behind black holes. The plasma is hotter and denser than any star's core, and it wants to escape. Made in the Transcendent Plasma Forge. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.hyperon_crystal: Strange baryons locked into a lattice. The strangeness makes them heavier than they have any right to be. Made in the Hyperion Synchrotron.
item.theoreticalsciences.hypersphere_fra: Found: mined from Hyperspherical Ore in the Platonic Realm; dropped by the Hypercube Drifter (the Platonic Realm).
A curved piece of a sphere with a 3-dimensional surface.
item.theoreticalsciences.ice_core.lore: A cylinder of ice drilled from a glacier. Every layer is a year of snow, and its trapped bubbles are samples of the air of that year.
item.theoreticalsciences.ice_eel_spawn_e: A long dark eel with lights down its sides, hunting grazers, and biting whoever comes too close. Three meals and it spawns another; a day with none and it starves. The predator of Titan's hidden ocean. Found in Titan's hidden ocean.
item.theoreticalsciences.identity_kernel: The smallest thing that is still you. Carry it in the Transcendental.
Also shields you completely in every other dimension.
The square root of minus one, distilled from the imaginary mass of a tachyon, or (from Euler's formula) worked out on the Integrator from π, e and Rational Fields.
item.theoreticalsciences.immortal_cell_l: Found: dropped by the Tumour Hydra.
Telomerase switched back on: the chromosome ends rebuild themselves, and the cells forget how to grow old. They have outlived their donor.
item.theoreticalsciences.inaccessible_ca: An infinity so large nothing smaller can build it.
Cancels momentum locally. Standard issue on every starship.
item.theoreticalsciences.infinitesimal.l: Smaller than every positive number, yet not zero. Made in the Analytic Continuator.
item.theoreticalsciences.inflaton_conden: A scalar field held at the top of its potential, rolling so slowly that space doubles many times before it moves. Made in the Inflation Chamber.
item.theoreticalsciences.inflaton_field_: The field that drove cosmic inflation, stretching the universe exponentially in a fraction of a second. Bottled, it trembles with stored expansion, as if wanting to make everything around it larger. It is hot, restless and very light. Made in the Fractionation Spire, the Eye of the Event Horizon and the Multiverse Rift Stabilizer. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.integer_ring.lo: The naturals, plus their antimatter reflections: every number now has a negative. Made in the Peano Arithmetic Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.integral_operat: The area under a curve, summed from infinitely many infinitesimal slices. Made in the Analytic Continuator.
item.theoreticalsciences.interstellar_du: Found: mined from Dust Cloud in the Accretion Frontier; mined from Dusty Ice in the Accretion Frontier (Molecular Cloud Nebula); dropped by the Nebuloid (the Accretion Frontier (Asteroid Belt, Molecular Cloud Nebula)).
Grains of silicate and soot a tenth of a micron across, coated in ice. A hundredth of the interstellar medium by mass, and what every rocky planet was made of.
item.theoreticalsciences.interstellar_me: The thin gas between the stars, about one atom per cubic centimetre: a better vacuum than any made on Earth, yet the stuff new stars are born from. Made in the Interstellar Scoop. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.ion_channel_mem: A bilayer studded with channels that open for one kind of ion only, so a voltage builds across it: the cell's battery. Made on the Patch-Clamp Rig; the Ribosome Assembler builds Synthetic Cells with it.
item.theoreticalsciences.ionic_liquid_ce: A salt that is liquid at room temperature. It conducts electricity, does not evaporate, and dissolves almost anything. It is clear, slightly viscous and faintly warm. Chemists call such salts designer solvents, because they can be tuned for almost any task. Made in the Electrolytic Cell. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.iron_catalyst.l: Magnetite reduced to a sponge of iron, with a little potash and alumina to keep its grains apart: the catalyst that feeds half the world, by fixing nitrogen into ammonia.
item.theoreticalsciences.iron_singularit: 16,384 iron ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.island_fragment: A region inside the horizon that belongs, after the Page time, to the radiation outside: the island that makes the curve turn over.
item.theoreticalsciences.kaluza_klein_sh: Found: mined from Kaluza-Klein Ore in the Bulk (Moduli Wastes, Graviton Reef); dropped by the Brane Strider (the Bulk (Moduli Wastes, Graviton Reef)).
Momentum around a fifth dimension curled up too small to see. Mined in the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.kaluza_klein_si: 16,384 kaluza klein shard, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.karman_wraith_s: The wake of something no longer there: a ribbon of air that rides the Jet Stream, rippling from side to side at a steady beat and shedding eddies on alternate sides, a vortex street in the shape of a creature. It sings like a wire in the wind, and throws gusts at whatever comes near. Found in the Jet Stream, above Y 200 in the Accretion Frontier.
item.theoreticalsciences.kekule_ring.lor: A ring of six carbons whose electrons belong to the whole ring at once: aromatic, and far more stable than its bonds alone would make it. Dropped by the Ouroboros. Held as a catalyst in the Polymeriser (it never wears), it makes Aramid Fibre from Organic Evaporite.
item.theoreticalsciences.kekules_dream.l: In 1865 August Kekule dozed by the fire and dreamt of a snake that seized its own tail, and woke knowing that benzene's six carbons make a ring. Use it in Titan's Selk Crater to call the Ouroboros.
item.theoreticalsciences.kerr_metric_sha: The exact geometry around a spinning black hole, ergosphere and all.
item.theoreticalsciences.kilonova_ash.lo: Gold, platinum and lanthanides made in a second by the rapid neutron capture of a neutron-star merger, and thrown out at a fifth of the speed of light.
item.theoreticalsciences.klein_bottle.lo: A bottle with no inside. It only fits together in four dimensions.
item.theoreticalsciences.kugelblitz_seed: Enough focused light to collapse on itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.lapis_singulari: 32,768 lapis lazuli, crushed into one point.
An intellect that knows every force and every position. Shown a machine, it knows exactly how the machine must be run.
item.theoreticalsciences.large_deviation: A record of something that was not supposed to happen, and the exponentially small odds it beat.
item.theoreticalsciences.laser_head.lore: A laser rod between two mirrors, pumped by a flash of light, behind a Faraday isolator so no reflection can come back into it. A single frequency, steady for hours.
item.theoreticalsciences.laser_rod.lore: Garnet doped with neodymium, cut along its lattice and polished flat at both ends. Pumped with light, it gives back more light than it took in, all of one colour: infrared at 1064 nanometres.
item.theoreticalsciences.lasting_ward_fr: A Ward that leaves lasting memory behind: use it on yourself and you are held safe from Fracture for good. Made on the Antibody Bench, after Immune Memory.
item.theoreticalsciences.lasting_ward_gr: A Ward that leaves lasting memory behind: use it on yourself and you are held safe from Grey Goo for good. Made on the Antibody Bench, after Immune Memory.
item.theoreticalsciences.lasting_ward_ho: A Ward that leaves lasting memory behind: use it on yourself and you are held safe from Hollowing for good. Made on the Antibody Bench, after Immune Memory.
item.theoreticalsciences.lasting_ward_me: A Metastasis Ward that leaves lasting memory behind: use it on yourself and you are held safe from Metastasis for good. Made in the Clonal Selector, after Immune Memory.
item.theoreticalsciences.lasting_ward_re: A Ward that leaves lasting memory behind: use it on yourself and you are held safe from Rewind for good. Made on the Antibody Bench, after Immune Memory.
item.theoreticalsciences.lattice_seed.lo: A flawless crystal nucleus. Boules grow from it atom by atom.
item.theoreticalsciences.laue_pattern.lo: A photographic plate exposed to X-rays scattered by a crystal: a pattern of spots that shows how its lattice planes lie. Cut along them. Made in the X-ray Diffractometer.
item.theoreticalsciences.law_crystal.fou: Found: dropped by the Law Wraith.
item.theoreticalsciences.law_crystal.lor: A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop.
item.theoreticalsciences.law_violation_s: A sliver of space where a conservation law quietly fails: charge appears from nothing, and the rest of physics has to make room. Made in the Anomaly Containment Ward.
item.theoreticalsciences.law_wraith_spaw: Calls a Law Wraith into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.lawgivers_codex: Blank, until you write. Then the place you stand in obeys what you wrote.
item.theoreticalsciences.lead_pig.lore: A thick lead pot for Technetium-99m. Out in the open its vials are gone within a minute; inside, they wait.
item.theoreticalsciences.lead_shielding_: Dense, soft and cheap. Each centimetre of lead halves a gamma ray's chance of getting through.
item.theoreticalsciences.lens_phantom_sp: Nearly invisible: it is seen only by how it bends the light behind it into arcs and rings, the way unseen dark matter betrays itself to telescopes.
item.theoreticalsciences.lense_thirring_: A knot of spacetime twisted round by a spinning mass: anything near it is dragged round with it.
Electron, muon and tau, with a neutrino shadowing each.
item.theoreticalsciences.lie_group_latti: A smooth group of symmetries, turnable by any amount: the kind that the forces of physics are built on (U(1), SU(2), SU(3)). Made on the Symmetry Lathe.
item.theoreticalsciences.light_radiation: Lead plate shaped to fit armour. Put it with any armour piece in a crafting grid: that piece then stops 10% of the radiation dose.
item.theoreticalsciences.light_sail.lore: A sail of aluminised film a few microns thick, pushed by nothing but the pressure of starlight. Unfurl it high above the world, where there is no air left to drag on it, and it carries you out to the Accretion Frontier.
item.theoreticalsciences.lipid_bilayer.f: Found: dropped by the Macrophage (Inner Space (Tumour, Bloodstream, Lymph Node ...)).
item.theoreticalsciences.lipid_bilayer.l: Two sheets of fat molecules, tails inward, heads out to the water: the skin of every cell, five nanometres thick and self-sealing. Made on the Patch-Clamp Rig from egg yolk lecithin.
item.theoreticalsciences.liquid_antiheli: Antihelium cooled to a liquid. Only a handful of antihelium nuclei have ever been detected in collider debris; a whole pool of it should not exist. Made in the Mirror Matter Foundry. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.liquid_hydrogen: H₂ at 20 K, a fourteenth as dense as water: the best rocket fuel there is, and the hardest to keep. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
