item.theoreticalsciences.liquid_methane_: CH₄ at 94 K, with a little ethane and nitrogen dissolved in it: the stuff of Titan's seas, rivers and rain. Less than half as dense as water, and too thin to swim in. Found in Titan's seas and lakes. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.liquid_oxygen_c: O₂ at 90 K, pale blue and drawn to a magnet. Half of every rocket's propellant. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser.
item.theoreticalsciences.liquid_sodium_c: Sodium melted at 98 °C. It carries heat far better than water and boils only at 883 °C, which is why fast reactors use it as coolant, though it burns in air. Made in the Electrolytic Cell. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.liquid_spacetim: Spacetime itself, flowing like a liquid. Distances inside it are fluid, and it ripples with gravitational waves when disturbed. It is cold and has no colour, only the distortion of what is behind it. Poured, it bends the light of the room around the stream. Made in the Eye of the Event Horizon. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.lithium_6_ingot: Lithium enriched in its lighter isotope. One neutron splits it into helium and tritium, which is how a fusion blanket breeds its fuel.
item.theoreticalsciences.lithium_carbona: A white powder from the last of an evaporated brine, where the lithium waits after everything else has crystallised.
item.theoreticalsciences.lithium_ingot.l: The lightest metal, won from brine. Soft enough to cut with a knife; it floats on oil and burns crimson.
item.theoreticalsciences.lithospheric_pl: Rock from the base of a tectonic plate, where the cold, rigid lithosphere rides on the soft mantle below.
item.theoreticalsciences.litz_wire.lore: Hundreds of thin copper strands, each insulated and woven so every one takes its turn at the outside: at high frequency current crowds to a wire's skin, and this gives it more skin.
item.theoreticalsciences.living_catalyst: An enzyme in a living cell that remakes it as fast as it wears: a catalyst that never quite runs down while it is fed. Used as a catalyst, it heals its own wear. Made on the Gene Circuit Loom.
item.theoreticalsciences.living_cell.lor: A membrane holding a working machine inside: ribosomes, enzymes and a charge across its skin, burning sugar for its living. The first piece of the Tree of Life. It dies if carried about too long. Made on the Patch-Clamp Rig.
item.theoreticalsciences.living_soil.lor: Humus, biochar and fungi together: a soil that feeds its crop. High-yield seed lines need it. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.logos_thread.lo: A strand of the Word that orders the world. Wound into a coil it makes space obey a shape.
item.theoreticalsciences.lonsdaleite.lor: Hexagonal diamond, made only in the shock of an impact; harder, in places, than diamond itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.lorentz_transfo: Lengths shrink and clocks slow as you approach light speed. This crystal is always moving at 0.99c. Made in the Tensor Calculus Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.luminous_mesogl: Found: dropped by the Brine Jelly (Titan's Hidden Ocean (Subsurface Ocean, Hydrothermal Vents)).

The clear jelly of a brine jelly's bell, still faintly glowing: almost all water, held in a web of collagen. Dropped by Brine Jellies in Titan's hidden ocean. It lights membranes, and the Chemical Reactor draws a gel from it.
item.theoreticalsciences.m_brane.lore: A two-dimensional membrane of M-theory. Whole universes can live on one.
item.theoreticalsciences.m_theory_core.l: Eleven dimensions, and all five string theories turn out to be one. Made in the Compactification Lathe.
item.theoreticalsciences.macrophage_spaw: The big eater: a slow cell that engulfs whatever it catches and digests it. Caught, you are held inside and dissolved until you strike your way out; items and red cells it simply eats (and gives the items back when it dies). It goes for the Tumour Hydra too, as macrophages go for a real tumour. Found in Inner Space's Tissue and Bloodstream.
item.theoreticalsciences.magma_crawler_s: Calls a Magma Crawler into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.magnetar_crust_: Found: mined from Magnetar Crust Ore in the Accretion Frontier (Pulsar Field).
Iron crust from a magnetar, under a field of 10¹¹ tesla. It cracks in starquakes, and it still bends compass needles from across a room.
Its magnetic field would wipe a credit card from the Moon.
item.theoreticalsciences.magnetic_monopo: A north pole with no south. Dirac would be pleased.
item.theoreticalsciences.magnetite.found: Found: mined from Core Magnetite Ore in the Planetary Interior (Geodynamo Core); dropped by the Geodynamo Wraith (the Planetary Interior (Geodynamo Core)).
item.theoreticalsciences.magnetite.lore: Fe₃O₄, the most magnetic mineral there is. Struck by lightning it becomes lodestone; ground up it becomes ferrite.
item.theoreticalsciences.magnetized_plas: Plasma threaded by magnetic field lines. Its charged particles spiral along them and cannot cross, so a field can hold a gas hotter than the Sun's core. Made in the Tokamak. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.mammoth_capsule: A young Woolly Mammoth asleep in its transport capsule. Use it on the ground to let it go: it is wild, and stays wild. Made in the Revival Vat.
Three billion letters of Mammuthus primigenius, pieced together from fragments fifty letters long. Made in the Ancient DNA Lab.
item.theoreticalsciences.mammoth_ivory.f: Found: dropped by the Woolly Mammoth, when a player brings it down.
item.theoreticalsciences.mammoth_ivory.l: Dentine from a spiralling tusk, its growth rings counting out the years of the animal's life. Dropped by Woolly Mammoths killed by a player. Tusk dentine keeps DNA far better than bone: the Ancient DNA Lab reads a whole Mammoth Genome from one piece.
item.theoreticalsciences.mammoth_wool.fo: Found: dropped by the Woolly Mammoth.
item.theoreticalsciences.mammoth_wool.lo: A metre-long outer coat over dense underwool: what kept the mammoth warm through the Ice Age. Dropped by Woolly Mammoths. Spread over living soil, it seeds a mammoth steppe: a Stable Ecosystem, grown in the Ecosphere.
item.theoreticalsciences.mantle_of_omnip: Harm needs a law to happen by. You are wearing all of them.
item.theoreticalsciences.markov_chain_li: A link that remembers only the one before it. Chain enough of them and the past stops mattering at all.
The Higgs field has been told to ignore it.
item.theoreticalsciences.mathematics_sin: Every number, function, proof and infinity, compressed into one point. Made in the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.
item.theoreticalsciences.mathesis_cell.l: Leibniz dreamed of a mathesis universalis, a science of everything worked out as one calculation. Here it is: chance, shape and the infinite in a single fluid. Made in the Conceptual Singularity Compressor, with Euler's Identity as its catalyst. One of the five fluids of Pleroma. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.matrix_fibre.fo: Found: mined from Collagen Seam in Inner Space (Bloodstream, Lymph Node, Tissue); dropped by the Macrophage (Inner Space (Tumour, Bloodstream, Lymph Node ...)).
item.theoreticalsciences.matrix_fibre.lo: Collagen, the rope that holds a body together: three chains wound round each other into a fibre stronger than steel for its weight. Found in collagen seams in Inner Space's tissue. The Regeneration Tank spins more from tissue and bone.
item.theoreticalsciences.matured_antibod: An antibody bred over many rounds of selection, each round keeping only the clones that bind best, until it fits its target a thousand times more tightly. Made in the Clonal Selector.
item.theoreticalsciences.maxwell_boltzma: An ideal gas whose molecular speeds follow the Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution: most move near the typical speed, with a long thin tail of very fast ones. Made in the Markov Chain Refinery. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.maxwell_demon_c: A tiny intelligence that opens a door for fast molecules only. Thermodynamics objects. Made in Maxwell's Demon Sorter.
item.theoreticalsciences.medium_radiatio: Lead backed with graphite, which slows the neutrons lead lets through. A plated piece stops 18% of the dose.
item.theoreticalsciences.meganeura_capsu: A Meganeura, wings folded, in a capsule of high-oxygen air. Use it on the ground to let it go: it will patrol the place it was released. Made in the Revival Vat.
item.theoreticalsciences.meganeura_genom: The genome of a Carboniferous griffinfly, from tissue sealed in amber for 310 million years: impossible, and yet here it is. Made in the Ancient DNA Lab.
A wing of chitin film thirty-five centimetres long, pleated like a fan for strength. Its chitin can be made into Polymer Sheet in the Chemical Reactor. Dropped by Meganeura.
item.theoreticalsciences.memory_cell.fou: Found: dropped by the T Cell (Inner Space (Tumour, Nucleus, Lymph Node)).
item.theoreticalsciences.memory_cell.lor: A lymphocyte that has met an invader once and never forgets it: years later it wakes and answers in hours. Dropped by T Cells and kept in the Germinal Centres of Inner Space's Lymph Node; the Antibody Bench raises more from lymph tissue.
What is left when two compact stars become one: a single spinning hole, ringing down to stillness.
item.theoreticalsciences.messenger_rna.f: Found: dropped by the Polymerase (Inner Space (Nucleus)).
item.theoreticalsciences.messenger_rna.l: A working copy of one gene, read off the DNA to be carried to a ribosome: the message between the genome and the protein. Made on the Ribosome Assembler.
item.theoreticalsciences.metal_organic_f: Metal nodes, organic struts: a sponge with more inner surface than a football pitch per gram. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.metallic_hydrog: Hydrogen compressed until it becomes a metal. At pressures found in the cores of gas giants, the electrons break free and conduct like copper. It flows silvery and heavy, and may be a room-temperature superconductor. Made in the Neutron Star Forge and the Eye of the Event Horizon. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
Hydrogen crushed until it conducts like a metal. Metastable, probably.
item.theoreticalsciences.metamaterial_sh: Negative refractive index. Light bends the wrong way.
item.theoreticalsciences.metamorphic_sch: Basalt pressed and baked until its minerals regrew as flat, glittering mica, with the odd red garnet among them. Made in the Tectonic Press.
item.theoreticalsciences.metastable_vacu: The Higgs potential mapped out to the Planck scale: the valley we live in is not the deepest one. Held in a lattice of Higgs field capacitors. Made in the Higgs Field Modulator.
item.theoreticalsciences.metastatic_spor: Found: dropped by the Tumour Hydra.

A cluster of cells that has learned to leave: to slip its tissue, ride the blood and grow again somewhere it was never meant to be. Used in the Tumour of Inner Space, it takes hold and calls the Tumour Hydra.
item.theoreticalsciences.meteoric_iron.f: Found: mined from Iron Meteorite in Meteorite Crater structures in the Overworld.
item.theoreticalsciences.meteoric_iron.l: Iron and nickel from the core of a planetesimal that shattered billions of years ago. Etched, it shows crossed plates that grew only a degree in a million years.
item.theoreticalsciences.methane_cell.fo: Found: in the caches of Abandoned Refinery structures in Titan (Ontario Lacus Basin, Kraken Mare).
item.theoreticalsciences.methane_cell.lo: CH₄, the simplest hydrocarbon: the cloud's carbon, the Fuel Cell's fuel, and a Cracking Tower's feed. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.methane_skater_: Calls a Methane Skater into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.methanol_cell.l: Wood alcohol: made from carbon monoxide and hydrogen over copper, and a fuel and solvent in its own right. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.metric_tensor.l: g_μν: the rule for measuring distance in curved spacetime. Made in the Tensor Calculus Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.micro_singulari: A black hole the mass of a mountain, smaller than an atom. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.microenvironmen: An anomaly is never alone: here it has grown its own blood vessels, recruited its own stroma and taught the local immune cells to look away.
item.theoreticalsciences.microgravity_cr: Grown in free fall, where no current stirs the melt and no weight strains the lattice: not one dislocation in it. Made in the Rocket Assembly.
item.theoreticalsciences.microgravity_la: A sealed furnace and cold plate, launched to orbit and brought back. In free fall nothing settles and nothing convects, so crystals grow without flaws. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.microstate_tall: A count of the ways a system can be arranged and still look the same from outside: Boltzmann's W, whose logarithm is entropy. Made in the Peano Engine; the Maxwell Demon Sorter reads it.
item.theoreticalsciences.miniaturiser.lo: A ring of lenses round a capsule, after the 1966 film Fantastic Voyage: it shrinks whoever stands in it until a body's cells are the size of houses, and sets them down inside one. Used in the Overworld it takes you into Inner Space; used there, it brings you back out.
item.theoreticalsciences.minkowski_latti: Space and time as one four-dimensional geometry, with light cones at every point. Made in the Tensor Calculus Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.mirror_alloy_in: Matter and antimatter in alternating grains, a Penning field between every pair. It hums. Made in the Mirror Matter Foundry.
item.theoreticalsciences.mirror_antibody: An antibody built mirror-handed, the one shape that fits a mirror microbe. Use it on yourself: held safe from the Mirror Plague of the Antiverse's Mirror Microbes for three in-game days (no other ward holds it). Made in the Mirror Culture Vat.
item.theoreticalsciences.mirror_cell.fou: Found: dropped by the Mirror Microbe.
item.theoreticalsciences.mirror_cell.lor: A cell built left-handed where life is right, and right where life is left: its own mirror image. Nothing alive can eat it, and it can eat nothing alive. It dies if carried about too long. Made in the Mirror Culture Vat.
item.theoreticalsciences.mirror_microbe_: A bacterium built mirror-handed, as everything in the Antiverse is. Nothing alive can digest it, and nothing in a body can grip it: its touch gives the Mirror Plague, which no Anomaly Ward holds. Only a Mirror Antibody wards it. Found drifting in the Antiverse.
item.theoreticalsciences.mirror_processo: Antisilicon logic on an anticarbon die: it computes with positrons. Made in the Mirror Matter Foundry.
item.theoreticalsciences.mobius_strip.lo: One side, one edge. Walk along it and you come back upside down.
item.theoreticalsciences.mod_essence_cel: Every fluid of one mod distilled together into a single liquid. It tastes, reportedly, of everything its authors ever put in a tank. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.modular_form.lo: A function so symmetric it is called "the fifth fundamental operation of arithmetic".
item.theoreticalsciences.moduli_crawler_: Calls a Moduli Crawler into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
Found: mined from Moduli Ore in the Bulk (Moduli Wastes); dropped by the Moduli Crawler (the Bulk (Moduli Wastes)).
The shape and size of the hidden dimensions, crystallised. Found in the Moduli Wastes of the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.mof_gas_sorbent: A zinc framework whose pores are just wide enough for one methane molecule: a gram of it has the inner surface of a tennis court.
item.theoreticalsciences.moissanite.foun: Found: mined from Moissanite Crystal Mass in the Planetary Interior (Mantle Convection Zone).
item.theoreticalsciences.moissanite.lore: Silicon carbide, found in nature only in a few meteorites and in mantle rock. Harder than any gem but diamond, and far tougher: a drill bit of it cuts iron.
item.theoreticalsciences.moissanite_dril: A moissanite-tipped drill on a netherite shank: it mines Iron-Nickel and Core Magnetite Ore, which nothing softer can.
item.theoreticalsciences.moissanite_lens: Silicon carbide bends light more than diamond does: a moissanite lens is strong for its thickness, and it fires rainbows.
item.theoreticalsciences.molecular_cloud: Cold, dense gas where hydrogen pairs into molecules and dust shields them from starlight. At ten kelvin it collapses, slowly, into new stars. Made in the Electrolytic Cell, the Cloud Siphon and the Interstellar Scoop. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.molecular_orbit: Electron wavefunctions shared between atoms, frozen into a grid. This is what a chemical bond is. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.molten_salt_fue: Uranium and plutonium dissolved in molten fluoride salt, fuel and coolant at once, flowing at low pressure. Oak Ridge ran a reactor on it from 1965 to 1969. Made in the Chelation Column and the Gas Centrifuge Cascade. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.monazite_sand.l: Heavy golden grains sorted out of beach sand: a phosphate of the rare earths, with a little thorium that keeps it faintly radioactive.
item.theoreticalsciences.monte_carlo_sam: A billion random points, drawn and sorted: the answer to an integral too hard to do any other way, to a part in thirty thousand.
item.theoreticalsciences.morphogenic_ser: Every signal an embryo listens to, in one vial. A Breached Anomaly Engine spends one on every creature it grows.
item.theoreticalsciences.mould_culture.l: Penicillium, the blue-green mould on old bread. Fleming saw it kill the bacteria around it in 1928. It dies if carried about too long. Made on the Mycelium Bed.
item.theoreticalsciences.mu_metal_shield: Four parts nickel to one of iron, annealed in hydrogen: so permeable that a magnetic field would rather run through it than past what it shields. Carried in the off hand, it keeps you from being Magnetized.
item.theoreticalsciences.multiverse_shar: Matter from a universe with slightly different constants. Its colour will not settle. Made in the Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector.
item.theoreticalsciences.muonic_catalyst: Swap an electron for a muon and atoms shrink 200 times; close enough to fuse cold. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.mycorrhizal_ino: Fungal threads that wrap a plant's roots and reach far past them, trading phosphate and water for the plant's sugar. Made in the Mycelium Bed.
item.theoreticalsciences.nanite_slurry_c: A suspension of microscopic machines in water. The slurry moves on its own, shifting patterns across its surface as the nanites communicate. It feels faintly gritty and warm. Left in a bucket overnight, it rearranges itself into neat geometric ridges by morning. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.nanite_swarm.fo: Found: dropped by the Nanite Swarm.
item.theoreticalsciences.nanite_swarm.lo: A billion machines the size of viruses. Hungry.
item.theoreticalsciences.nanite_swarm_sp: Calls a Nanite Swarm into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
Superhuman at one thing; useless at everything else.
item.theoreticalsciences.natural_number_: One, two, three... Peano built all of arithmetic from zero and "the next one".
item.theoreticalsciences.nebular_gas_cel: Cold, dusty gas from which stars are born. It is mostly hydrogen and helium, drifting in faint clouds that glow when lit by nearby stars. It is light and very cold. Given enough of it and enough time, gravity would gather it into a new sun. It is the raw material of every star. Made in the Dark Matter Halo Collector. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.nebuloid_spawn_: Calls a Nebuloid into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.negative_energy: Casimir cavities stacked by the million: in each, the vacuum between the plates holds less energy than the vacuum outside.
item.theoreticalsciences.negative_mass_i: Push it and it comes toward you.
item.theoreticalsciences.negentropy_cell: Order, bottled. Entropy flows backwards inside. Made in the Maxwell's Demon Sorter.
item.theoreticalsciences.nematocyst_clus: Found: dropped by the Siphonophore Colony (the Hadal Trench).

Stinging capsules from a siphonophore's tentacles. Each fires a coiled, barbed thread at 40,000 g, the fastest motion any living thing makes, held back by a spring of pressure that engineers study. Dropped by Siphonophore Colonies in the Hadal Abyss.
item.theoreticalsciences.neodymium_blank: Nd₂Fe₁₄B, cast and pressed, not yet magnetised. Its crystals all point the same way, waiting for a field strong enough to set them.
item.theoreticalsciences.neodymium_magne: The strongest permanent magnet known: a thumb-sized piece can hold a kilogram of steel. Loses its strength above about 80 °C. Made in the Magnetizer.
item.theoreticalsciences.netherite_singu: 2,048 netherite ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.network_map.lor: Junctions and links, woven so that every place is joined to every other and none hangs by a single thread. Made on the Graph Loom. It routes Photonic Processors, and the living networks of a cell are read with it.
Billions of photonic neurons in a self-organising mesh.
item.theoreticalsciences.neural_organoid: A pea-sized brain grown in a dish. It has started to dream.
item.theoreticalsciences.neutrino_flux_c: A stream of ghost particles, trillions of which pass through me every second. They barely interact with anything, so the flux is invisible, weightless and almost impossible to stop. Only rarely does one leave a blue flash. Made in the Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector, the Neutrino Condenser and the Matter-Antimatter Annihilation Reactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_plat: Rolled to a thickness of a few femtometres.
item.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_sing: 32,768 neutronium ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.nickel_catalyst: Found: dropped by the Catalyst Sprite (Titan (Sotra Cryovolcanic Field, Selk Crater Field, Ontario Lacus Basin)).
Raney-style nickel, a sponge of metal so fine it takes up hydrogen like water: the catalyst for hydrogenation, and a fuel cell's electrode.
item.theoreticalsciences.nickel_plated_i: Iron under forty microns of nickel, laid down atom by atom from a bath: it will not rust, and acids barely touch it.
item.theoreticalsciences.nickel_sulfate_: Emerald green: nickel dissolved from meteoric iron, ready to be laid back down where it is wanted. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.nitric_acid_cel: Fuming and yellow with dissolved nitrogen dioxide: it dissolves copper and silver, and passivates iron. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.nitrogen_cell.l: Four fifths of the air, and so unreactive that its triple bond took a century of chemistry, and the Haber-Bosch process, to break. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.no_boundary_see: A closed universe tunnelled from nothing: round, without an edge, and without a first moment of time. Made in the Inflation Chamber.
item.theoreticalsciences.noble_gas_clath: Xenon caged in ice. The noble gases are not as aloof as the textbooks said. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.normal_distribu: Found: dropped by the Random Walker (the Overworld).
Faceted where the bell curve says it should be: most of it near the middle, less and less towards the edges, none past the tails.
item.theoreticalsciences.novikov_crystal: The self-consistency principle, crystallised: any time loop it is part of has no paradoxes.
item.theoreticalsciences.nuclear_waste_g: Fission products melted into borosilicate glass: it will hold them for the hundred thousand years they need.
item.theoreticalsciences.nucleotide.foun: Found: mined from Nucleotide Cluster in Inner Space (Nucleus); dropped by the Polymerase (Inner Space (Nucleus)).
item.theoreticalsciences.nucleotide.lore: A sugar, a phosphate and one of four bases: a single letter of the genetic code. Found in nucleotide clusters in the Nucleus of Inner Space; the Fermenter draws more out of yeast.
item.theoreticalsciences.nutrient_broth_: Found: in the caches of Bsl4 Field Stations.

A warm, rich medium for growing cells. Sugar provides energy, bone meal provides minerals, and a zeolite catalyst keeps the chemistry steady. It smells faintly sweet. Left uncovered for even a moment, it clouds with whatever life drifts into it. Made in the Bioreactor, the Fermenter and the Chemical Reactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.nylon_fibre.lor: A polyamide drawn into thread: stronger than steel for its weight, and the first fibre made wholly from coal, water and air.
item.theoreticalsciences.ocean_simulacru: A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, still bubbling inside its lattice. Made in the Omnilex Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.octonion_crysta: Eight dimensions, and multiplication no longer associates. The largest number system that still divides.
item.theoreticalsciences.omega_one.lore: The first ordinal that cannot be counted. Made in the Ordinal Recursor.
item.theoreticalsciences.omega_ordinal.l: The first number after all of the counting numbers. Made in the Ordinal Recursor.
item.theoreticalsciences.omega_point.lor: The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends. Made in the Omnilex Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnicellular_ge: One genome that can build any creature in any dimension.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnilex.lore: Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion. Made in the Omnilex Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnilex_seal.lo: A wax seal pressed with a law. Machines that bear one are permitted to work.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_dus: Ground Omnipotence. Each grain can still be anything, for a moment.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_see: Everything a Core needs to grow, folded small: a heart, a remembered world, and the proof that it can be done.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_sha: A splinter of the Core that made anything. It still remembers how; it has only forgotten what.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotent_edge: A blade with no thickness and no limit. What it cuts has never existed.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnipotent_ingo: Metal that is whatever metal it needs to be. Forged at the reborn Core, out of the boundless and the dust of the old Core.
item.theoreticalsciences.omniscience_cat: Every singularity there is, fused around a Theory of Everything. Holding it, you know everything, briefly. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnium_ingot.lo: A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.
item.theoreticalsciences.omnium_singular: Two hundred and fifty-six Omnium Ingots in one point. There is nothing left to compress it into.
item.theoreticalsciences.one_time_pad.lo: A strip of truly random key, as long as the message, used once and burned: the only cipher that can never be broken. Made on the Cipher Loom; an Entanglement Tuner is tuned with one.
item.theoreticalsciences.ontological_jun: Where a machine's idea of itself meets its matter. Without one, big machines forget what they are for.
item.theoreticalsciences.ontological_pro: Tier VI processor. It does not compute answers; it decides what is true.
item.theoreticalsciences.optimised_pathw: A machine's whole sequence of moves, worked out downhill until no shorter one is left. Fitted to a machine, each run takes a quarter less power. One upgrade per machine. Made in the Optimiser.
item.theoreticalsciences.oracle_lemma.lo: Creative mode only. Use inside one of Alpha Omega's trial chambers to have it count as solved.
item.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_hound_s: Calls a Ordinal Hound into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_shard.f: Found: mined from Ordinal Ore in the Platonic Realm; dropped by the Hilbert Bellhop (the Platonic Realm); dropped by the Ordinal Hound (the Platonic Realm).
item.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_shard.l: A piece of the order in which infinities come.
item.theoreticalsciences.organic_evapori: Found: mined from Evaporite Deposit in Titan (Kraken Mare, Selk Crater Field, Ontario Lacus Basin); dropped by the Cryolava Slug (Titan (Sotra Cryovolcanic Field, Xanadu Uplands, Shangri-La Dunes ...)); dropped by the Catalyst Sprite (Titan (Sotra Cryovolcanic Field, Selk Crater Field, Ontario Lacus Basin)).
Crystals of benzene and ethane, and of acetylene and butane, left behind where a methane lake dried up, Titan's salt flats. Found in the evaporite crust of Titan's dry lake beds.
item.theoreticalsciences.ouroboros_spawn: Calls the Ouroboros into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.oxygen_cell.fou: Found: in the caches of Lander Wreck structures in Titan (Shangri-La Dunes, Xanadu Uplands, Selk Crater Field); in the caches of Abandoned Refinery structures in Titan (Ontario Lacus Basin, Kraken Mare).
item.theoreticalsciences.oxygen_cell.lor: A fifth of the air, boiled off below nitrogen in an air separation column at minus 183 degrees. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.oxygen_rebreath: A mask, a bottle of oxygen, and a can of caustic soda that soaks up the carbon dioxide you breathe out, so the same oxygen goes round again. Twenty minutes on Titan, where the air is nitrogen and methane.
item.theoreticalsciences.page_curve_reco: The entropy of a black hole's radiation: rising as it evaporates, until halfway, then falling back to zero. Information comes out. Carried in the off hand, it puts your hotbar back in order (no Information Loss).
item.theoreticalsciences.pah_soot.lore: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons from the dust clouds: flat rings of carbon, fused; graphene already half made.
item.theoreticalsciences.panacea_cell.lo: The cure for everything, named for the Greek goddess of remedies: every fluid of life, and the answer to the Anomaly, held together by the Tree of Life. Made in the Abiogenesis Crucible. One of the five fluids of Pleroma. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.panspermia_seed: Life packed to survive the trip between universes.
item.theoreticalsciences.paradox_echo_sp: A figure forever meeting its own past. It acts out the grandfather paradox, flickering whenever its history stops adding up.
item.theoreticalsciences.paradox_residue: Found: dropped by the Paradox Echo.
What is left after a contradiction resolves itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.paradox_shade_s: "This statement is false." It is true, then false, then true again, every few seconds: true, solid and pale, it hunts you; false, a dark outline, nothing touches it and it touches nothing. Strike it while it is true. Found in the Axioms (the Platonic Realm, Y −720 to −650).
item.theoreticalsciences.partition_funct: Z = Σ e^(−E/kT), summed over every state a system can be in. Everything else, energy, entropy, pressure, is a derivative of it.
item.theoreticalsciences.path_integral.l: Every way of getting from here to there, added up. Made in the Analytic Continuator.
item.theoreticalsciences.pattern_templat: A Turing pattern set in gel: stripes and spots at exactly the spacing asked for, as a leopard's are laid down before it is born. Made in the Pattern Basin. With a Turing Morphogen, Bioculture grows Morphogenic Serum cheaply from it; the growing tissues of Biology are laid out by it.
item.theoreticalsciences.penning_harness: A wearable Penning trap: magnetic and electric fields that keep every atom of you from touching the Antiverse. Made by crafting.
Also shields you completely in the Platonic Realm.
item.theoreticalsciences.penrose_spindle: Couples to a rotating horizon's ergosphere.
item.theoreticalsciences.pentaquark_shar: Five quarks bound into one exotic hadron. They only exist for an instant, unless you crystallise them.
item.theoreticalsciences.penteract_latti: A five-dimensional cube: 32 corners, 80 edges, 40 cells.
item.theoreticalsciences.perfect_crystal: Three slabs cut from one silicon crystal, still joined at the base, so their lattice planes line up to a fraction of an atom: they split a neutron's wave, steer it, and bring it back together.
item.theoreticalsciences.perfused_tissue: A sheet of living cells kept alive by a network of fine channels carrying nutrient and oxygen to every one, as blood does. It dies if carried about too long. Made on the Perfusion Rig.
item.theoreticalsciences.peridot.found: Found: mined from Peridot Crystal Mass in the Planetary Interior (Mantle Convection Zone).
item.theoreticalsciences.peridot.lore: Gem olivine, the mineral the upper mantle is mostly made of. It forms only deep down and only reaches the surface carried up in lava.
item.theoreticalsciences.permafrost_samp: Soil frozen for thousands of years, holding the carbon of the plants that grew before it froze.
item.theoreticalsciences.phantom_energy_: Dark energy with w below -1. Its density grows as space expands, until it tears apart galaxies, stars, atoms, and then the cell.
item.theoreticalsciences.phase_locked_st: Locks a multiblock's fields to a reference oscillator. Drift comes slower and smaller.
item.theoreticalsciences.phosphate_buffe: Phosphoric acid and its salt, held at pH 7.4; the pH of blood. Add acid or base and it barely moves. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.photographic_pl: A glass plate coated with a light-sensitive emulsion set in gelatin. Left open under the sky for an hour, it records stars far too faint for any eye.
item.theoreticalsciences.photon_moth_spa: Calls a Photon Moth into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.photonic_die.lo: A single photonic logic die. Made in the Planck-Scale Cutter.
item.theoreticalsciences.photonic_lens.l: Focuses light onto wafers: never used up in lithography, though many finer optics are built from it.
item.theoreticalsciences.photonic_logic_: Engraved with waveguides instead of wires. Made in the Quantum Lithographer.
item.theoreticalsciences.photonic_neuron: A neuron that thinks at the speed of light.
item.theoreticalsciences.photonic_proces: Tier I processor. Computes with light. Made in the Metamaterial Weaver.
item.theoreticalsciences.photoresist_cel: A light-sensitive coating made of quantum dots. Each dot reacts to a single photon, so patterns can be printed finer than the wavelength of light. It is thin, faintly coloured and cool to the touch. Exposed regions harden instantly, so it records light like a photographic plate. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.physarum_cultur: A single yellow cell the size of a plate, with millions of nuclei. Set oat flakes out as cities and it links them with the shortest network it can: it once laid out Tokyo's railways. It dies if carried about too long. Made on the Mycelium Bed.
item.theoreticalsciences.pi_crystal.lore: A crystal whose circumference is exactly π times its width, to as many digits as the Geometer's Table could hold. One of the five constants of Euler's identity. Made at the Geometer's Table.
item.theoreticalsciences.pixel_tracker_m: A qubit-array sensor that records the exact path of every charged particle crossing it.
item.theoreticalsciences.planck_area_til: The smallest area there is, in loop quantum gravity: 8πγℓₚ²√(j(j+1)), where a spin network's link pierces a surface.
item.theoreticalsciences.planck_diver.lo: Shrinks you past the Planck length into the Quantum Foam. Use again to come back. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.planck_mite_spa: Calls a Planck Mite into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.planck_shard.lo: 1.6 x 10^-35 m. You cannot cut it smaller.
item.theoreticalsciences.planetary_core_: Iron and nickel from two planets' cores, pressed together to the pressure at a core's centre: the stuff every rocky planet sinks to its middle.
item.theoreticalsciences.planetary_nebul: Found: dropped by the Nebuloid (the Accretion Frontier (Asteroid Belt, Molecular Cloud Nebula)).
The glowing shell a dying Sun-like star throws off: oxygen green, hydrogen red, round a white dwarf at its centre.
item.theoreticalsciences.planetary_plate: The sharpest of a thousand short exposures of a planet, taken in the instants the air held still: belts, moons, a shadow.
item.theoreticalsciences.plasma_nozzle_t: A converging magnetic nozzle that accelerates plasma to a few percent of light speed.
item.theoreticalsciences.plasma_thruster: A magnetic nozzle of lonsdaleite and iron: plasma pushed out along its field lines leaves faster than any chemical exhaust.
item.theoreticalsciences.platinum_rhodiu: A woven mesh of platinum with a tenth part rhodium, glowing orange in the converter. Ammonia touches it for a thousandth of a second and comes off as nitric oxide.
item.theoreticalsciences.platonic_compas: Points at the realm of ideal forms, and, used, takes you there (and back). In the Realm, sneak and use it to climb a layer, or sneak, look down and use it to go down one, from the Axioms at the bottom to the Continuum (the Infinite above needs the Cantor Key). Mended with Euclidean Shards.
item.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_cell.lo: All knowledge and the world itself, made one: the fullness the Gnostics said held all of being. Made in the Pleroma Confluence from five fluids, and the Transcendental is opened with it. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_crystal: Pleroma, the fullness. Every law the Transcendental held, frozen into one lattice.
item.theoreticalsciences.plume_elemental: A column of hot rock rising from the base of the mantle, solid yet flowing over the ages. Where such a plume reaches the crust, chains of volcanoes follow.
item.theoreticalsciences.plutonium_239_p: Bred from uranium-238 in the reactor and taken out of its spent salt. Warm to the touch from its own alpha decay.
item.theoreticalsciences.pocket_universe: An entire cosmos, folded into a bubble you can hold. Please do not drop it. Made in the Causality Loop Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.poisson_clock.l: A clock that ticks at random: each tick a decay in its radium, the waits between them falling off exponentially. It keeps perfect average time and never says when.
item.theoreticalsciences.polonium_210_so: A speck of polonium giving off so many alpha particles that it is warm to the touch. Harmless at arm's length; deadly inside you.
item.theoreticalsciences.polymer_sheet.l: Polyethylene: chains of ten thousand ethylene units, tangled. Light, tough and waterproof; the commonest plastic there is.
item.theoreticalsciences.polymerase_spaw: An enzyme that works the double helix: it walks to the nearest one, climbs it rung by rung reading the strand and laying down a copy behind it, turns at the top and works back down. Knocked off, it climbs back on. Harmless. Found in the Nucleus of Inner Space.
item.theoreticalsciences.porphyrin_oxyge: Found: dropped by the Red Cell (Inner Space (Bloodstream, Tissue)).
An iron atom in a flat ring of four pyrroles, haem. It holds oxygen when there is plenty and lets it go where there is not.
item.theoreticalsciences.positronium_hyd: A molecule made of a hydrogen atom and an atom of matter bound to antimatter. It lasts a nanosecond, unless you trap it.
item.theoreticalsciences.positronium_ski: Calls a Positronium Skitterer into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.posterior_table: Belief, updated by evidence. Carry one while solving a research derivation and it pays for a hint instead of Insight. Made in the Monte Carlo Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.power_set.lore: The set of all subsets. Always strictly bigger than what you started with. Made in the Formal Proof Assistant.
item.theoreticalsciences.precision_gyros: A fused-quartz sphere, the roundest object ever made, spinning in a vacuum. Space itself turns its axis. Carried in the off hand, it holds you steady against Frame Drag and Tidal Strain.
item.theoreticalsciences.predictive_latt: Simulates the machine a minute ahead and corrects what has not happened yet.
item.theoreticalsciences.presolar_grains: Silicon carbide stardust condensed in the winds of stars that died before the Sun was born. Moissan named the mineral moissanite when he found it in a meteorite.
item.theoreticalsciences.pressure_hull_p: Ceramic faced, steel backed and aramid laced: a plate rated for a thousand atmospheres, curved to be part of a sphere. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.pressure_suit_b: Sealed boots of a pressure suit. Above about 19 km, the Armstrong limit, water boils at body temperature, and so would the wearer without them.
item.theoreticalsciences.pressure_suit_c: A rigid shell built to bear the weight of rock overhead. At the base of Earth's mantle the pressure reaches about 136 GPa, over a million atmospheres.
item.theoreticalsciences.pressure_suit_h: A sealed helmet that keeps the head in breathable pressure. Above about 19 km, water in the body would boil at body temperature without it.
item.theoreticalsciences.pressure_suit_l: Layered leggings that hold air pressure against the body. Bending a knee in an inflated suit is hard work, so the joints are built to keep their volume constant.
item.theoreticalsciences.prime_shard.fou: Found: mined from Prime Number Ore in the Platonic Realm; dropped by the Axiom Sentinel (the Platonic Realm).
item.theoreticalsciences.prime_shard.lor: Divisible only by itself and one. Grows naturally in the Platonic Realm; otherwise it has to be sieved out.
item.theoreticalsciences.prime_singulari: 16,384 prime shard, crushed into one point.
What the first three minutes made: three parts hydrogen to one of helium-4, a pinch of deuterium and helium-3, a trace of lithium-7.
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_char: A copy of the laws as they were first written. Carry it in Hyperdimensional Reality. Made by crafting.
Also shields you completely in the Platonic Realm, the Antiverse, the Quantum Foam, the Bulk, black and white holes and the Transfinite Hierarchy.
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_ejec: Found: mined from Ejecta Ore in the White Hole Interior; dropped by the Photon Moth (the White Hole Interior).
Matter a white hole threw out before there was anything to throw.
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_harv: Every crop that has ever grown, in one seed.
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_law_: The substance of law itself, before any particular law. It has no temperature and no fixed form, and it reshapes itself to fit whatever rule is asked of it. It is clear, cold and utterly still until disturbed. Found in the Ocean of Primordial Law in Hyperdimensional Reality. Made in the Omnilex Engine and the Axiom Distiller. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.primordial_soup: The chemical mixture from which life arose. Morphogens, chiral crystals and superacids give it the ingredients for self-replication. It is warm and bubbles slowly. Miller and Urey made amino acids in a flask of sparks; this goes much further. Made in the Chemical Reactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.prion_lattice.l: Misfolded protein stacked into amyloid. Touch a healthy protein to it and the healthy one misfolds too: shape is the infection. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.prior_tablet.lo: What you believe before you look, written down so that the evidence can change it. Made by crafting.
A lining of harmless bacteria that hold every surface, so nothing harmful finds room to grow. Fitted to a Biology console, it is never contaminated again. One upgrade per machine. Made in the Fermenter.
item.theoreticalsciences.programmable_ma: Matter that changes its own shape and properties on command.
item.theoreticalsciences.proof_certifica: Found: dropped by the Paradox Shade (the Platonic Realm).

A proof, checked line by line, that a machine stays inside its limits. Use it on a multiblock's controller to file it there (up to four). Each one catches one containment failure: the machine still shuts down, but nothing is released. Made in the Formal Proof Assistant.
Found: dropped by the Axiom Sentinel (the Platonic Realm).
Part of a proof an Axiom Sentinel was writing about you. QED.
item.theoreticalsciences.proof_mass.lore: A polished cube of gold and platinum that touches nothing. Whatever path it follows is the path of free fall itself.
item.theoreticalsciences.proof_of_everyt: What Alpha Omega left behind: a proof that you understood. The Transcendental opens only to it. Made in the Omega Simulator.
Ethylene's heavier sister: polypropylene, acrylic, and the start of nylon. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.proton_decay_re: Positrons and neutral pions from protons that lived 10^34 years and then simply came apart.
A collapsing knot of nebular gas, hot enough to glow but not yet to fuse. Made in the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.
item.theoreticalsciences.protostellar_em: Found: mined from Protostar Fragment in the Accretion Frontier (Molecular Cloud Nebula).
A shard of a star not yet lit, still glowing with the heat of its own collapse. A furnace of a fuel: it burns for a long time.
item.theoreticalsciences.prussian_blue_p: Iron(II) and iron(III) bridged by cyanide: the first synthetic pigment, and a low-spin one, its colour comes from the gap. Made in the Coordination Reactor from iron and hydrogen cyanide; with sugar it presses into Prussian Blue Tablets.
item.theoreticalsciences.prussian_blue_t: Iron hexacyanoferrate. Swallowed, it traps radioactive caesium and thallium in the gut so the body passes them instead of keeping them.
item.theoreticalsciences.psionic_ether_c: A gas that carries thought. Breathing near it fills the mind with faint impressions that are not my own, and it moves in eddies that follow attention. It is warm and almost tasteless. Its currents curl toward whoever in the room is concentrating hardest. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_timing_c: Found: mined from Pulsar Timing Ore in the Accretion Frontier (Pulsar Field); dropped by the Pulsar Wisp (the Accretion Frontier (Pulsar Field)).
Ticks with the precision of a millisecond pulsar.
item.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_timing_r: Arrival times of a pulsar's pulses, steady to a millionth of a second over months: a clock spun up in a dead star.
item.theoreticalsciences.pulsar_wisp_spa: A spinning wisp that flashes on a perfect beat, like the lighthouse beam of a pulsar. Millisecond pulsars keep time nearly as well as atomic clocks.
item.theoreticalsciences.quadrupole_pole: A hyperbolic pole piece ground to within ten nanometres. Four of them squeeze a beam into focus.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_chlorop: Photosynthesis moves energy by trying every path at once, coherently. Made in the Bioreactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_dot.fou: Found: dropped by the Nanite Swarm.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_dot.lor: An artificial atom; its colour is set by its size.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_field_l: Particles are only ripples. The field is what is real.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_process: A fault-tolerant array of logical qubits. Made in the Matrioshka Brain.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_singula: Every possible state at once, compressed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.quantum_spaceti: Spacetime treated as a fluid of quanta. In loop quantum gravity, area comes in discrete chunks, and here those chunks have settled into one shared state. Made in the Spin Network Loom. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
A one-dimensional vibrating string. Its mode of vibration decides which particle it is.
item.theoreticalsciences.quarantine_fiel: A field that clears an anomaly faster than it can copy itself. It does not destroy anything; it only keeps R below one. Made in the Anomaly Containment Ward.
item.theoreticalsciences.quark_gluon_pla: The state of matter that filled the universe for its first few microseconds. Protons and neutrons have melted, and quarks and gluons flow freely as an almost perfect liquid with barely any viscosity. It is the hottest thing I have ever bottled, and it pours like light. Made in the Quark-Gluon Collider. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.quark_star_core: The heart of a star too dense even for neutrons.
item.theoreticalsciences.quasar_jet_fila: A thread of the jet that a spinning black hole drives out along its axis at nearly the speed of light, wound up in magnetic field.
item.theoreticalsciences.quasicrystal_pl: An alloy whose atoms are ordered but never repeat: five-fold symmetry, which no ordinary crystal can have. Hard, and slippery.
item.theoreticalsciences.quaternion_crys: Hamilton carved i² = j² = k² = ijk = -1 into a bridge. Here it is carved into a crystal: pure rotation.
item.theoreticalsciences.qubit.lore: |0> and |1> at once, until you look.
item.theoreticalsciences.qubit_array_waf: Thousands of qubits, engraved through a metamaterial lens.
item.theoreticalsciences.qubit_die.lore: A single die of entangled qubits.
item.theoreticalsciences.quine_replicato: A machine whose instructions contain a description of itself and an order to copy it. A von Neumann replicator, a virus, a meme. Made in the Nanite Assembler.
item.theoreticalsciences.quintessence_ce: The fifth element of the ancients, and the field cosmologists think may be driving the universe apart: all of Physics in one fluid. Made in the Universe Forge, with the Theory of Everything as its catalyst. One of the five fluids of Pleroma. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.r_process_clust: Gold, platinum and uranium, forged in seconds by the neutron flood of a supernova.
item.theoreticalsciences.radiogenic_lead: Lead that was once uranium, radium and radon: the stable end of a decay chain, made one nucleus at a time.
item.theoreticalsciences.radium_salt.lor: Ten milligrams of radium chloride, glowing faintly in the dark by its own decay. Handle it as little as you can.
item.theoreticalsciences.radon_cell.lore: A noble gas born from the decay of radium. Radon-222 has a half-life of 3.8 days and is far heavier than air, so it pools in cellars and low places. Made in the Decay Chamber. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.rail_armature.l: A copper slug that bridges a railgun's two rails: the current through it and the field of the rails push it out at kilometres a second.
item.theoreticalsciences.random_number_c: Single photons meet a half-silvered mirror: transmitted is 1, reflected is 0. Nothing in the universe knows the next bit in advance.
item.theoreticalsciences.random_walker_s: Calls a Random Walker into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.rare_earth_oxid: Neodymium, samarium and their cousins, so alike chemically that it took a century and a spectroscope to tell them apart.
item.theoreticalsciences.rate_table.lore: A machine's rate equations, solved ahead of time and printed as a table, so it never waits to work out its next step. Use it on a multiblock's controller (or a console machine) to fit it: +20% products each cycle, on top of what its precision gives, so a perfectly tuned machine goes past perfect. One upgrade per machine. Made in the Integrator.
Every ratio of integers. Dense everywhere, and still full of holes. Made in the Peano Arithmetic Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_amber.found: Found: mined from Amber Ore in the Overworld.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_amber.lore: Tree resin hardened over three hundred million years. Something small with wings is caught inside, perfectly kept. Mined from Amber Ore in the Overworld, and set in the walls of Dig Sites.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_antigold.fo: Found: mined from Anti-Gold Ore in the Antiverse.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_antigold.lo: Gold of the mirror universe, cold blue where ours is warm yellow, only the light it reflects is the same.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_antiiron.fo: Found: mined from Anti-Iron Ore in the Antiverse.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_antiiron.lo: Ore from the Antiverse. Iron, exactly, except that every particle in it is the opposite one.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_pitchblende: Found: mined from Deepslate Pitchblende Ore or Pitchblende Ore in the Overworld; mined from Oklo Uraninite Ore in the Planetary Interior (Natural Reactor), Oklo Reactor Ruin structures in the Planetary Interior (Natural Reactor); dropped by the Fission Husk (the Planetary Interior (Natural Reactor)); in the caches of Fallout Shelter structures in the Overworld.
Uraninite: heavy, black and pitch-glossy. Marie and Pierre Curie found two new elements in it by following its radioactivity.
item.theoreticalsciences.raw_star_matter: The matter of a star, as simulated inside a black hole. It behaves exactly as stellar material should, because the horizon simulates it perfectly. It glows with the light of a star that does not exist. Made in the Eye of the Event Horizon. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
The rationals with every gap filled; including the transcendental numbers mined from the Platonic Realm.
Keeps a patch of reality from being edited. Made in the Reality Compiler.
item.theoreticalsciences.recombinant_dna: A double helix spliced from more than one creature. Made in the Gene Sequencer.
item.theoreticalsciences.red_cell_spawn_: A disc with a dimple in each face, packed with haemoglobin, carried round and round by the current. Climb on and it carries you too. Found in the Bloodstream of Inner Space.
item.theoreticalsciences.red_giant_envel: The swollen outer layers of a dying star, a hundred times wider than it once was.
item.theoreticalsciences.redshift_lens.l: A calibrated lens of spectra: distances from standard candles set against the redshifts of their galaxies. Every one is moving away, and the farther, the faster.
item.theoreticalsciences.redshift_record: Counts of gamma rays climbing a tower, and the source speed that brought them back into tune: gravity measured with a stopwatch of atomic nuclei.
item.theoreticalsciences.refractory_suit: Boots lined with refractory ceramic, the kind that keeps its strength at temperatures that melt steel and lets very little of the heat through.
Armour of refractory ceramics, which keep their strength where metals soften. Basaltic magma erupts at about 1,100 to 1,200 °C, and the suit hardly notices.
A helmet lined with ceramic that shrugs off heat which would melt steel. It insulates, so the inside stays cool while the outside glows.
Leggings of ceramic fibre under aluminised cloth, like a furnace worker's. The bright outer layer reflects radiant heat before it can soak in.
item.theoreticalsciences.reheating_plasm: The hot soup left when the inflaton decayed and inflation ended. It filled a cold, empty universe with particles and heat: the Big Bang proper. Made in the Inflation Chamber. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.rekindled_heart: Four sparks of the second creation, beating together around an Eschaton Core.
item.theoreticalsciences.rekindled_spark: What the Pleroma Reconstitutor leaves behind once the Transcendental is whole again: the first light of the second creation.
item.theoreticalsciences.relativity_brea: The place where general relativity fails. Curvature becomes infinite and the equations stop giving answers. The fluid is cold and black, and space around it is torn. Rulers placed in it disagree with themselves, and clocks show no time at all. Found in the ceiling of the Quantum Foam. Made in the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.renormalised_es: Essence with its infinities taken away, the way renormalisation tames the endless sums of quantum field theory until only finite, measurable values remain. Made in the Anomaly Resolution Engine. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.residual_starli: The light left over when matter goes beyond stellar temperatures. It is a hot, glowing gas that carries the memory of every star that went into it. It moves like a slow, luminous fog. Its glow is the colour of a sky just after a star has set. Made in the Transcendent Plasma Forge. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.resistant_clone: The cells that survived the last treatment, and so the ones that make the next tumour. Selection, not malice. Made in the Evolution Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.resolved_anomal: An anomaly explained: its strangeness measured, renormalised, and written back into the laws. It is just physics now. It always was. Made in the Anomaly Resolution Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.resonance_probe: Reads the four virtual-particle resonances where you stand in the Quantum Foam.
item.theoreticalsciences.resonant_tuning: A tuning fork whose tines are entangled: struck once, it keeps ringing. It calibrates like the plain fork but never wears out, and when an answer is wrong it says how far off it is (how many primes are missed, which step of a proof fails, how many elements are out of balance). Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.retrocausal_cry: Found: mined from Retrocausal Ore in the White Hole Interior; dropped by the Photon Moth (the White Hole Interior).
It formed after you mined it.
item.theoreticalsciences.rf_resonator_ce: A pill-box cavity of topological superconductor. The standing wave inside kicks each passing bunch forward.
item.theoreticalsciences.rich_copper_chu: Found: mined from Rich Copper Ore in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns).
Porphyry copper, veined with gold that came up with it.
item.theoreticalsciences.rich_gold_chunk: Found: mined from Rich Gold Ore in the Planetary Interior (Magma Chambers); dropped by the Magma Crawler (the Planetary Interior (Magma Chambers)).
Reef gold in quartz pebbles; the kind of ore that, on Earth, carries uraninite too.
item.theoreticalsciences.rich_iron_chunk: Found: mined from Rich Iron Ore in the Planetary Interior (Crustal Caverns).
Banded iron from deep down: richer than any Overworld ore, with magnetite in its layers.
item.theoreticalsciences.riemann_curvatu: How much a vector turns when carried around a small loop, curvature itself. Made in the Tensor Calculus Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.riemann_zeta_cr: Every non-trivial zero lies on the critical line. Probably. This crystal grew along it.
item.theoreticalsciences.rift_anchor.lor: Pins a tear between universes open long enough to reach through.
item.theoreticalsciences.ringwoodite.fou: Found: mined from Ringwoodite Ore in the Planetary Interior (Mantle Convection Zone); dropped by the Plume Elemental (the Planetary Interior (Mantle Convection Zone)).
item.theoreticalsciences.ringwoodite.lor: A high-pressure form of olivine from 520 km down. Its crystals hold water: there may be more of it in the mantle than in every ocean.
item.theoreticalsciences.rocket_stage.lo: An aluminium tank with an engine at one end, built to be thrown away: once its propellant is gone it is dead weight, so it falls back and the rest goes on lighter. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.room_temperatur: Zero resistance without cryogenics. Physicists have chased this for a century. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.russell_paradox: The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. Does it contain itself? Made in the Cantor Diagonalizer.
item.theoreticalsciences.samarium_cobalt: Sm₂(Co,Fe,Cu)₁₇: harder to magnetise than neodymium, and it keeps its magnetism far hotter.
A little weaker than neodymium, but it keeps its field up to 300 °C; the magnet for hot machines. Made in the Magnetizer.
A single crystal of aluminium oxide pulled from the melt, every atom of it in one lattice. Cut, it gives windows clear from ultraviolet to infrared.
item.theoreticalsciences.sapphire_window: A disc of synthetic sapphire, aluminium oxide grown from the melt: hard, clear from ultraviolet to infrared, and it stays clear when frozen.
item.theoreticalsciences.satellite_image: The ground seen from orbit, in visible and infrared: rivers, faults, and the heat of what lies under the surface.
item.theoreticalsciences.schmidt_correct: A thin, almost flat plate of fused silica, figured to a gentle aspheric curve. In front of a spherical mirror it gives a sharp image across a field many degrees wide.
item.theoreticalsciences.schrodinger_lim: The boundary where quantum mechanics stops behaving. It is a still, cold fluid in which superpositions persist indefinitely, never collapsing. Looking at it, I see both outcomes at once. Measurements dipped into it return every answer at once. Found in the floor of the Quantum Foam. Made in the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.scintillator_cr: Flashes when a particle passes through it. Count the flashes and you know what was made in the collision.
item.theoreticalsciences.sediment_core.l: A tube of layered ground. Each band is a year, a flood or an ash fall, stacked in the order it happened.
item.theoreticalsciences.seismic_recorde: A paper drum turned by clockwork under a hanging pen. The ground shakes, the pen does not, and the difference is written down. Made in the Seismograph.
item.theoreticalsciences.self_healing_po: Cut it and the chains find each other again. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
Frozen smoke: a glass that is ninety-nine parts air. The best solid insulator there is.
item.theoreticalsciences.silicon_boule.l: Silicon reduced from silica with carbon, then pulled from its melt as one flawless crystal: the most perfect solid people make.
item.theoreticalsciences.silicon_life_sp: Life built on silicon instead of carbon. It grew in the Bulk.
item.theoreticalsciences.simulated_unive: A whole other world, run from its first instant to its last inside the Forge. Each mod has its own.
item.theoreticalsciences.singularity_clu: Nine singularities condensed into one, when there are too many to hold.
item.theoreticalsciences.singularity_sce: It does not fire singularities. It decides where one has always been.
item.theoreticalsciences.siphonophore_sp: Not one animal but a colony of them, each so specialised it cannot live alone: a float, pulsing swimming bells, and a stem trailing back with feeders and stingers along it. Some grow longer than a blue whale. Whatever brushes the stem is stung. Found drifting in the Hadal Abyss.
item.theoreticalsciences.soft_hair_filam: Zero-energy excitations on a horizon that remember what fell in: a black hole may not be quite as bald as it seems.
item.theoreticalsciences.solar_statite.l: A light sail balanced between gravity and radiation pressure.
item.theoreticalsciences.source_code_fra: A few lines of the program that runs the universe. Mostly comments. Made in the Reality Compiler.
item.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_alloy: An alloy of matter and curved space. Its reflection shows distant stars.
8,192 spacetime alloy ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_beari: Turns on a frictionless geodesic. It will outlast the machine around it.
item.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_catal: A self-sustaining knot of curved spacetime. Required (not consumed) to grow pocket universes and the highest processors. Made in the Tesseract Assembler.
item.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_singu: All of relativity, compressed into the one place relativity breaks down.
Crumpled leftover geometry. A Maxwell's demon can sort useful shards out of it. Made in the Fractionation Spire.
item.theoreticalsciences.spark_of_life.l: The moment chemistry became biology, caught and kept.
item.theoreticalsciences.specimen_bundle: One of everything a mod's world grows or leaves behind, sealed in glass.
item.theoreticalsciences.spectral_analyz: Right-click phenomena, blocks or creatures to gain Insight. Made by crafting.
Starlight spread into a rainbow and caught on glass. The dark lines in it say which elements the light passed through.
A fuel rod after three years in a reactor: still mostly uranium, but laced with fission products a million times more radioactive.
item.theoreticalsciences.spent_fuel_salt: Molten fluoride fuel after a pass through the core, thick with fission products and fresh plutonium, and still hot with its own decay heat. Made in the Molten Salt Reactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.spin_foam_latti: Loop quantum gravity: spacetime itself, woven from discrete quanta of area.
item.theoreticalsciences.spin_network_no: A node of a spin network: a grain of volume, its faces the links that join it to its neighbours. Space is built from these.
Turn it through 360 degrees and it comes back negative. It takes 720 to restore it.
item.theoreticalsciences.stabiliser_matr: Compactified dimensions woven tight with quantum strings, so they stay rolled up under load.
item.theoreticalsciences.stability_margi: A proof of how far each setting can stray before the machine's working point stops being stable. Fitted to a machine, its precision falls off half as fast, so fine tuning is much easier. One upgrade per machine. Made in the Integrator.
item.theoreticalsciences.stable_dose.lor: A substance metered out so its level in the body stays steady, between too little to work and enough to harm: the pharmacist's art. Made on the Dosing Pump.
item.theoreticalsciences.stable_ecosyste: A sealed world in balance: producers, grazers and hunters whose numbers rise and fall around each other without ever crashing or exploding. The fifth piece of the Tree of Life. It dies if carried about too long. Made in the Ecosphere.
item.theoreticalsciences.stable_strategy: A mix of ways to behave that, once common, nothing else can invade: Maynard Smith's answer to why animals mostly fight by display. Recorded at the Strategy Table. The Bioreactor grows Tardigrade Cultures cheaply with one.
item.theoreticalsciences.standard_model_: Every known particle in one lattice. It explains almost everything, except gravity and dark matter. Made in the Femtoscale Assembly Line.
Every particle that exists, compressed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.star_field_plat: A developed plate of a patch of sky: thousands of stars, their positions measured to a fraction of an arcsecond.
A pressurised can of Rocket Hull with a hatch at each end, its wiring grown from microgravity crystal. Four of them, docked in orbit, make a station. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.stellar_core.lo: A captive star the size of a fist, ignited by a white hole. Made in the Stellar Plasma Crucible.
item.theoreticalsciences.stellar_iron_in: Iron from the core of a star; the end of fusion. Making anything heavier costs energy instead of releasing it.
item.theoreticalsciences.stellar_iron_si: 16,384 stellar iron ingot, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.stellar_plasma_: The hot, ionised gas from a star's core, where hydrogen fuses into helium at fifteen million kelvin. It glows white and roils with magnetic field lines, and it wants to escape in every direction at once. Made in the Stellar Plasma Crucible, the Universe Forge and the White Hole Emitter. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.stellar_singula: The whole life of a star, compressed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.stellar_spectru: Starlight spread into a spectrum on the plate. The dark lines across it give each star's temperature and what it is made of.
item.theoreticalsciences.stem_cell_cultu: Cells that have not yet decided what to become.
item.theoreticalsciences.sterile_neutrin: Interacts with nothing except gravity. Very hard to keep hold of.
item.theoreticalsciences.sterile_pack.lo: Swabs, wipes and a fresh filter, sealed and steamed in the Autoclave until not one spore in a trillion is left alive. Use it on a Biology machine to bring it back to fully sterile and clear any contamination. Made in the Autoclave.
item.theoreticalsciences.storm_elemental: A thunderstorm cell come to life, fed by warm sea: a billowing dark base, an anvil spreading at its top, and inside, charge torn apart by the updraft until the air breaks down. It hangs over its prey and strikes. Found over warm Overworld seas during thunderstorms, and gone when the storm passes.
item.theoreticalsciences.strain_sensor.l: A fused-silica fibre that changes its light when it stretches by a part in a billion.
item.theoreticalsciences.strained_spacet: Spacetime under tidal strain: stretched along one line and squeezed across it, as the Moon stretches the oceans. Anything inside it is pulled apart. Made in the Time Dilation Chamber. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.strange_charm_q: The second generation: heavier, and they only exist for an instant outside strange matter.
item.theoreticalsciences.strange_matter_: Quark matter laced with strange quarks, possibly more stable than ordinary nuclei. A drop of it converts any normal matter it touches into more of itself, given the chance. It is dense, dull and should be kept very far from everything. Made in the Particle Spectrometer, the Quark-Gluon Collider and the Hyperion Synchrotron. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
Found: dropped by the Destabilised Husk.
Up, down and strange quarks. Possibly contagious.
8,192 strange matter pellet, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.stress_energy_t: Matter tells spacetime how to curve. This is what it says. Made in the Chrono Loom.
item.theoreticalsciences.string_coupling: Tunes how strongly strings split and join. Turn it up and string theory becomes a different string theory.
item.theoreticalsciences.stromatolite_fr: Found: mined from Stromatolite Ore in the Overworld.
Fine layers of limestone, each laid down by a mat of cyanobacteria: the first life to breathe out oxygen. Mined from Stromatolite Ore in the Overworld's deepslate.
item.theoreticalsciences.structure_assem: Use on a multiblock controller to build every missing block from your inventory, coils in the highest tier you have enough of. Sneak-use to preview what is missing. Sneak-use in the air to switch mode: build, disassemble, or coils (changes a built structure's coils to another tier). Sneak-use on any block of an ME network to bind it: what you lack is then taken from the network.
A molecule's spectrum, read and written down: which bonds it has and where. A synthesis that knows its target takes fewer steps.
item.theoreticalsciences.sulfur_dioxide_: The choking smell of burning sulfur, and the first step to the chemical industry's most used reagent. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.sulfuric_acid_c: Oily, dense and fiercely drying. More of it is made than any other chemical: a country's output of it was once a measure of its industry. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.superconducting: Zero resistance. The current never stops.

Solder that conducts electricity without resistance. Chilled with superfluid helium, it joins femtoscale components with perfect efficiency. It shimmers faintly when current passes through. Magnets float above a puddle of it, pinned in place by expelled field lines. Made in the Phase Diagram Kiln and the Bose-Einstein Condenser. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.supercritical_s: A fluid past its critical point, neither liquid nor gas. It diffuses like a gas and dissolves like a liquid, getting into every pore. It is warm and almost invisible. Industry uses supercritical water and carbon dioxide to dissolve what nothing else will. Made in the Chemical Reactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.supercritical_w: Water above 374 °C and 22 MPa, where liquid and steam become one. It dissolves oils that ordinary water will not, and corrodes most metals. Made in the Aquifer Pump. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.superfluid_heli: Helium so cold it flows without friction. It climbs the walls of its container in a thin film, leaks through gaps too small for any normal liquid and never stops swirling once set in motion. It is utterly clear and almost weightless in the pipe. Made in the Fractionation Spire and the Bose-Einstein Condenser. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.superintelligen: It has already read this tooltip. And the next one.
item.theoreticalsciences.supernova_remna: What is left after a star's core collapses and its outer layers are blasted across the galaxy. Made in the Neutron Star Forge.
item.theoreticalsciences.superpartner_sh: A neutralino: the supersymmetric twin of a boson. It turns out to be what dark matter is made of.
item.theoreticalsciences.superposition_c: Exists in several lattice configurations simultaneously.
Conway's numbers: every real, every ordinal, every infinitesimal, all in one ordered field. Made in the Cantor Diagonalizer.
item.theoreticalsciences.survey_map.lore: Heights, rivers and benchmarks, measured rather than guessed. Every line on it was walked.
item.theoreticalsciences.survey_satellit: A telescope pointed down instead of up, with solar wings and a radio. Flown high enough, it photographs the ground.
item.theoreticalsciences.symbiont_cultur: The same anomaly, turned: it still copies itself, but now it pays its host back. Parasite and partner differ by one sign.
item.theoreticalsciences.symbiont_lining: A living skin of helpful microbes grown to line a machine, repairing and renewing its catalysts as they work. Fitted to a machine, its catalysts wear 40% slower. One upgrade per machine. Made in the Ecosphere.
item.theoreticalsciences.symmetry_crysta: Found: dropped by the Tessellate (the Platonic Realm).
Turned on the Symmetry Lathe so that it looks the same after a sixth of a turn, or in a mirror: twelve symmetries, one group. Made on the Symmetry Lathe.
item.theoreticalsciences.symmetry_seed.l: A quartz blank cut by hand with six even faces: the first symmetry, and the Symmetry Lathe's indexing head. Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.synaptic_fluid_: A warm, conductive medium for photonic thought. It carries signals between photonic neurons with almost no loss and stays at body temperature on its own. It glows softly when a thought passes through. Made in the Bose-Einstein Condenser. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
The smallest genome that can still be alive, written from scratch. Made in the Gene Sequencer.
item.theoreticalsciences.t_cell_spawn_eg: A killer lymphocyte on patrol. It leaves you alone, unless you carry an infection: then you glow in the Lymph Node and it hunts you down. It hunts the anomalies that infect, and the Tumour Hydra, too. Found in the Lymph Node of Inner Space.
item.theoreticalsciences.tachyon_flux_ce: A thin stream of faster-than-light particles. Because their mass is imaginary, they speed up as they lose energy, so the coldest flux is also the fastest. It arrives in the pipe a fraction of a moment before I open the valve. Made in the Tachyon Resonator. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.tachyon_klystro: A microwave amplifier whose electron beam has been replaced with tachyons. It drives RF cavities from slightly in the future.
item.theoreticalsciences.tachyon_singula: 8,192 tachyon crystal, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.tardigrade_cult: Survives vacuum, radiation and freezing by simply pausing being alive. Made in the Bioreactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.tautology_shard: Found: mined from Tautology Ore in the Platonic Realm; dropped by the Paradox Shade (the Platonic Realm); in the caches of Liars Vaults; in the caches of Proof Stairss.

A sliver of a statement true in every case there is: "it rains or it does not". Found in Tautology Ore in the Axioms, the Platonic Realm's lowest layer (Y −720 to −650), and dropped by Paradox Shades. The Formal Proof Assistant writes Proof Certificates and Axiom Schemas from it.
item.theoreticalsciences.technetium_99m_: An excited nucleus that gives off one clean gamma ray and calms down within hours: the most used medical isotope in the world.
item.theoreticalsciences.telescope_mirro: A disc of glass ground to a paraboloid within a fraction of a wavelength, then silvered. Light from a whole star lands on one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.telomerase_comp: Rebuilds the clocks at the ends of chromosomes. Cells that have it do not age. Made in the Evolution Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.temporal_knot.l: A worldline tied into a knot. Untie it and something happens twice. Made in the Chrono Loom.
item.theoreticalsciences.temporal_singul: Every moment there has ever been, compressed into one instant.
item.theoreticalsciences.tessellate_spaw: A creature of hyperbolic tiles, a heptagon and seven smaller round it. Broken, it falls into two smaller ones, and those into two smaller still. Found in Curved Space (the Platonic Realm, Y 560 to 720).
Found: dropped by the Hypercube Drifter (the Platonic Realm).
A hypercube's 3D shadow, rotating through a direction you cannot point to.
Focuses light through the fourth dimension. A lithography catalyst.
item.theoreticalsciences.test_mass.lore: Forty kilograms of fused silica, polished to a few nanometres and hung on silica fibres: a mirror that does nothing but follow spacetime.
item.theoreticalsciences.theodolite_lens: A sighting lens on a graduated circle: two angles and one measured baseline, and every distance follows.
item.theoreticalsciences.theoretical_dos: The theories of the middle ages of your research. Feeds a Research Nexus.
item.theoreticalsciences.theoretical_not: One third of a Research Dossier.
One third of a Research Dossier.
One third of a Research Dossier.
item.theoreticalsciences.theory_of_every: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model in one equation. It fits on a T-shirt. Made in the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.
item.theoreticalsciences.thermochemical_: A heat of combustion, measured to a part in a thousand and written down: the numbers every later energy balance starts from.
item.theoreticalsciences.tholin.found: Found: dropped by the Methane Skater (Titan (Kraken Mare, Ontario Lacus Basin)); dropped by The Ouroboros; dropped by the Tholin Drifter (Titan (Xanadu Uplands, Kraken Mare, Shangri-La Dunes ...)).
item.theoreticalsciences.tholin.lore: The orange-brown tar that sunlight makes from methane and nitrogen high in Titan's air, and that snows down onto everything. Carl Sagan named it from the Greek for "muddy". Boiled with water, it gives amino acids.
item.theoreticalsciences.tholin_drifter_: Calls a Tholin Drifter into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.thorium_232_pel: Three times as common as uranium, and not fissile itself, but a neutron makes it uranium-233, which is.
A thought, frozen in a lattice so it can be copied.
item.theoreticalsciences.tidal_alloy_scr: Found: mined from Tidal Ore in the Black Hole Interior; dropped by the Tidal Horror (the Black Hole Interior).
Metal pulled thin by tides stronger than its bonds.
item.theoreticalsciences.tidal_horror_sp: Calls a Tidal Horror into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
