item.theoreticalsciences.tidal_plasma_ce: Plasma near a black hole, where the pull on its near side far outstrips the far. Infalling gas is drawn out into long, thin streams: spaghettified. Found in lakes in the Accretion Frontier's Accretion Rim. Made in the Time Dilation Chamber. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.tidal_shear_cry: Found: dropped by the Tidal Stretcher (the Accretion Frontier (Accretion Rim)).
A crystal pulled long and thin by a tidal force: one end fell faster than the other.
item.theoreticalsciences.tidal_stretcher: A creature of the tide near a compact mass, where feet are pulled harder than head. It draws everything near it out long and thin, like spaghetti.
item.theoreticalsciences.time_dilated_sa: A crystal grown deep in a gravity well. By its own clock it took longer to form than the outside world saw.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_boa: A board whose traces are protected by topology.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_bou: A boule doped with topological insulator. Its surface conducts; its interior never will.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_def: A knot in a broken symmetry: the field could not agree which vacuum to fall into, so it kept both, and the seam between them cannot untie. Made in the Higgs Field Modulator.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_die: A die of topologically protected logic.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_ins: Insulating bulk, conducting surface, protected by topology.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_log: Braided anyons on a wafer; errors cannot touch them.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_pro: Tier III processor. Fault-tolerant by geometry. Made in the Femto Fabricator.
item.theoreticalsciences.topological_waf: A wafer whose edges carry current without resistance.
item.theoreticalsciences.topos.lore: A universe of mathematics with its own internal logic. Change the topos and you change what is true.
item.theoreticalsciences.transcendence_c: A crystal that has stepped outside every system that could describe it.
item.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_me: A metal whose properties are set by the forge, not by physics.
item.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_pl: Plasma above the temperature where matter has fixed properties. It is no longer any element; it is all of them and none. It glows every colour at once and has no fixed density. Instruments dipped into it return a different reading every time, all of them correct. Made in the Transcendent Plasma Forge. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.transcendental_: Found: mined from Transcendental Ore in the Platonic Realm.
π and e, which no polynomial can reach. Mined in the Platonic Realm, or extracted from axiom stone in an Analytic Continuator.
The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, without the place.
item.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_lat: Threaded with ℵ₀ turns. It never quite finishes screwing in, and it never comes loose.
item.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_pro: Tier VII processor. Finishes infinitely many operations in finite time.
item.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_wea: A weave with more threads than any finite count. Aleph-one and Absolute Infinity are stitched on it.
item.theoreticalsciences.transit_light_c: A star's brightness, dipping for a few hours as a planet crosses in front of it. The depth gives the planet's size.
item.theoreticalsciences.treads_of_infin: Every step lands. None of them fall.
item.theoreticalsciences.tree_of_life.lo: Every living thing, from the first cell to the whole biosphere, on one branching tree from a single root. As a catalyst it never wears. The keystone of Biology. Made in the Ecosphere from the five pieces of life.
item.theoreticalsciences.tree_simulacrum: A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe. Made in the Omnilex Engine.
item.theoreticalsciences.tritium_cell.lo: Hydrogen with two neutrons, radioactive with a half-life of 12.3 years. Its beta electrons are so weak they cannot get through the outer layer of skin. Made in the Tokamak and the Irradiation Chamber. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.true_vacuum_see: A bubble of the deeper vacuum, held below its critical radius. Let it grow and it expands at the speed of light, forever.
item.theoreticalsciences.tumour_hydra_sp: A mound of overgrown tissue as wide as a house, with heads on long necks growing out of every side. Its body only walks to keep the heads in reach; the heads bite. Strike a head or anywhere along its neck: every 30 damage cuts that head off (a blow to the body is mostly soaked up). The stump stays where the head was, open for five seconds: seal it with fire, or strike it with a CAR-T Cell Culture or an Apoptosis Trigger, and that head is gone for good; leave it, and it grows back with another beside it. With no heads left, blows to the body land in full and it can be killed. Its bite carries Metastasis. Called with a Metastatic Spore on open ground in the Tumour of Inner Space.
item.theoreticalsciences.tumour_specimen: Found: mined from Tumour Nodule in Inner Space (Tumour); dropped by the Tumour Hydra.
A sample of cells that have forgotten how to stop dividing. Found in tumour nodules in Inner Space's Tumour, and dropped by the Tumour Hydra; an Immortal Cell Line grows more in the Bioreactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.tuning_fork.lor: Strike it against a machine with a console and it rings at the machine's own pitch. Then the machine has to be calibrated by hand, with a short game that fits its science: match a waveform, line up a spectrum, route a flow, balance an equation, chain a proof, sieve primes, break a cipher, find the shortest route or an equilibrium, and more. Solve it and the machine is set at a working point for the recipe it runs (the console's fine tuning earns more). Older multiblocks have their tuning dial set. Each calibration dulls the fork a little (256 uses). Made by crafting.
item.theoreticalsciences.turbomolecular_: Bladed discs spinning at ninety thousand rpm, batting gas molecules out of the beamline one at a time.
item.theoreticalsciences.turing_morphoge: Two chemicals, one fast and one slow, that paint stripes and spots by themselves. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.unbihexium_ingo: Element 126, the heart of the island of stability. Nothing should be this heavy and last this long. Made in the Nuclide Forge.
item.theoreticalsciences.undecidable_ker: A program no other program can predict: whether it halts is true or false, and provably unprovable. It runs on anyway. Made in the Formal Proof Assistant.
item.theoreticalsciences.unified_dossier: Everything up to the edge of mathematics, unified. Feeds a Research Nexus.
item.theoreticalsciences.unified_notes_1: One third of a Research Dossier.
item.theoreticalsciences.unified_notes_2: One third of a Research Dossier.
item.theoreticalsciences.unified_notes_3: One third of a Research Dossier.
item.theoreticalsciences.unity.lore: The set whose only member is the empty set: von Neumann's one. Every probability adds up to it, and every quantum state is scaled to it. One of the five constants of Euler's identity. Made in the Formal Proof Assistant.
item.theoreticalsciences.universe_seed.l: A grain of false vacuum primed to inflate into a cosmos. Made in the Universe Forge.
item.theoreticalsciences.unruh_thermomet: A detector that clicks when it is accelerated through empty space: to it, the vacuum is a warm bath, T = ħa/2πck.
The two lightest quark flavours; everything you have ever touched is made of them.
item.theoreticalsciences.uranium_235_pel: Uranium enriched to a few percent of the fissile isotope: reactor fuel. The cascade will not go past 20%.
item.theoreticalsciences.uranium_238_pel: Depleted uranium: what is left when the U-235 has been taken out. Dense, barely radioactive, and fertile: in a reactor it becomes plutonium.
item.theoreticalsciences.uranium_hexaflu: The one uranium compound that is a gas near room temperature: it sublimes at 56.5 °C. Fluorine has a single isotope, so its molecules differ only by their uranium. Made in the Gas Centrifuge Cascade. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_drifter_: Calls a Vacuum Drifter into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.vanadium_bed.lo: Vanadium pentoxide on a silica support, in rings. At four hundred degrees it hands oxygen to sulfur dioxide and takes it back from the air, over and over.
item.theoreticalsciences.vent_biofilm.fo: Found: dropped by the Vent Grazer (Titan's Hidden Ocean (Subsurface Ocean, Hydrothermal Vents)); dropped by the Ice Eel (Titan's Hidden Ocean (Subsurface Ocean, Hydrothermal Vents)); dropped by the Vent Crab (Titan's Hidden Ocean (Hydrothermal Vents)).
item.theoreticalsciences.vent_biofilm.lo: A mat of bacteria that live on chemistry instead of light: hydrogen and sulfide from the vents, turned into food. The first link of the hidden ocean's food chain. Dropped by Vent Grazers in Titan's hidden ocean.
item.theoreticalsciences.vent_crab_spawn: A yeti crab: pale, hairy-clawed, walking the floor round the vents and waving its claws to feed the bacteria it farms on them. Harmless, unless struck. Near a vent long enough, it broods another. Found round the vents of Titan's hidden ocean.
item.theoreticalsciences.vent_grazer_spa: A pale shrimp that circles the hydrothermal chimneys, grazing the bacteria on them. Well fed, it splits off another; it flees any eel. The prey of Titan's hidden ocean. Found in Titan's hidden ocean, round its vents.
item.theoreticalsciences.virtual_gravito: Found: mined from Ephemeral Graviton Ore in the Quantum Foam; dropped by the Vacuum Drifter (the Quantum Foam).
A quantum of gravity that has not yet decided to exist.
item.theoreticalsciences.virtual_monopol: Found: mined from Ephemeral Monopole Ore in the Quantum Foam; dropped by the Planck Mite (the Quantum Foam).
A magnet with one pole. The vacuum only lends these briefly.
item.theoreticalsciences.virtual_pair_sp: Calls a Virtual Pair into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
Found: mined from Ephemeral Photon Ore in the Quantum Foam; dropped by the Virtual Pair (the Quantum Foam).
Light that never left anything and will never arrive.
item.theoreticalsciences.virtual_quark.f: Found: mined from Ephemeral Quark Ore in the Quantum Foam; dropped by the Virtual Pair (the Quantum Foam).
item.theoreticalsciences.virtual_quark.l: A quark borrowed from the vacuum. It wants to go back.
item.theoreticalsciences.void_essence.fo: Found: dropped by the Void Wraith.
item.theoreticalsciences.void_essence.lo: What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled.
item.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_sh: Found: mined from Void Lattice Ore in the Bulk (Moduli Wastes, Graviton Reef); dropped by the Void Wraith; dropped by the Moduli Crawler (the Bulk (Moduli Wastes)); dropped by the Graviton Wisp (the Bulk (Graviton Reef)); and elsewhere.
A fragment of the scaffolding between branes.
item.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_si: 32,768 void lattice shard, crushed into one point.
item.theoreticalsciences.void_wraith_spa: Calls a Void Wraith into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.
item.theoreticalsciences.von_neumann_pro: Builds copies of itself from whatever it finds. Put one in a Dyson Array. Made in the Nanite Assembler.
item.theoreticalsciences.vortex_filament: Found: dropped by the Kármán Wraith (the Accretion Frontier, above Y 200: the Jet Stream).

A thread of spinning air that will not unwind: the core of an eddy, held together by its own circulation. Wound round a magnet, it guides charged gas along the field. Dropped by Kármán Wraiths in the Jet Stream, above Y 200 in the Accretion Frontier.
item.theoreticalsciences.ward_fracture.l: A trace of what the Destabilised Husk carries, prepared so the body is ready for it. Use it on yourself: held safe from Fracture for three in-game days. Renew it while more than half of that is left and the imprint overloads instead. Made on the Antibody Bench.
item.theoreticalsciences.ward_grey_goo.l: A trace of what the Nanite Swarm carries, prepared so the body is ready for it. Use it on yourself: held safe from Grey Goo for three in-game days. Renew it while more than half of that is left and the imprint overloads instead. Made on the Antibody Bench.
A trace of what the Void Wraith carries, prepared so the body is ready for it. Use it on yourself: held safe from Hollowing for three in-game days. Renew it while more than half of that is left and the imprint overloads instead. Made on the Antibody Bench.
item.theoreticalsciences.ward_metastasis: A ward against Metastasis, the Tumour Hydra's bite, which hides from any plain ward. Use it on yourself: held safe for three in-game days. Renew it while more than half of that is left and the imprint overloads instead. Made in the Clonal Selector.
item.theoreticalsciences.ward_rewind.lor: A trace of what the Paradox Echo carries, prepared so the body is ready for it. Use it on yourself: held safe from Rewind for three in-game days. Renew it while more than half of that is left and the imprint overloads instead. Made on the Antibody Bench.
item.theoreticalsciences.warm_helium_cel: Helium that has done its job and warmed back up. It is ordinary gas now, clear and inert, waiting to be cooled again. Once superfluid, it is just helium. The noble gas never reacts with anything, so it can be recycled almost endlessly. Squeezed and chilled again, it remembers how to become superfluid. Made in the Stellar Plasma Crucible, the Tokamak and the Lattice Growth Vat. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.warp_bubble_cor: A bubble of flat space ready to be pushed through curved space. Used, it anchors where you stand; the anchored bubble brings you back there once.
item.theoreticalsciences.wave_packet.lor: A particle, written as a sum of waves; localised, but never exactly.
item.theoreticalsciences.wavefunction.lo: Everything a particle could be, written down at once. Made in the Analytic Continuator.
item.theoreticalsciences.waveguide.lore: A rectangular copper pipe that carries microwaves the way a pipe carries water; no wave longer than twice its width gets through.
item.theoreticalsciences.well_ordering_c: Every descent ends somewhere. Carry it in the Transfinite Hierarchy, the Platonic Realm's upper strata.
Also shields you completely in the Platonic Realm, the Antiverse, the Quantum Foam, the Bulk and black and white holes.
item.theoreticalsciences.whipple_shield_: Armoured like a spacecraft: a thin outer bumper shatters an incoming particle into a spray the inner wall can stop. Fred Whipple proposed it in 1946.
A thin bumper held off from the wall behind it. A micrometeoroid striking it shatters into a spreading cloud the inner layer can stop. Fred Whipple proposed it in the 1940s.
A thin outer bumper set apart from the shell, as Fred Whipple proposed in 1946. A fast grain strikes it, shatters into a spray, and spends itself in the gap.
Leggings layered like a Whipple shield: a thin outer skin shatters a hypervelocity grain into a spray of vapour that the next layer catches.
item.theoreticalsciences.white_dwarf_cor: A star's carbon heart, the size of a planet and held up only by electron degeneracy.
item.theoreticalsciences.white_hole_frag: A time-reversed horizon. Nothing can enter.
item.theoreticalsciences.wormhole_throat: The narrowest point of an Einstein-Rosen bridge, held open with exotic matter.
item.theoreticalsciences.xenobot_swarm.l: Living machines made of cells, designed by an evolutionary algorithm.
item.theoreticalsciences.xenogenome_samp: A genome from a creature of another dimension. Its code is not written in DNA. Made in the Gene Sequencer.
Life fluid from another dimension. It does not use DNA, and its chemistry is foreign. It is warm, iridescent and moves on its own. Its molecules are built on a backbone no terrestrial cell would recognise, and their handedness alternates in ways that should be unstable. Somehow it thrives on that instability. Made in the Bioreactor. (1,000 mB in a containment cell.)
item.theoreticalsciences.xylem_fibre.lor: Bundles of dead, hollow, lignified cells: the pipes a plant pulls its water up through, strong in tension and stiff along their length. Made in the Hydroponic Tower.
item.theoreticalsciences.yeast_culture.l: Budding yeast, Saccharomyces cerevisiae: given air it grows, and without air it ferments sugar to alcohol and carbon dioxide. It dies if carried about too long. Made in the Fermenter.
item.theoreticalsciences.yellowcake.lore: Uranium oxide concentrate, roasted out of pitchblende: a coarse yellow-brown powder, still 99.3% uranium-238.
item.theoreticalsciences.zeolite_catalys: A crystal full of molecule-sized pores; reactions that fit inside go faster. Made in the Chemical Reactor.
item.theoreticalsciences.zero.lore: The empty set, counted: von Neumann's zero. Nothing at all, and the start of every number. One of the five constants of Euler's identity. Made in the Formal Proof Assistant.
jei.theoreticalsciences.env_hint: Project them with Field Projectors, or build where the dimension already has them.
jei.theoreticalsciences.forge_laws: Compile at the rebuilt Core: tune its laws. 3 min re-seed after any forging.
jei.theoreticalsciences.forge_laws_drift: Compile at the rebuilt Core. Laws drift after each forging; 3 min re-seed. A Reconstitutor or Eschaton Foundry makes it too.

jei.theoreticalsciences.info.entangled_r: Item, fluid and energy transport. Place it against a machine, tank or chest, tune several to one channel with an Entanglement Tuner, and sneak-use with the tuner to switch it between sending and receiving. Moves 256 items, 64,000 mB and 64 M FE per tick, at any distance, even between dimensions. Research: Entangled Logistics.
jei.theoreticalsciences.info.entangled_t: The upgraded Entangled Relay: 8,192 items, 4,096,000 mB and 2.1 billion FE per tick, on the same channels. Place it against a machine, tank or chest, tune it with an Entanglement Tuner and sneak-use to switch between sending and receiving.
jei.theoreticalsciences.info.entanglemen: Tunes Entangled Relays and Transceivers to one channel (use it on them), and sneak-use switches one between sending and receiving. Everything on a channel moves items, fluids and energy between the blocks they face.
jei.theoreticalsciences.info.pleroma: Made in the Pleroma Confluence from 1,000 mB each of Quintessence, Alkahest, Mathesis, Panacea and Anima Mundi.
jei.theoreticalsciences.info.relativity_: Relativity Breakdown is the ceiling of the Quantum Foam. Fill a cell from it; it regenerates at once and never flows. Processed into the concepts of general relativity.
jei.theoreticalsciences.info.schrodinger: Schrödinger's Limit is the floor of the Quantum Foam. Fill a cell from it; it regenerates at once and never flows. Processed into the concepts of quantum mechanics.

proof.theoreticalsciences.diagonal.lesso: Change every diagonal digit and no list can contain you.
proof.theoreticalsciences.diagonal.rule: Six numbers hang on the wall. Make a seventh that no list could contain. Cantor needed only one line to do it.
proof.theoreticalsciences.diagonal.steps:
HOW TO ESCAPE
1. On the wall, lit lamps are 1 and dark lamps are 0. Each row is one number.
2. The gold [digits] run down the diagonal: digit 1 of Number 1, digit 2 of Number 2 ... digit 6 of Number 6.
3. Flip your switches below so each of YOUR digits is the OPPOSITE of the gold digit in the same column.
4. Touch the pedestal. Your number now differs from every number on the wall, so it cannot be on the list.
proof.theoreticalsciences.diagonal.title: The Diagonal
proof.theoreticalsciences.diagonal.wrong: The list already knows that number. It rewrites itself, read it again.

proof.theoreticalsciences.proper_time.ru: Live through 20 seconds of your own time. Your clock only runs while you are at rest. The singularity strikes where you stand.
