tooltip.theoreticalsciences.upgrade.stab: Upgrade: precision falls off half as fast
tooltip.theoreticalsciences.warp_bubble_: Use to anchor where you stand; you get an Anchored Warp Bubble that returns you here once.
tooltip.theoreticalsciences.wear.dead: Dead (%s): no use to any recipe
tooltip.theoreticalsciences.wear.exposed: Decays only out in the open: carry it in a Lead Pig
tooltip.theoreticalsciences.wear.heals: Heals a run of wear each run it is fed (sugar or broth)
tooltip.theoreticalsciences.wear.living: Dies off only while carried loose or dropped; machines and chests keep it
tooltip.theoreticalsciences.wear.poison: Poisoned by an unassayed feed: %s runs each
tooltip.theoreticalsciences.wear.spent: Spent (%s of new): too weak to work
tooltip.theoreticalsciences.wear.worn: Worn out: no longer works as a catalyst
tooltip.theoreticalsciences.whipple_shie: A thin bumper sheet, a gap, and layers of ceramic cloth: a micrometeorite shatters on the bumper and its spray is caught behind. Each piece stops a quarter of the Asteroid Belt's micrometeorites; a full set, all of them.
trait.theoreticalsciences.glow.desc: Selected %s times for glow, with the anglerfish's bacteria: at II, it bears glowing berries.
trait.theoreticalsciences.hardiness.desc: Selected %s times for hardiness, with tardigrade genes: from II, it grows in orbit and on Titan.
trait.theoreticalsciences.yield.desc: Selected %s times for grain: more wheat in the Hydroponic Tower.
transit.theoreticalsciences.accretion_fr: Starlight presses on the sail. The stars crowd ahead, and something dark waits among them.
The sail turns for home. The black hole shrinks behind you to a point.
transit.theoreticalsciences.antiverse.fl: Charge, parity and time reversed. Touch nothing you brought with you.
Through the mirror again, back into a universe made of matter.
transit.theoreticalsciences.black_hole_i: Past the event horizon, every road leads to the centre.
Climbing out of a black hole. This should be impossible.
transit.theoreticalsciences.hadal_trench: Eleven kilometres of water overhead, and a thousand atmospheres pressing on the hull.
Ballast away: the sphere rises towards the light.
transit.theoreticalsciences.hyperdimensi: More directions than you have names for. The World Tree waits above the Ocean of Law.
The extra dimensions fold away. Three will have to do.
Smaller, and smaller still, until the cells of a body are the size of houses.
The lenses open out, and the world grows back to its size round you.
transit.theoreticalsciences.living_proof: Inside Alpha Omega's mind, every step must follow from the last.
Q.E.D. The proof lets you go.
transit.theoreticalsciences.orbital_stat: Four hundred kilometres up, falling round the world at 7.7 km/s, and always missing it.
The burn ends; the station falls away behind.
transit.theoreticalsciences.planetary_in: Crust, mantle, and below: the rock grows hotter with every kilometre.
The layers fall away beneath you. Cool rock, then daylight.
transit.theoreticalsciences.platonic_rea: Every shadow on the cave wall gives way to its perfect form.
Back among the shadows. The forms stay true without you.
transit.theoreticalsciences.quantum_foam: Shrinking past the Planck length, where space itself boils.
The bubbles shrink to nothing as you grow back into the world.
transit.theoreticalsciences.the_bulk.fla: Our brane peels away. Between the membranes, gravity alone can follow you.
The membranes close in. You settle back onto our own brane.
transit.theoreticalsciences.titan.flavou: Down through the orange haze under a parachute. Somewhere below, a sea of methane waits.
The capsule climbs out of the smog, and Saturn's rings open above you.
transit.theoreticalsciences.titan.name: Titan
Down through a hundred kilometres of ice, and out into water no light has ever reached.
Up the tether, through the ice, to the orange sky.
transit.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_: Remove the middle third. Repeat forever. Keep counting past infinity.
Back to finite numbers, where every count comes to an end.
transit.theoreticalsciences.white_hole_i: Time runs backwards here: nothing may enter, everything is thrown out.
Flung out of the white hole and back into ordinary time.
item.theoreticalsciences.mammoth_spawn_e: Six tonnes of Ice Age grazer, brought back from a thirty-thousand-year-old bone. It wanders, grazes and keeps with its herd. It never starts a fight, but hurt one and every mammoth nearby charges, tusks first. Never found in the wild: released from a Mammoth Capsule, made in the Revival Vat.
item.theoreticalsciences.meganeura_spawn: A griffinfly of the Carboniferous, seventy centimetres across, from an age when the air held a third more oxygen. It patrols the place it was let go, darting and hovering, and flees fast and high if struck. Never found in the wild: released from a Meganeura Capsule, made in the Revival Vat.
block.theoreticalsciences.oceanic_basalt: The floor of every ocean is basalt, poured out at the ridges and carried for two hundred million years to sink back into the mantle at the trenches. Down here it is cold, glassy at the rind, and flecked with olivine that hot water turns to serpentine and hydrogen. Hot water through it gives hydrogen, more than Titan's silicate (made in the Chemical Reactor).
Found: in the Hadal Trench (Hadal Abyss, Hadal Vent Field), the rock of the whole trench, heaped into pillows where lava once broke out under the sea.
block.theoreticalsciences.hadal_ooze.lor: Marine snow, settled: the shells and glassy skeletons of plankton that drifted down for a million years, a centimetre a millennium. The glass is radiolarian silica, almost pure, and an arc fuses it to Fused Silica more cheaply than sand (made in the Tesla Coil).
block.theoreticalsciences.hadal_ooze.fou: Found: in the Hadal Trench, blanketing the floor of the Hadal Abyss and in drifts round the Hadal Vent Field.
message.theoreticalsciences.void_hadal_t: The current carries you up, and up, to the surface of a familiar sea.
